前传|q2_jasper.rank: 灵格（估，两队里身手最好）

He holds a short boat hook in both hands, its iron hook pierced with deep-tide drainage holes and a thin water-blue rune glowing along it, a steady look.

前传|q2_feina.battle: Flying low through a deep floor, in a winged archer's light kit: the fitted leather short jacket with the two wing slits, faced across the chest and shoulders with thin overlapping plates of dark beast shell that keep her light; a mountain-copper balance-scale plate on the left shoulder; a leather bracer on the bow arm with a single wind rune glowing pale blue; the quiver at her hip. 前传|q2_poppy.why: 天边的灯管账的半身人，下井只记账不出手，资料有姿势句顶替，照原句交回。

前传|q2_ladon.why: 201年29岁，下过三年井、能贴着穹壁飞上去，估灵格；父亲在监察所抄文书，中等人家，灵格照二档，公会旧皮甲配一两样会亮的东西，西边契约红线亮暗红。

He holds the short spear at a slant, its blade pointing forward and upward and throwing faint sparks, the butt behind him, the wings half spread, a watchful look.

前传|q2_saki.why: 二十岁的探路斥候，估共鸣，远哨家几代给公会探路，中等；共鸣一档，短外套外头只添一件兽皮背心、一片壳护臂和一把灌过魔力结霜的短刀，斥候要轻。

前传|q2_sansia.why: 四百多岁在林外走的木精灵，残响市集看旧东西，一箭钉住灰斗篷，估灵格；中等，二档，兽皮长甲配壳片肩和一只刻叶纹会亮的护臂，弓不换。

She holds the longbow with an arrow nocked, low and ready, a thin green glint running along the drawn string, a calm look.

前传|q2_silas.why: 白烛祭司，烛光挡得住铁水的雨，估灵格；小圣堂檐下长大，贫，降一档；祭司走法袍的路子，不带刃，只添一领缝了护符线会亮的白披肩和一片壳护臂。

前传|q2_mungo.battle: On a landing of the long stair: the guild's old hardened-leather armour buckled tight, its mountain-copper balance-scale plate on the left shoulder, the leather patched with dark monster hide that has an oily sheen and reinforced at the chest with a plate of pale beast shell on which he has carved a single rune; the words he carved along his leather bracers glow a low amber; the beard plates tucked into the collar; the mountain-copper guild seal on its cord. 前传|q3_tilo.rank: 灵格→极境（这一格是叫名字叫到天亮那一夜）

前传|q3_tilo.battle: Holding a terrace on the night of the tide, in east-slope garrison issue: the grey-blue tunic under a refitted leather cuirass riveted with mountain-copper, its twice-recovered shoulder guards now capped with plain copper plates; a rune line stitched in pale thread round the cloth section patch on his chest, glowing a soft dawn-gold; mountain-copper banded bracers; a short garrison cape of the same grey-blue; the bread bag tied tight; the reed whistle at his neck. 前传|q3_zane.why: 角城军团的西坡边兵，灵格高段，匠人家出身中等，穿军团发的整套黑皮甲；318年西边还没有电，添上约240年以后的铆钉黄铜扣和红莲契印的暗红光，枷匠家的大盾不换。
前传|q3_zane.battle: Holding the terrace, in the horn-city legion's heavy issue: the black legion leather riveted with iron and fastened with brass steam-age buckles, the city brand on its chest set with a legion badge sealed by a contract sigil that glows dark red; the two thick iron shoulder plates and the brand traced with thin copper rune lines that glow like banked coals; riveted iron vambraces; the old pincers at his belt. He braces the iron-rimmed tower shield before him with one hand, every ring-clasp along its rim cut open, and holds the other palm out flat and low, the copper glow in it burning bright, a steady, unmoving look.

前传|q3_funk.pref: 不带铁（研究院那一张写明塔底下不许带铁）

前传|q3_funk.battle: Under the tower in the lightning wastes, with no metal anywhere on him: the heavy forge apron, every rivet picked out and the holes stitched shut with rawhide, worn over the bare-armed top; broad pauldrons of thick storm-beast hide laced on with rawhide and scorched with branching lightning marks that glow a dull white; forearm guards of boiled monster hide; a belt of braided sinew. He grips the millstone hammer in both hands, raised to strike, thin white lightning crawling over its stone head, the white scars on his palms glowing hot red, a fierce, held-back look.

前传|q3_coqui.rank: 灵格→极境（这一格是一口气甩出七石那一夜）

前传|q3_coqui.battle: Under the lightning tower, with no metal on her at all: the many-pocketed jacket buttoned up, a short vest of supple monster hide laced over it; bracers of pale beast shell, the right one scratched with a tally of notches; three little bone dice in her ear in place of the bronze ones; a braided sinew belt with the pouch of ground flint pebbles. She holds the leather sling ready with a flint pebble in its pouch, a faint white spark at the stone, the other hand at her thick left collar, a sharp, focused look.

前传|q3_costa.pref: 照常（骨匠穿自己刻的骨甲）

前传|q3_costa.battle: On watch under the lightning tower, in bone armour of his own carving: over the grey bone-guild robe a close-fitting harness of bone plates at the chest, shoulders and forearms, each plate cut with fine warding patterns that glow a pale orange; the pocketed vest of bone knives and files over it; the nine bone tags at his waist, eight carved and one blank; the bone hands bare from the wrists. He holds the bone spear low and ready in both bone hands, its shaft of joined thunder-mane wolf leg-bones carved with a ward line that glows where lightning would run, the pale orange eyes glowing, a still, watchful look.

前传|q3_svia.pref: 崖上的规矩（赤脚、露鳞当甲）

前传|q3_svia.battle: On the ten-pace line, in cliff-clan war dress with no iron on her: a sleeveless short cuirass of thick storm-beast hide, branched scorch marks across it glowing faint white, leaving the scaled arms bare; a gorget of the same hide; the thick cloth band at the waist wound with a cord of braided sinew; the scales on her arms raised like armour, white fire leaping in their seams; bare feet planted. She holds the black obsidian hammer in her right hand, white sparks crawling over its ground black head, and the hardwood-capped white-ash staff in her left, a fierce, unflinching look.

前传|q3_nyx.rank: 英雄（LVL 196）→传奇（撼世，这一格是拖王的影子进影界那一夜）

前传|q3_nyx.battle: Stepping out of a shadow, at the height of her craft: a close-fitting suit of true shadow-cloth woven by shadow-demons and sold only at the night market of the mirror city, so matte that light sinks into it, the cuffs and hems bound tight; a black hood of the same cloth up; soft boots soled with silent shadow-cloth over cave moss; bracers of layered shadow-cloth over thin dark plates that neither ring nor shine; wisps of living shadow trailing from her shoulders and heels; the little lamp at her side with its bronze leaf open a crack. She holds the two black obsidian daggers low, one in each hand, a cold, still look.

He holds the torch, now lit, in one hand and the short spear with its cave-black iron head low in the other, a frightened, wavering look.

前传|q3_jonny.why: 十六岁的见习术士，未成年，下城淘晶屑人家，第三格照姿势句，battle 照原句交回。

前传|q3_suniva.why: 议会书记，不是打仗的人，第三格照姿势句画持剥晶刀和城章下井，battle 照原句交回。

前传|q6_gudmund.why: 981年英雄，炉城深井那一支的老斥候；英雄四档，油布外套照穿，底下一件内衬山铜小甲片的皮短褂，护腕带指节护片，脖子上挂护目镜，腰上小晶匣，苔罐照旧。
前传|q6_gudmund.battle: In a tunnel that is closing, in a forge-city scout's close gear: the layered-pocket oilcloth coat buttoned over a fitted jerkin of boiled leather lined with small overlapping mountain-copper plates, their rune lines glowing faint moss green; copper-ringed bracers with hard knuckle guards; the felt hat pulled low, a pair of brass goggles hanging at the neck, the star-chart rank emblem glowing on its cord; the moss jar open at his belt beside a small crystal cell. He grips the short pick in his right hand, ready to strike, the moss vial at his beard glowing blue-white. A fierce, scolding look.

前传|q6_bjarke.why: 鉴定所门口的背夫，八百多岁的背钟人，背东西不拿兵器；第三格照姿势句整句顶替，battle 照原句交回。
前传|q6_bjarke.battle: Carrying in the deep: thick leather pads over a long-sleeved leather jerkin, a broad belt of carrying straps, the wooden frame on his back loaded with a sealed crate lashed tight, heavy soft-soled boots. He grips both shoulder straps of the frame, braced under the load; he carries no weapon.

前传|q6_tima.why: 201年已到灵格，垂暮时七百九十多岁、领回收部一队，估英雄；英雄四档，回收部四袖灰呢外套照穿，底下一副深潮钢的鳞形胸甲，四条小臂都上刻符护臂，桨刃不换。
前传|q6_tima.battle: Ready in the deep, in recovery-department gear over a tide-folk war harness: the four-sleeved deep grey heavy wool coat with leather-padded shoulders, cinched with a broad belt over a fitted scale-shaped breastplate of dark blue-green deep-tide steel whose seams glow a faint sea green; rune-etched steel bracers on all four forearms; the large water skin and the pouch of white cloth strips at the belt, the four-strapped frame on her back. Her lower hands grip the two iron-edged short paddle-blades, held crossed in front like a shield, their edges lit with a thin watery glow; her upper hands are open and ready. A steady, watchful look.

前传|q6_zlata.why: 246年灵格，七百多岁的面包师，下井只下过两年，估极境；她一直穿雷狱那一件旧皮甲，偏好照旧，只把胸口和肩上换成雷打铁，门号的刻痕发亮，炉铲当长戟。
前传|q6_zlata.battle: Ready to defend the lane, in her old Thunder-Gaol armour refitted for the lane: the old leather armour re-plated with dark storm-forged iron at the chest and shoulders, the chest plate still engraved with her family's door number, its grooves glowing a faint violet; iron-banded bracers over her scarred forearms, heavy boots, the flour-dusted apron tucked up into the belt. She grips the long-handled iron oven peel in both hands like a halberd, its sharpened blade forward and glowing a dull oven red, a fierce glare with the corners of her eyes reddening.

前传|q6_odette.why: 这一身是约545年右翼压折以前塔港夜翼斥候的旧皮甲，收在箱子里，样子照繁荣那一段西边的黑曜钢扣和甲片，不往垂暮升；那时估灵格，中等，二档。
前传|q6_odette.battle: The scouting leathers of her flying days, kept in a chest since the wing was crushed: a fitted black leather flying jacket with two slits for the wings, faced at the chest and shoulders with small black obsidian-steel plates and buttons that never shine, a tower-port sky scout's short half-cape of night blue; leather bracers with a hooked wrist guard, dark trousers and soft climbing boots, a coil of thin rope at the hip. She holds a slim short knife low in one hand, a faint violet glow along its edge, the good wing spread, the broken right wing stiff and half open, a cool, sharp look.

前传|q6_ranka.why: 970年英雄，回收部背人的狼耳；英雄四档，灰呢外套照穿，底下一副沿脊背和肋下加了薄钢片的背负甲，背带交叉处发光，护目镜、工具带、白布条都留。
前传|q6_ranka.battle: On the stairs of the deep, in recovery-department gear built for carrying: the deep grey heavy wool coat with leather-padded shoulders cinched by a broad belt over a fitted harness of boiled leather and thin rune-etched steel plates along the spine and ribs, faint pale lines glowing where the carrying straps cross it; steel-ribbed bracers, brass goggles pushed up over her ears, a tool belt with a small crystal cell, the birch frame and its ropes with copper clasps on her back, a white cloth strip at the left arm with a thin pale light in its stitching. She grips the short axe in her right hand and a coil of rope in her left, braced on a stair, a steady, unhurried look.

前传|q6_farida.why: 970年极境，山里守闩人出身，下山后黑羊毛斗篷一直没换，偏好朴素；三档，斗篷底下一件嵌燧石灰石锻甲片的皮短褂，不加装饰，接缝透余烬橙光，桩头照旧刻余烬符。
前传|q6_farida.battle: Holding a camp, in a gate-keeper's plain war gear: the mountain-woven black wool cloak pinned back over a fitted jerkin of boiled leather set with dark flint-grey stone-forged plates, unadorned, their joints glowing a faint ember orange; heavy leather bracers banded with iron, brass goggles pushed up on the forehead, a tool belt, the bundle of stakes on her back whose iron tips are etched with glowing ember runes. She grips the short stone-breaking hammer in her right hand, raised to strike, its mountain-forged head glowing at the face. A level, unmoving look.

前传|q6_sivie.why: 970年英雄，架绳的夜翼，驻点高巢家；英雄四档，皮短褂外头一副轻的黑曜钢胸肩甲，黄铜扣的攀索带配平口铁钩，护腕带小晶匣，左翼白羽是她的升风之羽，微亮。
前传|q6_sivie.battle: Stringing a rope across a gap, in a sky rigger's fitted war harness: the leather short jacket with its wing slits under a light harness of thin black obsidian-steel plates over the chest and shoulders, brass-buckled climbing straps with plain open iron hooks, rune-etched wrist guards with a small crystal cell, brass goggles at the neck, the coils of thin rope round her waist and the row of iron spikes strapped down one leg; the wings half spread, the white feather showing and faintly glowing. She holds the small hammer in one hand and an iron spike in the other, ready to drive it into rock, a quick, fearless look.

前传|q6_laethen.why: 7年已是极境，垂暮时一千三百岁的老游侠，估英雄；英雄不看家境，四档，精灵不穿重甲，荆棘挂破的苔绿斗篷不补，底下一副叶形皮鳞短甲边缘透绿金光，白桦长弓不换。
前传|q6_laethen.battle: On the forest edge at night, in an old ranger's fitted forest gear: the moss-green cloak with its thorn-torn hem left unmended, under it fitted short armour of layered leaf-shaped leather scales, dark and supple, a faint green-gold vein of light running along their edges; a rune-carved bracer on the bow arm, a quiver of white-fletched arrows at the hip whose heads glint pale green. He holds the white-birch longbow at an angle with an arrow nocked, the string half drawn, a thin green light gathering along the arrow, a still, distant look.

前传|q6_aine.why: 433年已是极境，垂暮时一千一百多岁的白栎门守门人，估英雄；四档，深绿短外套底下一副白栎树皮甲片的背心，纹理透蜜金光，守门照旧光脚，门钥匙和剪灯芯的小剪子挂着。
前传|q6_aine.battle: Guarding the door, in a door-keeper's forest war dress: the deep green jacket buttoned over a fitted vest of pale white-oak bark plates whose grain glows a soft honey gold; a carved bracer on the bow arm, a quiver of beeswax-fletched arrows at the hip, the door key and the wick scissors at the belt, bare feet planted. She holds the short white oak bow with an arrow nocked, low and ready, a warm lamplight glow along the arrowhead, a firm, watchful look.

前传|q6_kian.why: 433年共鸣，阶上最穷的滴泉家，往后只是换蜜的人，垂暮时估灵格；家穷降一档，照暗精灵贴身黑衣不响不反光，王庭发的那件大一号的黑皮甲照穿，只添几片涂黑的铁片，矛头一层水光。
前传|q6_kian.battle: As a soldier of the steps, in the issue kit of the dark stair: the same black leather armour a size too big with the sleeves rolled twice, made so it never rings or reflects, a few thin black-iron plates laced over the chest and shoulders with blackened buckles; dark wrapped boots, the oil jar on his back, an unlit torch at his belt, the small clay bowl on its cord at his neck. He holds a short spear with a cave-black iron head low in both hands, a faint deep-blue water sheen along the head, a still, alert look.

前传|q6_fenya.why: 246年已是极境，垂暮时八百多岁、夜里上号台认天影，估英雄；四档，偏好守旧堡的老式样，锁甲照旧，只换上会发蓝白光的山铜环，罩一片不加装饰的钢胸甲，圆盾的堡号发亮。
前传|q6_fenya.battle: On the wall, in old-fort gear kept to the old pattern: the worn-smooth old-fort mail shirt, re-linked with rings of dark mountain copper that glow faint blue-white along the hem, over a dark grey padded tunic; a plain steel breastplate over it, unadorned; the iron-grey cloak with its single polished scale clasp; leather gloves. She holds the round shield up in her left hand, the old fort's mark carved on its face glowing, and the short spear with its leather-wrapped shaft in her right, the shoulders flat and set, the weight on the front foot, a stern, unblinking look.

前传|q6_ksenia.why: 864年已是英雄（LVL 128），垂暮时二百五十岁上下，四档；雷狱铁打的重甲照她的样子，雷燎焦痕和身上的紫纹一路透光，那一扇牢门是她的招牌，姿势里照原句留着不换。
前传|q6_ksenia.battle: Holding a line, in Thunder-Gaol war plate: dark heavy armour forged of gaol iron, its plates scorched with lightning burns and laced with faint pale violet lines that glow along the grain, black obsidian-steel pauldrons, broad leather straps across the back, the star-chart rank emblem and a dimmed war seal hanging at the belt. She holds before her as a shield an iron prison door as tall as a person and half as wide, a row of rivets down its face and a palm-sized food slot at waist height with one bar bent, gripping it by its leather straps, a faint violet glow running down into its rivets. A steady, immovable look.

前传|q6_lizzie.why: 第一千三百零五的队长兼画图的，界钥旅印，估极境，不拿兵器；第三格照姿势句整句顶替，battle 照原句交回。
前传|q6_lizzie.battle: Leading her party into the deep: the academy outfit under a fitted leather jerkin, leather bracers, a coil of rope over one shoulder, the flat map case at her belt. She holds up in one hand a palm-sized, pale grey-white six-pointed key shaped like a star, glazed like porcelain, one point broken half off, and a charcoal pencil in the other; she carries no weapon.

前传|q6_lucia.why: 挽晨遗民的最后一个，未成年，穿得严实，不打仗；第三格照姿势句整句顶替，battle 照原句交回。
前传|q6_lucia.battle: Ready for the deep roads: the long brown cloak belted at the waist with a cord to keep it off the ground, the sleeves rolled, her layered clothes tied close at the wrists and ankles. She holds the short iron bar low in one hand and does not fight. A wary, alert look.

月银纪史诗|ge10_kaya.why: 英雄不看家境，4档：一身照她量的雷纹豹领主皮猎装，皮上雷纹泛紫光，狼牙短斗篷，整根铁枪是猎雷人故意招雷的那一路，紫雷顺铁杆爬上枪尖。
月银纪史诗|ge10_kaya.battle: Hunting the storm, in a hunter-hero's gear cut from her own kills: a close-fitting hunting suit of dark-brown thunder-leopard hide tailored to her, the beast's lightning stripes still glowing violet in the leather; the short cloak thrown back with its ring of wolf teeth along the edge, each tooth tipped with a tiny spark; bracers of the same striped hide, a belt with the copper bell on the left hand side. She holds the solid iron-shafted spear in both hands low and ready, the point forward, violet lightning coiling up the iron shaft into the point, drawn there on purpose; the ears flat back and the tail low, the amber eyes narrowed; a fierce, focused look.

月银纪史诗|ge10_lothar.why: 极境3档，王子家境加一档到4，照朝峰不带铁的规矩量身做：老窑工的釉陶盔、雷狼皮叠缝的胸甲配干木扣，三层雷皮大盾面上带盾墙之令的光。
月银纪史诗|ge10_lothar.battle: Commanding the host with no iron on him, in the Peak kingdom's war harness made for its prince: a rounded helmet of fired clay with a dark brown-black glossy glaze, plainly pottery, shaped by the old kiln master; a fitted cuirass of layered storm-wolf hide laced with sinew and fastened with carved dry-wood toggles, its lightning pattern glowing faint white-blue; hide vambraces; the deep-blue cloak with the white antlers on his back. A big round shield covered with three layers of storm-wolf hide on his left arm, a sheet of pale light rimming its face, and in his right hand a long dry-wood spear with a fire-hardened point, a thin thread of storm-light along the shaft. A set, grave look.

月银纪史诗|ge10_winda.why: 八十岁的接生婆，不打仗、不带兵器，夜里上山接生，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge10_winda.battle: Not a fighter, going up the mountain at night: a heavy dark wool cloak over the indigo dress, the white apron tied on, a walking stick of pale willow in the right hand, the wicker box on her back, a small lit oil lamp held in the left hand. A steady, unafraid look.

月银纪史诗|ge11_hipono.why: 英雄不看家境，4档：牧野骑手的硬皮鳞轻甲照他的身量做，甲片烫的风鬃马冲锋时闪风光，铜头白蜡长枪带一道风，不带弓，左腕缠断弦。
月银纪史诗|ge11_hipono.battle: Ready to charge, in a steppe prince's riding harness made to his frame: a fitted light armour of hard-boiled leather scales over the side-vented tunic, each plate burned with a running wind-maned horse that flickers with a gust of pale wind-light, shoulder guards of the same scales, leather leg guards, soft boots, the horse-mane cord tying his hair, leather bracers with the broken bowstring wrapped round the left wrist. He holds the white-ash lance with its bronze head low and forward in both hands, a thin streak of wind running along the bronze, knees bent, no bow. A hard, focused look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge11_rowen.why: 灵格2档，朝峰公主加一档到3，照朝峰不带铁：雷狼皮叠缝的合身短甲配干木扣、釉陶盔、雷皮小圆盾带电纹，招牌是釉陶刃的干木柄短剑，袖口炭笔不丢。
月银纪史诗|ge11_rowen.battle: Ready on the gate tower, in the Peak's no-iron war kit cut for a princess: the blue cloak with the white antlers thrown back, a fitted jerkin of layered storm-wolf hide fastened with dry-wood toggles over the quilted short riding skirt and leggings, hide bracers, a glazed ceramic helmet; the round shield covered in thunder-hide raised on her left arm, faint lightning running through its hide; the short sword with a dry wooden grip and a dark glazed ceramic blade held forward in her right hand, its glaze catching a cold gleam; the charcoal pencil tucked in her sleeve. No iron anywhere. A resolute look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge11_tess.why: 灵格2档，浮岩一支补桥的矮人，家境中等不加减：帆布工装外添一件矮人做的铆皮半甲，肩上符文铁钉带炉红，小锤头敲一道符文，浮岩坠子往上提。
月银纪史诗|ge11_tess.battle: Ready on a swinging bridge, in a bridge-mender's work kit refitted for a fight: the canvas jacket buttoned and belted tight, over it a short dwarf-cut half-vest of riveted hard leather with rune-struck iron studs at the shoulders glowing faint ember red, hard leather knee and elbow pads, thick gloves, the belt ring of hooks and wedges, the pumice pendant lifting a little on its cord. The small hammer gripped in her right hand, a single rune on its head glowing ember red, a loop of pumice-fibre rope in her left; feet planted wide, the braids tied back. A fierce, fearless look.

月银纪史诗|ge11_sheila.why: 灵格2档，雾湾留下的穷渔家减一档到1：铅坠短衣外只添自己剥的鲨皮护腕，骨刀带一点海蓝光，网坠子发亮。
月银纪史诗|ge11_sheila.battle: Ready to dive in a fight: the lead-hemmed sleeveless tunic belted tight, its row of lead weights glinting dull silver, shark-skin wrist guards she cut herself, the wrapped trousers, the pierced lead disc on its cord at her neck; the bone knife gripped low in her right hand, its edge carrying a faint sea-blue sheen, the fine net held open in her left, every sinker on it gleaming. Knees bent, the wet hair tied back. A cold, alert look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge11_roman.why: 鹿门的王后，不打仗也不拿兵器，这一格是她不认错的站相，照原句交回。材料里附的原页那一条错贴成了洛温的，我照原页「鹿门的王后（人物）」那一条判的。
月银纪史诗|ge11_roman.battle: Defiant, no weapon: the pale-rose gown with a deep blue cloak clasped over it, silver antler brooch, leather belt; she stands tall with her chin up and one hand pressed flat to her chest, the other held out palm up. A proud, tearful look.

月银纪史诗|ge12_noi.why: 灵格2档，采珠人家穷减一档，未成年也往低里判，1档：短衣外添一件粗鲨皮背心和鲨皮护臂，腕上记气的结绳、姐姐给的小刀照留。
月银纪史诗|ge12_noi.battle: Ready to row hard: the short linen tunic belted tight with a rope, a sleeveless vest of rough shark skin over it, shark-skin guards on both forearms, trousers tied at the calf, the thin knotted cord of breaths round his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us); a long oar held upright in both hands beside him like a staff, the small knife his sister gave him at his belt. A set, determined look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge12_damian.why: 英雄4档：珠湾王子那一身鲨皮珠甲照他量身做全，护肩护颈护臂都是鲨皮、不带钢片，一百二十颗自己摸的珠泛海底的光。
月银纪史诗|ge12_damian.battle: Ready on the harbour wall, in the pearl armour of the bay's princes made to his measure: a fitted sharkskin cuirass with layered sharkskin pauldrons, gorget and arm guards and no steel plates at all, a hundred and twenty pearls he dived for himself set across the chest and shoulders, glowing faintly like light under the sea; a short blue cloak over one shoulder held with a shell clasp, sharkskin gauntlets, wax plugs with small pearls in both ears. The narrow, slightly curved long blade drawn and held low in his right hand, a thin line of water-light along its edge, his left hand open for balance, feet planted. A fierce, steady look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge12_modi.why: 灵格2档，自家有船的盐船船主，家境中等：盐渍外套外添一件半身人尺寸的盐浸鲨皮背心和鲨皮护臂，舵杆铁包脚带不沉之舵的一点海绿光。
月银纪史诗|ge12_modi.battle: Ready at the helm, in a salt-barge owner's own fighting kit: the salt-stained coat buttoned and belted, over it a halfling-sized vest of salt-hardened sharkskin crusted white at the seams, shark-skin bracers, trousers tied at the ankles, the rope at her middle hung with the salt knife and the small wax pot, wax plugs in her ears. She holds a long tiller-pole upright in both hands, taller than herself, its iron-shod foot and grip bands glowing a faint sea green as if the barge itself were leaning on it. A fierce, shouting look.

月银纪史诗|ge12_king.why: 老王年轻时是潜得最深的王子，估极境，3档；他说兽的东西不该戴在人头上，头上什么也不戴、不拿兵器，身上是四十年前自己那件放宽了的珠甲，珠光暗了。
月银纪史诗|ge12_king.battle: Commanding from the harbour wall, with no crown and no weapon: over the blue robe the sharkskin cuirass he wore as a prince forty years ago, let out at the sides with new straps, the hundred and twenty pearls he dived for in his youth still glowing a soft, dim sea-light; sharkskin bracers, a plain short cloak; nothing at all on his head. One hand raised palm out, the other at his side. A grave, firm look.

月银纪史诗|ge13_joen.why: 英雄不看家境，4档；他一辈子穿补了又补的油布外衣、鱼叉换到第四根杆，偏朴素，好料子是十七岁斩的汐鳞蛇皮贴身背心，不加装饰，鱼叉头挂一缕雾光。
月银纪史诗|ge13_joen.battle: Ready on a pitching deck, in a helmsman-hero's plain gear: the much-patched oilcloth coat belted tight with a rope, under it a close-fitting vest of dark tide-scale serpent hide from the serpent he killed at seventeen, unadorned, its scales giving a faint cold sea-green sheen; bracers of the same hide over the sleeves, trousers tied at the calves, straw-rope sandals, the leather waterskin with its cord tied in many knots at his belt. He holds the old fish-spear on its fourth shaft low and level in both hands, point forward, a thin wisp of sea-fog light clinging to the iron head; knees bent and balanced. A hard, watchful look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge13_tina.why: 灵格2档，补网的穷人家减一档：蓝布裙掖短、外罩皮背心，帆布围裙照留，添一张自己打结的网斜挎着，结上带愈挣愈紧的淡光，母亲的铜顶针照挂。
月银纪史诗|ge13_tina.battle: Ready for a rough crossing: the blue dress tucked and belted shorter over wool leggings, a leather jerkin over it, the canvas apron kept on, boots, her mother's brass thimble on its cord at the neck; a folded net of her own knots slung across one shoulder, every knot holding a faint pale gleam that tightens when pulled. The small knife held low in her right hand, the netting shuttle in the left; the plait pinned up. A tense, resolute look, mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge13_hakon.why: 极境3档，峡湾船长家境中等不减：厚羊毛外衣底下一件北边的铁环甲，海象皮护臂刻浪纹、橹歌起时泛海蓝光，招牌是钟舌包皮的小铜钟和砍缆斧。
月银纪史诗|ge13_hakon.battle: Ready to cut cable, in a fjord captain's war kit: the thick grey wool coat belted tight over a northern shirt of small riveted iron rings, walrus-hide bracers etched with wave lines that glow faint sea blue as his rowing song rises, the oilcloth cape thrown back over one shoulder, heavy sea boots; the small bronze bell at his belt with its clapper wrapped in leather, a faint ring of light humming around it. He holds the short cable axe low in his right hand, its bearded iron head bright along the edge, the left hand open and ready, feet planted wide. A fierce, shouting look.

月银纪史诗|ge13_suki.why: 共鸣，坡下渔家穷姑娘，1档：短衣外添一件粗鲨皮短背心和鲨皮护腕，父亲的骨哨照挂，骨钩尖带一点海光。
月银纪史诗|ge13_suki.battle: Ready to climb and cut: the faded fisher tunic tied tight with a leather belt, a short vest of rough shark skin over it, shark-skin wrist guards, the fishing line wound round her forearm, her father's bone whistle on its cord at the neck; a sharp bone hook gripped low in her right hand, its point glinting a faint sea-light, the left hand reaching forward, knees bent, the tail stiff behind her. A fierce, fast look, the ears flat.

月银纪史诗|ge14_mele.why: 英雄4档：照他量身做的野猪硬皮猎甲配护肩护臂，披十六岁钉死的铁皮狼王皮、毛上一层铁光，柏木匣系在腰上，自磨的矛头带琥珀光。
月银纪史诗|ge14_mele.battle: Ready to throw, in a plains prince-hunter's harness made for him: a fitted hunter's cuirass of hardened boar hide shaped to his frame with matching shoulder guards and bracers, the heavy grey pelt of the iron-skinned wolf king he killed at sixteen worn over one shoulder, its fur bristling with a dull iron sheen; a small cypress-wood box tied tightly at his belt. He grips the white ash spear in his right hand drawn back at shoulder height, the head he ground himself flashing a hard amber light, the left arm forward for balance, eyes locked ahead.

月银纪史诗|ge14_ode.rank: 共鸣→灵格（LVL 30→45，这一格是雨夜护炭那一刻）
月银纪史诗|ge14_ode.why: 守火人，未成年，不打仗不带兵器，照原句只添余烬眷顾那一点：火绒袋缝里透着活炭的红光、火钳口留一点炭红。
月银纪史诗|ge14_ode.battle: Standing his ground: the burned hide cloak belted tight with a cord over the coarse wool tunic, no armour and no weapon, the tinder pouch at his belt with a faint red glow of live embers showing through its seams, boots wrapped with thongs. He holds the iron fire-tongs upright in both hands in front of him like a staff, a warm ember-red glow caught in their jaws, the feet planted, the chin raised; a stubborn look.

月银纪史诗|ge14_irena.why: 王后启源，不打仗，这一格是护家的站相，钥匙和藏在袖里的红手掌就是她的东西，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge14_irena.battle: Standing firm for her house: the deep-brown gown with a leather belt cinched tight, a heavy dark travelling cloak, the key ring held firmly in her left hand, the right hand hidden in its sleeve; the chin raised, the brows drawn together.

月银纪史诗|ge14_jarlin.why: 灵格2档，粮原穷猎户家减一档：短猎衣外只添一只野猪硬皮护臂，箭头是平原兽骨磨的，软靴上缠一缕神行之足的绿风。
月银纪史诗|ge14_jarlin.battle: Ready to shoot: the short hunting jerkin laced tight over the close-fitting shirt, a hard boar-hide bracer on the left forearm, tight leg wraps and worn soft boots with a faint green swirl of wind wrapped round them, the small pouch of wheat grains at her belt, the quiver on her back holding arrows with heads ground from plains-beast bone. She holds the short bow drawn with an arrow nocked, eyes fixed on the distance, one foot pointed back on its toe; a sharp, unblinking look.

月银纪史诗|ge15_della.why: 共鸣，西坡逃来的孤儿、劈柴的守火人，1档：烧洞皮围裙罩东门库里的旧钉皮甲，添一块旧皮肩护，短斧刃上一线炭红。
月银纪史诗|ge15_della.battle: Ready to hold the gate: the scorched leather apron over an old studded leather jerkin from the gate's store, an old hide guard strapped over the right shoulder, leather bracers, hide boots wrapped with thongs, the braid pinned under a plain iron cap. She holds the short axe low in her right hand, a thin ember-red line glowing along its edge, the left hand open at her side; a steady, narrowed-eyed look.

月银纪史诗|ge15_jarlin.why: 极境3档，粮原穷猎户家到极境只减一档，2档：旧猎衣衬一层挡爪的铁皮狼软皮，护臂磨得发亮，换过两回弓臂的短弓、墨勒麦小袋照留，软靴上一缕绿风；偏好跟第十四歌那一格一样照常。
月银纪史诗|ge15_jarlin.battle: Ready to shoot: the old plains hunter's jerkin laced tight, now lined with supple iron-hide wolf leather that turns claws, a leather bracer worn smooth on the left forearm, leg wraps, soft boots with a faint green swirl of wind wrapped round them, the small cloth pouch of wheat grains at her belt, a quiver at the waist. She holds the short bow with its twice-replaced limbs drawn halfway, an arrow nocked whose head carries a pale glint, eyes narrowed at the distance; a calm, hard look.

月银纪史诗|ge15_leo.why: 灵格2档，牧野王家的骑士加一档到3：烫风鬃马的皮板轻甲配齐护肩护腿，马纹冲锋时闪风光，马鬃缨长枪，父王给的短刀照挂没用过。
月银纪史诗|ge15_leo.battle: Ready to charge, in the royal knight's harness of the grassland: a side-vented leather riding tunic under a matched light cuirass of boiled-leather plates with shoulder plates and thigh guards, every plate branded with a running wind-maned horse, leather vambraces, leather leg guards, soft boots, a plain open helm of hardened leather held under his arm, his father's unused short dagger at his left hip. The black-horsehair-tasselled lance is lowered forward in both hands, and the branded horses flicker with pale wind-light as if about to run; a firm, determined look.

月银纪史诗|ge1_ask.why: 共鸣，桥洞里打猎过活的穷猎户，祭火年间几乎没有铁，就是猎装外头缝一块厚皮护胸、箭头那半截废墟旧铁带一点暗红古光。
月银纪史诗|ge1_ask.battle: Ready to shoot from the snow, in a bridge hunter's scant war gear: the white wolf pelt pulled up with the wolf's head as a hood, a thick boiled-hide chest guard sewn on over the smoked deerskin short coat, rawhide bracers stitched with bone needles on both forearms, leg wraps, feet bound in hide strips. He holds the tall yew longbow drawn halfway in both hands, an arrow on the string whose head is half bone and half old iron ground from a fallen-god ruin, a dull ember-red glow still living in the iron; the quiver of crow-fletched birch arrows rides at his right hip. The ice-blue eyes narrow on a far mark, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge1_alm.why: 共鸣，穷猎户家的次子，熊皮背心照他的脾气敞着，只添一块皮肩护、骨片护臂，矛头下缠一圈废墟旧铁，追风之矛带一缕风。
月银纪史诗|ge1_alm.battle: Ready to charge into the beasts, in a poor hunter's few pieces: the bear-fur vest belted tight but still open over the wool shirt, a single thick boiled-hide guard strapped over the left shoulder, rawhide bracers with small bone plates sewn along them on both forearms, leg wraps and hide boots. He holds one long fire-hardened spear with a ground bone tip in his right hand, drawn back to throw, a thin ring of old ruin iron bound under the bone point glowing dull ember red and a faint twist of wind already curling round the shaft; the other six spears ride in a bundle on his back. A fierce, laughing look, the green eyes bright.

月银纪史诗|ge1_miah.why: 接骨的，不出手，不穿甲，照他的路子只在袍子外头系一块挡爪的厚皮围裙，手上带骨语圣手那一点暖光。
月银纪史诗|ge1_miah.battle: Ready to carry the wounded: the walnut-brown felt robe belted tight, the sleeves tied back with linen strips, a thick hide apron laced over the robe front against claws and no other armour, a satchel of bandages across the chest, the two birch splint-boards and the beeswax-sealed jar of bear grease at his belt, hide boots. He holds one splint-board in his right hand like a short club and a roll of bandage in his left, the long white fingers carrying a faint warm glow, the light his hands give when they find a broken bone. A worried but steady look, the mouth shut. The robe closes straight down the centre front with bone toggles under the belt and has fitted straight sleeves; no overlapping diagonal front.

月银纪史诗|ge1_hellas.why: 共鸣，南边逃来的难民，身上三层皮子都是借的，最外一层改成护胸，招牌是自己搓的那盘扯不断的绳，绳上带一点淡光。
月银纪史诗|ge1_hellas.battle: Ready to fight with a rope, in borrowed hides and his own rope: the three borrowed hides cinched with a rope belt, the outermost a stiff boiled-hide piece laced on as a chest guard, rawhide strips wound over both forearms, hemp leg bindings, hide-wrapped feet. He holds a long loop of rope in his right hand, whirled ready to throw, a faint pale sheen running along the twist of the strands that no beast can bite through, and the red-corded bone knife in his left; the big coil of hand-twisted rope hangs across his chest, its knots glinting the same pale light. A sharp, quick look, the mouth set.

月银纪史诗|ge1_niobe.why: 寻人的母亲，不打仗，肩上照她自己的意思什么也不披，不加甲，只添寻踪之线那一根从小鞋牵出来的淡光线。
月银纪史诗|ge1_niobe.battle: Setting out across the snow to follow a track: the grey felt robe belted tight with a leather strap, the sleeves tied back, leather mittens, hide boots laced high, no cloak on the shoulders and no armour, a walking staff of plain wood in her right hand, the tiny rabbit-skin shoe pinned inside her robe at the chest; from the shoe a short, thin thread of pale light trails out ahead of her, the line only she should see, leading toward the living. The black hair braided back for once; a fixed, unflinching look, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge2_dion.why: 共鸣，渔家养大，未成年，档往低里判，不加甲，身上像样的只有过路的神给的三件：照影铜盾、掘地龙爪弯刃、鞋跟灰羽，穿得严实。
月银纪史诗|ge2_dion.battle: Walking backwards toward danger, with nothing but a fisher's clothes and the three gifts of the road: the hemp tunic under the seal-skin vest, fully covered, seal-skin bracers on both forearms, the net rope belt cinched tight, the laced grass shoes with one grey feather sewn into each heel, a small swirl of wind lifting around them. He holds the round bronze shield up before his chest, its face polished like a windless lake and turned toward himself so that he looks only into it, never at the foe; the blade edged with a single burrowing-dragon claw is drawn low in his right hand, its dark claw edge glinting stone-grey. His body is turned away, the mouth set tight, the brow drawn together.

月银纪史诗|ge2_andor.why: 共鸣，礁边渔村剖鱼的姑娘，家里穷，渔衣外头只添一件自己剥的鲨皮背心和鲨皮护腕，船钩叫她攥得锈红；原句的献祭字样改掉了。
月银纪史诗|ge2_andor.battle: Ready to dive into the surf and fight: a short hemp fisher's tunic belted tight over fitted hemp leggings, a sleeveless vest of rough grey shark skin laced over it, shark-skin guards over both wrists, the strip of white linen torn from the robe she wore onto the reef tied round one leg, her own shark's tooth on its cord at the neck, the green hair bound up with the fish-bone pin. She holds the long gutting knife low in her right hand, blade turned out, and a short boat-hook in her left whose iron hook has gone rust-red, a faint salt-white glint where her grip closes on it. A fierce, sharp look.

月银纪史诗|ge2_sera.why: 盲眼的养鸽姑娘，未成年，不打仗，靠鸽子和摸石头，不穿甲也不加护符，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge2_sera.battle: Standing her ground in the street: the dove-grey dress belted with a leather strap, a grey wool cloak closed at the throat, soft leather boots, the pebble string tied close at her waist, the long hair braided and wound round her head. She holds out one arm with the grey dove ready to fly from her wrist and the other hand flat against a wall; a calm, unafraid look.

月银纪史诗|ge2_einar.why: 共鸣，岛主的儿子，家境把他从1档抬到2档，可他是歌手、只会唱，所以是从父亲厅里借来、肩宽了一号的铁鳞衫，配家里的金鱼胸针和银臂环，琴弦带一点暖光。
月银纪史诗|ge2_einar.battle: Out of his depth but standing his ground, in war gear borrowed from his father's hall: the indigo wool cloak pinned on the left shoulder with the gold brooch cast as a fish biting its own tail, over a shirt of small iron scales a size too broad for him, worn over a quilted linen jerkin; the silver arm ring on the right wrist, leather bracers, boots. He grips the small driftwood harp with its whale-sinew strings in his left hand like a shield, the strings humming with a faint warm glow, and in his right a plain borrowed short sword held awkwardly low; the smile gone for once, the mouth set.

月银纪史诗|ge2_danae.why: 铜塔出来的公主，如今是补网的妇人，不打仗，门口拿网梭挡人，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge2_danae.battle: Standing in a doorway against a visitor: the grey apron cinched tight over the hemp dress, the shawl pinned, sleeves rolled up, sturdy shoes; she holds a heavy wooden net-mending shuttle in her right hand like a short club, her chin raised, her left hand flat against the door frame; a cold, level look, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge3_emon.why: 共鸣，红枝厅少年，未成年往低里判，可冰鬃狼皮是他自己斩下的兽，照万兽前英雄披兽的写法让皮呵白霜，红短袍外添一件库林打的少年身量的鱼鳞铁片衫，算2档。
月银纪史诗|ge3_emon.battle: Ready to fight on the ice: the red hall's red tunic belted tight with the wolf-tooth buckle, over it a short shirt of Kurin's fish-scale iron plates fitted to a youth's frame, leather bracers over the sleeves, the pelt of the ice-maned wolf he killed at seven settled on both shoulders with its head on his shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us), a faint white frost breathing from the worn fur, deerskin boots. He grips a long barbed spear with a black shaft and a head ground from the spine bone of a tide-scale serpent, so cold it gives off white vapour, held forward in both hands. A fierce, focused look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge3_moen.why: 共鸣，铁匠独女，未成年，按位阶是1档，可铁匠家自己打得出铁，围裙底下添一件她自己打的小号鱼鳞铁片背心，带霜炉的一点霜青光，火钳钳口带炉红，算2档。
月银纪史诗|ge3_moen.battle: Standing guard at the forge door, in the smithy's own iron: the burnt leather apron cinched tight over a short vest of overlapping iron scales she forged herself, lighter and smaller than her father's, each scale holding a faint frost-blue sheen from the snow forge; leather gloves, the sheepskin jacket buttoned to the throat underneath, the wolf tooth on its cord, hobnailed boots. She grips a heavy long-handled pair of iron tongs in her right hand held out like a weapon, their jaws still glowing a dull forge red, an iron-bound mallet hanging in her left; a determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge3_fildi.why: 共鸣，红枝厅的战士，补层里红枝厅战士就是熊皮斗篷加库林打的鱼鳞铁片甲加红枝铁边圆盾，正是一套合身的旧甲，添霜炉铁片的霜青光和小臂的角质光。
月银纪史诗|ge3_fildi.battle: Ready to hold the line, in the red hall's war kit: the shirt of overlapping iron scales Kurin forged, belted tight, every scale carrying a faint frost-blue sheen from the snow forge, the heavy bearskin cloak thrown back over one shoulder, leather bracers, the bare forearms showing a faint polished-horn sheen. He carries the iron-rimmed round shield painted with a single red branch on his left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us) and a short spear in his right hand held ready; the short wide-bladed sword hangs at his hip. A fierce, steady look, the jaw set.

月银纪史诗|ge3_kong.why: 北境的王，年轻时斩过狼群首，估灵格，王家算2档，可他十年不打仗、这一身是上坡跪着挨冻的，不加甲，只让冠上橙冰曜核亮着；原句的献祭字样改掉了。
月银纪史诗|ge3_kong.battle: He does not fight: dressed for the long cold kneeling on the hill, the white-wolf-lined blue-grey robe belted tight under a heavy hooded cloak, fur gloves, fur boots, no armour and no weapon; the plain iron-banded crown on his head, its small orange-ice beast core glowing a soft cold orange and breathing a thin frost above it. He holds a plain wooden staff of office in one hand, the other hand pressed to his chest; an anxious but resolved look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge3_kurin.why: 铁匠，原句就是守在砧子边不出手，不加甲，只让锻锤沾一点他雪地野炉的霜青光和火星。
月银纪史诗|ge3_kurin.battle: He does not fight: braced at the anvil, the thick leather apron cinched over the rolled-sleeve wool shirt, thick gloves, a leather cap, heavy boots, a pair of tongs tucked in the belt, no armour. He grips the big forging hammer in both hands held across his body, its head rimed with a thin frost-blue sheen from his snow forge and a few bright sparks still clinging to its face; a stubborn look, the mouth set.

月银纪史诗|ge3_kasba.why: 老祭司，观天说吉凶，不出手，不加甲，只让骨铃杖上的小骨符带一点淡白的光。
月银纪史诗|ge3_kasba.battle: He does not fight: dressed for the cold watch on the south bank, the charcoal-grey robe belted tight under a heavy fur-edged hooded mantle, fur gloves, fur boots, no armour. He holds the plain wooden staff in his right hand, its small bone charms glowing a faint pale white and stirring by themselves, the left hand pointing at the sky; a stern, certain look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge4_arke.why: 英雄不看家境，4档；他自己说不披甲，所以分量全在斩下的兽上：雷纹豹王的整张皮当甲当盔、电光满身，护臂用九首藤蟒王的鳞皮，弓弦是它的筋。
月银纪史诗|ge4_arke.battle: Ready to strike, wearing no armour but the beasts he killed: the whole pelt of the thunder-striped leopard king tied tight over the shoulders, the leopard's head set on his head as a helm and the two forepaws knotted across his chest, blue-white lightning crawling all through the fur and snapping between the leopard's fangs above his brow; under it only the coarse hemp tunic belted tight, bracers cut from the scaled hide of the nine-headed vine-serpent king, the hide-cord shoes laced to the calves. He grips the whole olive-tree club raised in his right hand, and the great bow strung with the vine-serpent king's green-glinting sinew is slung across his back. A fierce, angry look, the gold eyes burning.

月银纪史诗|ge4_io.why: 灵格，牧人家出身、穷一档，打不了仗，举的是火不是兵器，只添一块挡火星的短皮披肩，火把杖头那团长明之炬亮着。
月银纪史诗|ge4_io.battle: Ready to light the way, carrying fire instead of a weapon: the faded blue tunic under the sheepskin vest buttoned up, three loops of hemp rope belted tight at the waist, a short hide cape against sparks over the shoulders, leather gloves on both hands, boots laced. He grips the iron-hooped torch staff in his right hand held forward, its flame burning bright, steady and upright as if no wind or rain could ever reach it, a ring of warm gold light around the staff head; a coil of rope over his left shoulder. Braced and bright-eyed, the brows drawn together, the mouth set.

月银纪史诗|ge4_hipola.why: 灵格本是2档，南原女王，家境加一档到3：赭红毡袍外一整身兽皮鳞甲，招牌是历代女王传下的奔马金带，箭上带追云托起的风。
月银纪史诗|ge4_hipola.battle: Ready for a ride, in the war dress of the southern plain's queens: the red-ochre felt robe belted tight under a full coat of scale-hide armour pressed from a great steppe beast, a white-fox collar at the throat, fox-trimmed cuffs rolled back, scale-hide vambraces, riding boots; the ancestral belt of linked gold plaques at her waist, each stamped with a running horse that glints warm gold as if galloping. She holds a horn bow in her left hand with an arrow nocked, a thread of wind spiralling round the arrow, and a quiver of arrows at her hip; a fierce, laughing look, the braids flying.

月银纪史诗|ge4_naifei.why: 悬城的牧羊姑娘，未成年，这一格是攀索、不是打仗，不加甲，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge4_naifei.battle: She does not fight: ready to climb, the sky-blue dress-robe belted tight with the wool rope, the canvas cape tied snug at her neck, leather gloves, soft leather climbing shoes laced to the ankle. She grips the rope in both hands with the bronze hook held forward; a focused, brave look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge4_oryu.why: 梯林王胆小、不出手，估启源，可他有钱又怕死，照家境给一身贵而不合身的镀边铜鳞外套，算2档，手里照旧只有权杖。
月银纪史诗|ge4_oryu.battle: He does not fight, but he is armoured far beyond his nerve: a heavy bronze-scale coat over the blue robe, the scales gilded at the edges and too broad for his thin shoulders, a bronze helmet pulled down low over the thin gold circlet, its small blue water-core showing at the brow and glowing a faint watery blue, leather gloves, shoes buckled. He holds a plain staff of office in both hands out stiffly in front of him; a frightened but commanding look, the mouth set.

月银纪史诗|ge4_piro.why: 十三岁的牧羊少年，一生只点过一回火，不打仗，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge4_piro.battle: He does not fight: ready for a long watch on the hill, the sheepskin vest buttoned, a hooded wool cloak over the tunic, leather mittens, laced shoes. He holds the wooden crook upright in both hands; a steady, watchful look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge4_tiweng.why: 覆城的老祭司，守祭坛不出手，补了几十层的祭袍就是他的样子，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge4_tiweng.battle: He does not fight: standing guard at the altar edge, the patched robe belted tight under a heavy wool mantle, fur-lined gloves, boots laced. He holds the mast staff upright in both hands; a firm, stubborn look, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge5_xien.why: 共鸣，镜湖诗人的学徒、林中木屋里长大，未成年往低里判，只在常服外头罩一件白丘猎团借来的皮护胸，招牌是那杆淬过霜牙熊冰毒的白蜡冰矛。
月银纪史诗|ge5_xien.battle: Keeping watch at the city gate, in the little a lake poet's apprentice can borrow at the White Hill: the moss-green tunic and deerskin jerkin with a hunting-band hide chest guard strapped over them, a single dull copper band button at its edge; leather bracers over the sleeves and tall laced boots. In both hands he grips a long white ash-wood spear, its tip steeped in frost-fang bear venom, held forward and slightly up; pale blue frost glitters on the tip and a thin cold mist breathes from it along the shaft. A wide-awake, unflinching look, the eyes open, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge5_gol.why: 英雄、带了猎团十七年的头领，英雄不看家境，照万兽前英雄披自己斩下的兽：熊皮斗篷下一身量身的兽皮甲，焰鬃狼皮的肩护臂护胫，铜扣封火核，刻名的弓是招牌。
月银纪史诗|ge5_gol.battle: Leading the hunt, in a beast-age hero's war gear: the black bear-hide cloak thrown over one shoulder, under it a fitted cuirass of polished hide, the row of copper hunting-band buttons across the chest each set with a chip of red fire core glowing like an ember; a pauldron, bracers and greaves of red flame-mane wolf hide that throw small sparks when he moves; a bow carved all over with names slung across his back, the carved names holding a faint ember glow. He grips a long spear in both hands, braced forward at an angle, its head ground from a flame-mane wolf fang with a lick of flame at the point; two short spears at the belt; the silver staff is left behind. A fierce, unflinching look, the jaw set.

月银纪史诗|ge5_lis.why: 灵格，退隐的猎团老手，住林海木屋，家境中常，二档：当年猎团的旧皮甲改合身，藤蟒鳞的射手护臂和刺鹿角箭头是会亮的两样，她靠无声，不加重甲。
月银纪史诗|ge5_lis.battle: Ready to loose, in her old hunting-band kit refitted: the grey-green deerskin shirt under an old hide cuirass from her years in the band, re-cut close to her lean runner's frame; a long archer's bracer of green-black vine-serpent scale on the left forearm, its scales shimmering faintly green; a leather bracer over the right cuff, the thin soft slippers, the skinning knife at her belt. In her left hand she holds the yew longbow with a white hair wrapped round its back forward at full draw, an arrow nocked whose head is ground from thorn-deer antler with a faint green glint, the right hand at her cheek; the long lock across her forehead, the green eyes narrowed on a far target, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge5_berdma.why: 林海守火三十年的女祭司，问梦不打仗，照祭司的路子不披甲，只让斗篷边的干橡果和杖头的光应着焚枝问梦术。
月银纪史诗|ge5_berdma.battle: Calling up a dream, in no armour, as a Forest Sea priestess goes to the fire: the long undyed linen robe and the deep walnut-brown cloak, the ring of dried acorns along its edge glowing one by one a faint violet, the pouch open at her belt. She holds the oak staff up before her with both hands, the bone bell ringing, a burning twig glowing in the head of the staff, faint pale-violet smoke curling round her hands and rising in slow threads like the shapes of a dream, the half-lidded amber eyes steady and calm.

月银纪史诗|ge5_finny.why: 镜湖的老诗人，一辈子不打仗不拿兵器，第三格是钓鱼的姿势句，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge5_finny.battle: He never fights and carries no weapon: the oatmeal robe hitched up through the belt, the grey shawl wrapped tight round his shoulders, he stands braced on both feet holding a bent fishing rod in both hands as if a great fish were pulling, the beard blowing, a rare fierce, laughing look.

月银纪史诗|ge5_koma.why: 原页没写位阶，二十岁斩过焰鬃狼王、守城二十三年却抗不住笛声，估极境；诸王纳贡的最高王，极境加一档，照万兽前的王把自己斩的那张狼王皮整张披上，冠上的赤火核正对得上。
月银纪史诗|ge5_koma.battle: Ready to defend his city, in the High King's war gear: over the dark-grey tunic a fitted cuirass of hardened red flame-mane wolf hide, and across his shoulders the pelt of the flame-mane wolf king he slew at twenty, its head hanging behind his back, the forepaws knotted across the chest, small sparks crawling in the red-gold fur; an iron-reinforced leather cap under the crown with its glowing red fire core; iron bracers; the crimson cloak pinned back. He grips a long straight iron sword in his right hand held forward and low, a heavy round shield faced with the same red hide on his left arm, its rim darkened by heat. A grim, unflinching look.

月银纪史诗|ge6_aidan.why: 英雄，逃了十五年手头穷，可英雄不看家境，好东西是自己打来的：发白的九矛猎装底下一身亲手剥的林海藤蟒鳞甲（★），红铜、黄铜两杆矛是招牌。
月银纪史诗|ge6_aidan.battle: Ready to leap, in war gear he made himself in fifteen years on the run: the worn-pale Nine Spears hunting shirt under a close-fitted cuirass of green-black scaled hide cut from a great vine serpent of the Forest Sea, the scales flashing faint green when he moves, with matching scale vambraces and shin guards; the grey-green cloak pinned back, tall laced boots. He grips the red-copper spear in his right hand, its head glowing a dull ember red, and the brass spear in his left, its head a pale gold gleam, both held low and forward in a crouch ready to spring, the short sword at his waist; a keen, steady look, the eyes open, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge6_gleni.why: 王家出身，可逃了十五年身上只剩补丁短袍和艾丹的旧斗篷；她靠听风和那一壶酒，不拿刀，只添一件艾丹替她裁的鹿皮背心，酒壶口泛出叫人发困的光。
月银纪史诗|ge6_gleni.battle: Keeping watch against pursuers, with no armour and no blade: the short patched robe cinched tight under a light deerskin vest Aidan cut and laced for her, the hunting cloak pinned back, leather bracers on her wrists, the pouch of dried white poppy at the belt, the grass sandals. In her right hand she holds a small clay wine flask, a faint drowsy silver-white glow rising from its mouth; her left hand is cupped to her ear to catch far footsteps, the green-gold eyes narrowed, the mouth closed; she carries no blade.

月银纪史诗|ge6_kailan.rank: 英雄（LVL 131→158，喊醒三十个村子那一日一夜）
月银纪史诗|ge6_kailan.why: 英雄本该四档，可他图轻，背上只一杆短矛，照他的偏好压成跑得动的一身：剃了毛的焰鬃狼皮背心不着火（★），鞋跟带火星应着迅雷之足；传奇那一张往后另画，偏好不变。
月银纪史诗|ge6_kailan.battle: Running ahead of the danger, in a Nine Spears runner's kit cut for speed and nothing more: the short hunting shirt cinched tight with a belt under a thin close-fitted vest of shorn flame-mane wolf hide that will not catch fire, deerskin leg wraps, light leather bracers, new thin-soled shoes with small embers flickering at the heels, the old burnt-through shoes tied at his belt. He holds his one short spear in his right hand pointed forward at a run, the left hand cupped beside his mouth to shout a warning, the honey hair and nape braid streaming, bright eyes and an open mouth.

月银纪史诗|ge6_eogan.why: 原页没写位阶，老王不再上阵，估灵格；王族家底厚，战厅里披的是祖父柯马那一身焰鬃狼王皮甲（★，跟柯马那一张对上），穿在瘦了的身上有点松，姿势照原句。
月银纪史诗|ge6_eogan.battle: He is old and no longer fights; in the war-hall he wears his grandfather Koma's war harness, a little loose on his thin frame: a cuirass of hardened red flame-mane wolf hide over his robe, the wolf king's faded red-gold pelt across his shoulders with the forepaws knotted on the chest, a few dim sparks still crawling in the fur; the crimson cloak pinned back and the crown with its glowing red core on his head. He leans on a long staff held upright in his right hand, the left hand on the hilt of a sheathed straight sword at his belt; a stern, stubborn look.

月银纪史诗|ge7_maren.why: 画的是上崖那一刻，已到英雄，本该四档；他是种麦的，王与龙都压不弯腰，不要旗号不要装饰，照朴素压一档：一身剃毛不染的焰鬃狼皮甲（★），粗麻短褂、草绳腰带、半截仓签照旧，母炉之料的剑裹着布透出暗红的热。
月银纪史诗|ge7_maren.battle: Ready for the cliff, in plain gear of good stuff with nothing added: the short linen tunic and straw-rope belt with the split granary tally, over them a close-fitted cuirass and vambraces of fire-mane wolf hide, the fur shorn, undyed, no plate, no badge, faint sparks along the seams; cloth forearm wraps under the vambraces, boots. A sword with no scabbard, wrapped in cloth from end to end, is slung across his back on a strap, its hilt over his right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us), a dull dark-red heat glowing through the cloth along the blade; both hands are empty and balled at his sides, the gaze steady and cold.

月银纪史诗|ge7_oswin.why: 灵格本是二档，灰岭小王家底在，加一档成套：深蓝外袍下的煮皮甲配黑铁山形肩片，臂环和领扣封着曜核的光，招牌是雷鬃狼獠牙磨的三支投枪。
月银纪史诗|ge7_oswin.battle: Ready to hunt a beast, in the Greyridge prince's war gear: the indigo robe belted short over a fitted boiled-leather cuirass with black iron mountain-shaped plates at the shoulders, the black iron mountain clasp at the collar and the two bronze arm rings on his right forearm each holding a faint glow of beast-core light; bracers, boots. A round linden-wood shield painted with a grey mountain on his left arm, its rim bound in black iron; the white-ash spear with his grandfather's old head in his right hand held forward low; three javelins with heads ground from a storm-mane wolf's fangs bundled in a leather quiver across his back, thin violet sparks crawling on their points. The grin is gone, replaced by narrowed, intent blue eyes.

月银纪史诗|ge7_inga.why: 灵格，第一炉压风箱的矮人姑娘，家里不富又未成年，往低里判；她徒手掰兽嘴、不拿兵器，只添一对第一炉的铆钉护臂，矮人符文圈泛炉火红。
月银纪史诗|ge7_inga.battle: Ready to wrestle, with no weapon and only the forge's own gear: the thick leather apron cinched tight over the long-sleeved tunic, a pair of heavy riveted forge bracers from the First Furnace on both forearms, a ring of dwarven runes struck into their iron bands glowing a dull furnace red, heavy iron-toed boots, the small stone bowl at her belt. She carries no weapon: both hands are raised open in front of her, fingers curled; a fierce, determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge7_hob15.why: 磨坊的小儿子、随粮车喂难民，不拿兵器，未成年，照原句只添脖子上那粒干麦亮着麦神的金光，应着他求收获回回有回话。
月银纪史诗|ge7_hob15.battle: On the road with refugees: the floury smock under a weathered oilcloth travelling cloak buttoned to the neck, cloth gaiters over sturdy boots, a seed pouch at his belt, the single dry wheat grain on its straw cord at his neck glowing a faint warm gold. He carries no weapon: he holds a bulging sack of grain in both arms in front of him, the knees braced, a rare earnest, determined look, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge7_ragna.why: 共鸣的牧羊女，家贫、未成年，赤脚是她的天赋不改；一档只有长厅给的那把水色长剑和脚踝上奥斯温赏的臂环封着一点曜核的光，溪石带着泉水。
月银纪史诗|ge7_ragna.battle: Ready to defend the flock, in a shepherd's clothes and one gift from the long hall: the long wool tunic belted tight, the sheepskin vest closed, leather wrist-guards, barefoot, the bronze arm ring at her left ankle (on the viewer's right when they face us) holding a faint glow of beast-core light. A long sword with a pale water-coloured blade is slung across her back on a strap, its hilt over her right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us); in her right hand she grips the braided sling cord with a river stone in its cup, the stone beaded with clear spring water that glints; a fierce, quick, determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth shut. The sword is slung on her back so that its hilt rises above her RIGHT shoulder, which is on the viewer's LEFT when she faces us, never above the other shoulder; the tunic hem stays down at her shins in this panel too.

月银纪史诗|ge7_fia.why: 灵格本是二档，苇棚猎户家的女儿，家贫减一档，未成年：猎装外只添一件岚鹰皮的短背心（★，羽是她自己拔的那种鹰），箭羽泛风的光，应着乘风之子。
月银纪史诗|ge7_fia.battle: Ready to run and shoot, in her hunting clothes and one piece of the hunt: the sun-faded hunting jacket buttoned to the neck, cuffs tied, over it a light sleeveless vest of storm-hawk skin, its short grey feathers along the shoulders lifting in a wind no one else feels; a leather bracer on her left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us), the reed quiver on her back, its storm-hawk fletching stirring with a faint pale-green gleam of wind. She holds the short magic-plant heartwood bow at full draw with a reed arrow nocked, aimed past the viewer; a sharp, narrow-eyed look, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge7_ronan.why: 灵格，村里出身，可吃住在双虹城领主家、枪头是领主家传的，算中常，二档：领主家的煮皮甲改合他的身架，加一领他拧断脖子的那头铜皮狼的皮（★），臂环封着曜核的光。
月银纪史诗|ge7_ronan.battle: Holding the bridgehead, in lord's-house gear refitted to his man-sized frame: the boiled-leather cuirass laced tight, over his shoulders a short mantle cut from the copper-skinned wolf he killed at the south gate, its metal-bright fur shining like old bronze, leather pauldrons beneath and leather bracers, the bronze Greyridge arm ring on his right forearm (on the viewer's left when they face us) holding a faint core-light; heavy boots. He holds the white-ash spear with the lord's family spearhead levelled forward in both hands, the point steady; his pale eyes blaze gold, a hard, unflinching look, the mouth shut.

月银纪史诗|ge8_inga.why: 英雄，不看家境，四档量身打的炉城角力甲；她一辈子徒手、白骨剑二十九年没拔，所以不给兵器，只把护具做到顶：铁片肩背、符文铁箍护臂、铁钉指虎手套，剑照旧插在石鞘里。
月银纪史诗|ge8_inga.battle: Fighting with her bare hands, in a forge-heart wrestler's harness made to her own measure: the thick leather waistcoat reinforced with overlapping plates of dark rune-struck iron across the shoulders and back, the runes glowing a deep furnace red; thick leather bracers up to the elbows banded with iron rings carved with dwarven runes; heavy fingerless leather gloves with iron-studded knuckles; iron-toed boots planted wide. The white bone sword stays sheathed in its plain chiselled stone scabbard at her belt on the right hand side; both fists are raised in front of her chest, a steady, heavy, unafraid look, the brows low.

月银纪史诗|ge8_rolf.why: 石匠，凿子不打仗，只护他的工台，照不打仗的路子不披甲：皮围裙的铁钉上打着小符文，凿刃亮着刚刻完一个万年不磨的字的光，应着不磨之铭。
月银纪史诗|ge8_rolf.battle: Not a fighter, ready to defend his bench: the leather apron cinched tight, its iron studs struck with small dwarven runes that glow a faint stone-white, the seven chisels standing in the apron pocket, leather forearm guards, iron-capped boots. He grips a heavy mason's hammer in his right hand and a short iron chisel in his left, held low in front of him, the chisel's edge glowing pale as if it had just cut a letter that will never wear away; a stubborn scowling look.

月银纪史诗|ge8_heros.why: 九十七岁的瞎眼歌手，不打仗，第三格是赶路的姿势句，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge8_heros.battle: Not a fighter: a heavy dark-blue travelling cloak over the washed-out robe, a walking staff of pale ash wood in the right hand, the lyre on a strap across his back, the pouch of stones at the belt. He walks with the head raised toward a distant sound, a grave, unafraid look.

月银纪史诗|ge8_enfus.why: 极境本是三档，奥斯温的外甥、长厅之嘴，王族加一档：量身的黑漆硬皮甲带黑铁边，三个臂环封着曜核的光，招牌是投枪上那一圈岭风（穿云之臂）；家传剑是寻常好剑，不发光。
月银纪史诗|ge8_enfus.battle: Ready to throw, in long-hall war gear made for the best spearman of the grey hills: a fitted cuirass of black-lacquered hardened leather over the deep-blue tunic, edged in black iron, the black iron mountain clasp at the collar, matching pauldrons and bracers; the three twisted arm rings on his right upper arm (on the viewer's left when they face us) each holding a faint core-light; a round linden shield faced with boiled leather, rimmed in black iron and painted with a mountain, on the left arm. In his right hand a long ash-wood javelin drawn back over the shoulder, its beast-fang head wrapped in a thin pale spiral of highland wind, two more javelins held in a bundle in the shield hand, the plain family sword sheathed at the left hip; a hard, scornful look.

月银纪史诗|ge8_nif.why: 替家里还情的小歌手，不打仗不拿兵器，未成年，第三格是赶路的姿势句，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge8_nif.battle: On the road in bad weather: a heavy grey wool travelling cloak with the hood up over the linen dress, the vest with the golden wheat ear on the back under it, leather gloves, laced boots, a walking stick in the right hand. A resolute, steady look, the brows drawn a little together, the mouth closed.

月银纪史诗|ge8_oswald.why: 原页没写位阶，按一代斩一头的冠估极境；七十六岁的老王不上阵，第三格是拄杖的姿势句，照原句交回。
月银纪史诗|ge8_oswald.battle: He does not take the field: a heavy dark-blue wool cloak over the over-robe, fastened with the black iron clasp, the circlet on his head, a plain straight staff of grey ash in the right hand with the iron-shod end on the ground, no weapon at his belt. A steady, heavy look.

月银纪史诗|ge9_tirian.why: 英雄，守望者不穿铁，四档的东西是长出来的：随季节变色的林色衣加一层倒树皮做的叶形轻甲片，不加装饰；日轮之弦在弓臂里渗着金红的日光，姿势照原句，弦松、不搭箭。
月银纪史诗|ge9_tirian.battle: Waiting at the line, in the Watcher clan's war garb grown for him rather than forged: the hooded tunic and long cloak of living forest weave, turned the brown of dead leaves for this season, the cloak pinned back from the shoulders; over the chest and shoulders light overlapping leaf-shaped plates of smooth fallen bark, with no ornament; the left bracer on; the long bow carved from a fallen tree of his own forest held upright in the left hand with the string slack and NO arrow nocked, a faint gold-red sunlight seeping into its limbs; the quiver at the right hip holding his only arrow; feet planted a shoulder width apart as if nailed to the ground; a cold, fixed look.

月银纪史诗|ge9_lien.why: 灵格，树山村的木精灵，家境中常，二档；她在林冠上跑跳，不穿重的，只把皮背心换成藤蟒鳞的（★），藤护腕上的活叶子朝着风，手边绕着看得见的风线（风之瞳）。
月银纪史诗|ge9_lien.battle: Ready to scout and strike from the branches, in light gear for the canopy: a close-fitted jerkin of supple vine-serpent scale tinted leaf green over the green tunic; woven vine bracers with a few living leaves that turn toward the wind; soft climbing shoes; a short hunting knife at the right hip and the coil of cord with the bronze bell hanging at the left hip. She holds the bell cord ready in her right hand, a few thin pale-green threads of visible wind curling round her free hand, a keen, alert look.

月银纪史诗|ge9_dora.why: 共鸣的皮货商，不是兵，一档：买卖人身上只多一件自己摊上的好皮子，一领焰鬃狼皮短披肩（★），银叶秤照旧挂在腰上。
月银纪史诗|ge9_dora.battle: On the road with a heavy load, in a trader's clothes and one good hide off her own stall: the deer-hide waistcoat buckled over a leather jerkin, a short shoulder cape of red fire-mane wolf fur thrown over it, a few sparks glinting in the fur; leather gloves, a short skinning knife at the right hip, the small balance with its glinting silver-leaf pans at the left hip, the bundle of hides strapped tight on her back. She holds the knife low in her right hand, a quick, calculating look.

月银纪史诗|ge9_aurel.why: 英雄、守了两千年的王庭长望，不爱靠装备，林色长衣补丁比衣裳多也不换；四档落在东西的成色上：金线补丁泛着护身的光，精灵藤纹护臂，月银箭镞燃着冷白的光。
月银纪史诗|ge9_aurel.battle: Keeping watch at the line, in no armour but the long-watcher's old robe: the patched forest robe pinned back, its dense gold-thread patches glinting with a faint warm light as if each mend were a ward; a long dark leather bracer on the left arm worked with fine elven vine tracery that glows soft green; a quiver of arrows with pale-silver heads burning with a cold white light at the hip on the right hand side, the long bow of a fallen tree held upright in the left hand, the string slack. He stands completely still, a long, calm, attentive look.

纷争纪|z1_tobias.why: 下城面包师，启源又是穷街，第三格走 battle_pose（撑着烧黑的长柄铲守炉口），原句里祖父的帝国旧呢外套、锅盖护肩正是灰的年月一档的样子，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_tobias.battle: Ready to hold the oven door: his grandfather's empire-wool overcoat gone grey with ash, belted over the apron, a battered pot-lid strapped over one shoulder as a pauldron, thick leather gloves. He grips the long burnt bread peel in both hands across his body like a quarterstaff, a rune scratched on its blade glowing ember-red; the clay jar hangs at his chest. A fierce, stubborn look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z1_rosvita.why: 未成年的铸灯匠女儿，手艺人家，铸灯术不管打仗，档往低里判；只添母亲那件帝国旧呢外套袖口暗掉的骸银线和她自己的铜焰，衣裳照旧是干活的那一身。
纷争纪|z1_rosvita.battle: Standing guard over the workshop: the long leather apron cinched and hitched up, her mother's old empire-wool coat cut short at the hem and fastened with lacing, grey with ash, its cuffs still edged with a line of bone-silver thread gone dull grey; thick lamp-caster's leather gloves, heavy boots. She holds the copper hammer low in her right hand and the brass lamp against her chest with her left, a small copper-yellow flame standing on its bare wick with no oil, a thread of green verdigris light flickering inside the lamp. A determined look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z1_zvia_a.why: 环山脚下夜医家的孙女，未成年，送终的人不拿兵器，第三格走 battle_pose（挡在将死的人和黑之间），兜帽还压着角，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_zvia_a.battle: Standing between the dying and the dark: the dark cloak closed at the throat with the hood pulled up over her head, the horns pressing the cloth into two low peaks beneath it, the pouch at her belt, boots. Her left hand holds the burnt candle stub forward at chest height with a small white flame on it, and her right hand is raised palm out with pale warding marks glowing faintly. A serious, unafraid look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z1_zvia_b.rank: 英雄（40年前后起三句誓时）
纷争纪|z1_zvia_b.why: 起誓那年已是英雄、领着头一批有名者，英雄不看家境定四档；她是夜医，照医者的路子不穿甲，用一件刻护符的软皮背心、骨片护臂和露出来的角火撑起这一档，兜帽割掉照灰的年月有名者的样子。
纷争纪|z1_zvia_b.battle: At the front of the named ones: the long dark cloak washed grey and closed at the throat, its hood cut away so both horns stand bare, the dim red flame on them burning high; over the plain dark dress a fitted healer's vest of soft black leather stitched all over with pale warding script that glows faint white, bracers of carved bone plates bearing the same marks over the sleeves, the burnt white candle stub lit at her neck, the worn pouch with the bone needle at her belt, soft boots. She grips the tall white staff upright in both hands before her, its small bone bell still and glowing faintly; a fierce, unafraid look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z1_felix.pref: 不打仗（落塔以后不再画环）
纷争纪|z1_felix.why: 塔林学徒，下城修灯人家出身，落塔那夜以后没再画过一道环，第三格走 battle_pose（张开两臂护着身后的人），灰袍、旧斗篷就是他，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_felix.battle: On the road with the survivors: the cloak fastened at the throat, the grey robe belted, boots, the box strapped on his back. He holds no weapon; both arms are spread to shepherd people behind him, counting heads under his breath.

纷争纪|z1_joachim.why: 七代守书库的人，不拿兵器，第三格走 battle_pose（一臂横在门口当闩），袖套长袍照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_joachim.battle: Guarding the library door: the grey robe belted tight, the sleeve guards on, the seven keys held in one fist. He holds no weapon; his other arm is spread across the doorway as a bar, a thin, resolute look.

纷争纪|z1_lothar.why: 苇岸小骑士家长子，灵格定二档，伯爵家养的兵穿得最齐，他这一副是帝国旧骑士甲改合身的，刮了纹，骸银线暗了，只喉甲上一枚曜核还亮，正合灰的年月一件会亮的东西。
纷争纪|z1_lothar.battle: Holding the gate, in his house's old imperial knight harness refitted to him: the dull half-plate fully buckled, its chest scraped smooth where the reed-leaf crest was, the bone-silver inlay along every plate seam gone dull grey, one old luminous core still set in the steel gorget and shining a cold white; matching old steel pauldrons and an arm guard on each forearm, plain and rubbed dark; the thick deep-blue wool cloak over one shoulder. He grips the plain knight's longsword with both hands, point down before him like a barrier, the leather-wrapped grip worn bright. A hard, level look.

纷争纪|z1_ottilie.why: 星湖渔家的女儿、贝洛尼卡的学生，不拿兵器，第三格走 battle_pose（把老师的石板当盾抱在胸前），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_ottilie.battle: On the road with the slate: the short black robe belted tight, leather gloves, boots. She holds the oilcloth-wrapped slate in front of her chest like a shield with both hands and no weapon; a firm, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z1_sefer.why: 第一个冲阵的有名者，英雄不看家境定四档；灰的年月魔族还没有系、也不造甲，照营里打的黑铁护臂护胫、骨片和起誓的刻痕往上加，光膀子披熊皮、烧弯的铁栅条照旧是他。
纷争纪|z1_sefer.battle: At the very front of the charge: bare-chested under the bear pelt thrown back, its two front paws knotted across his chest; heavy black-iron vambraces and greaves hammered for him in the named ones' camp, lashed with bone plates and cut with rough oath marks that glow ember-orange; a broad war belt riveted with iron, the patched old flask and the tiny child's glove tucked behind it. He grips the bent iron grate bar in both hands, raised across his body, the iron glowing red-hot under his grip, the orange flames on his ram horns roaring higher and white steam rising off his skin; a savage, unwavering look.

纷争纪|z1_snorri.why: 霜渡摆渡人，谁都收一样的钱，不替哪一边打，第三格走 battle_pose（压低身子拿撑篙听冰），油浸羊皮外套就是北边这些年的样子，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_snorri.battle: Crossing the ice at night: the sheepskin coat buckled tight, a scarf over the nose, the nailed boots. He taps the ice ahead with the iron-capped staff held in both hands, braced low; a patient, unshakable look. The scarf covers only the nose and mouth; both ears are uncovered, and the ear on the viewer's right is the clipped stub ending flat at eyebrow height, plainly shorter than the whole ear on the viewer's left.

纷争纪|z1_feige.why: 雪线外的老王，传奇顶上的那一档，可他九千年不对人拔剑，霜象皮旧王袍和背上的牙剑就是他的战装，第三格走 battle_pose（手按剑柄、一掌推人），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_feige.battle: Standing his ground on the ice: the robe tied back, a leather belt cinched, the huge sword still sheathed on his back, a hand resting on its hilt behind his shoulder. He plants his feet and holds out one open palm to push back whoever charges; a stern, unmoving look.

纷争纪|z1_helmut.rank: 极境（只给 AI，年轻时披过甲）
纷争纪|z1_helmut.why: 帝国封的第五代伯爵，极境加世家本该三档往上，可他如今只念判词不上阵，第三格走 battle_pose（戴白手套念纸），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_helmut.battle: He is no soldier: the dark coat buttoned to the throat, a plain black cloak, the white gloves, a plain dress sword in its scabbard hanging unused at his hip. He holds the folded sheet before him in both hands, reading from it; a rigid, frightened but composed look.

纷争纪|z1_clemens.why: 旗官的儿子守了四十年河谷做了白鸢头一个王，估灵格；身上是军团旧胸甲罩旧军官外套，正合灰的年月帝国剩下的那一身，第三格走 battle_pose（立父亲的旗、拿名册），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_clemens.battle: At the head of his valley men: an old legion breastplate rubbed dull over the coat, a grey cloak, a plain longsword in its scabbard at the left hip. He plants his father's banner pole upright in his right hand and keeps the roster in his left; an unhurried, firm look.

纷争纪|z1_agate.why: 粮官的孙女做了金穗头一个女王，管粮不上阵，第三格走 battle_pose（举钥匙守仓门），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1_agate.battle: Protecting the granary doors: the apron tied tight, the shawl pinned, stout boots. She holds the ring of keys raised in one fist and the tally board clamped under the other arm, planted wide in front of the doors; a stubborn, unafraid look.

纷争纪|z1r_reinhold.why: 穹都下城卫队统领，极境定三档，一身成套的帝国卫队旧战装，骸银线暗了、胸口一枚曜核还亮，招牌是荫篱家那杆界灯，正合灰的年月头领的样子。
纷争纪|z1r_reinhold.battle: Drawing the line, in the full old harness of the fallen capital's lower-city guard: the darkened steel half-breastplate buckled tight over the long navy gambeson coat, its seams traced with bone-silver thread gone dull grey and one old luminous core set at the breastbone still shining a cold white; a matching steel gorget, darkened steel pauldrons and vambraces; the white-edged guard cape thrown back off the right shoulder. He grips the man-tall brass lamp pole in both hands and drives its butt down at an angle, the family boundary lamp at its head flaring a hard white, a short tongue of white flame licking from the pole's butt. Feet planted wide, a cold, immovable look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z1r_kilian.why: 苇岸圣所的判词司祭，提照角灯照人的角，不拿兵器，第三格走 battle_pose（举灯照脸），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z1r_kilian.battle: He is no fighter: the ash-grey robe belted tight, a dark hooded travelling cloak over it with the hood down, worn boots, the oil flask at the belt. He holds the long hazel pole forward in both hands, the lamp under its old brass shade glowing a cold pale white at the far end, raised to light someone's face. A still, searching look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z2_nolen.why: 开国皇帝、Unique 的应许之晓，定这一纪开头顶上那一档；样子照参考图不改，白石的年月没有成批附魔甲，光加在錾满的晨光纹和破晓上，是身后信明年的人添的光。
纷争纪|z2_nolen.battle: In the field: the full suit of bright mirror-polished silver plate exactly as in the reference pictures, the fine flowing script and sunrise rays engraved all over it now glowing dawn-gold along every groove, the lion-head helm with the visor down and no crown on top, the great pale gold mane spilling over the shoulders, the deep-blue arming cloth at the joints, the great white fur-collared cloak streaming back. The great white-gold sword Dawn is drawn and held two-handed point-up in front of him, the broad straight blade clean and bright and lit along its whole length by a rising dawn-gold light, the feet planted wide, the mane and the fur collar stirring; a thin line of green through the visor slit.

纷争纪|z2_nolen_bare.why: 同一个人，档跟着甲那一身走，可这一张要的就是卸了甲的样子，不硬穿甲，只让胸前的晨光纹和破晓带上那一层晨光。
纷争纪|z2_nolen_bare.battle: Caught without the plate: the deep-blue wool arming coat belted tight, the gold sunrise ray stitched on its breast catching a real glint of dawn light, leather bracers and gloves, the white half-cloak thrown back, the great two-handed sword Dawn, white-gold, broad and straight and longer than she is tall, exactly as in the armoured reference picture, held two-handed point-up in front of her with the tip rising well above her head and a dawn-gold light rising along the blade, the feet planted wide, the bun tight; her whole bearing is the emperor's, only without the armour.

纷争纪|z2_knut.why: 烧炭人家的枪兵，共鸣又穷，定一档；白石的年月还没有附魔甲，只添一块白冠城库里领的铁护肩，胸口缝的晨光纹和自己磨的枪头带上誓与信的那一点光。
纷争纪|z2_knut.battle: In the spear line: the worn jerkin with the elbows rubbed through and the dawn crest stitched on the chest, its gold thread catching a real glint of dawn light, a dawn-gold cloth band on the upper arm, leather bracers, a single plain iron shoulder plate from the White Crown armoury strapped on the left, a plain open-faced iron cap with a sunrise painted on the brow. He levels the long spear in both hands, braced low at his hip, the small sunrise rune etched on his self-ground spearhead glowing dawn-gold with the faith of the line behind him, feet planted wide. A frightened but stubborn look, the jaw clenched.

纷争纪|z2_lutz.why: 铁匠收养的旗手，共鸣又穷，定一档；皮围裙改的胸甲是他自己钉的，只让铁片上的晨光印和旗上的金色晨光带上光，旗杆、枪尖一样不换。
纷争纪|z2_lutz.battle: Carrying the banner into the line: the chest piece made from a smith's leather apron, studded with iron plates he hammered himself, each plate stamped with a small sunrise that catches real light; leather bracers, a plain iron cap, the small smith's hammer at the belt. The white banner with its single gold sunrise is unfurled and held high in both hands on its seven-times-oiled ash pole, the gold sunrise on the cloth glowing faintly like first light, the iron spearhead at the top gleaming; the feet planted wide against the wind; a fierce, unwavering upward look.

纷争纪|z2_hartmut.why: 种麦人家出来的副官，可到了极境家境只差一截，又是皇帝身边的人，定三档：成套的锁甲加胸甲肩甲，新錾的晨光纹照得出真光，招牌是那面晨光快磨平的圆盾和女儿缝柄的短剑。
纷争纪|z2_hartmut.battle: Holding the door, in the emperor's adjutant's field harness: a shirt of fine riveted mail under a fitted steel breastplate and tassets worn over the dark coat, the dawn crest freshly chiselled on the breast and catching real light, steel pauldrons and vambraces, a plain open-faced iron helm on his head. The round shield braced in front at a slant has a faded sunrise whose paint shines with a real dawn-gold light, its rim newly bound in iron, and the short sword is drawn low behind it, his daughter's stitched leather on the hilt in his fist. An unblinking, immovable look.

纷争纪|z2_gulen.why: 符文一支的矮人工兵，极境定三档，矮人打的锁甲、刻符的铁护臂成套，招牌是山铜包锋的符铲，铲锋落下去字先亮，正是白石的年月诸族手艺里的魔法。
纷争纪|z2_gulen.battle: On the wall: the rune-chiselled leather apron with its row of small chisels worn over a close dwarf-forged mail shirt, rune-cut iron bracers whose marks glow a warm forge-orange, a plain iron cap with a single rune on the brow. He drives the rune shovel down before him with one hand, its orichalcum-edged blade lit where the chiselled runes flare as it strikes, while the other hand grips the notched mason's hammer raised; his feet planted wide, the stone-blue eyes narrowed; a stubborn, immovable look.

纷争纪|z2_togri.why: 跟古伦同一支、同一档，围裙补过三回照旧，加矮人锁甲和刻符护臂，胸前那块刻名石边角料带一点光，这一格是放闸，手里照旧是绞绳。
纷争纪|z2_togri.battle: At the gate winch: the rune-chiselled leather apron mended in three places over a close dwarf-forged mail shirt, rune-cut iron bracers glowing a warm forge-orange at the marks, an iron cap, the rune shovel on his back, the small slate of name marks at his chest lit faintly as if the names were being read aloud. Both hands haul hard on a thick winch rope, the body leaning back, the feet braced wide; a strained, determined look, the copper eyes fixed on the hands.

纷争纪|z2_tansy.why: 长辙家的头车车夫，灵格定二档，铃尾商路人家不穷不富；在缀铃短外套下头加一件改合身的厚皮衬甲，会亮的是存着青风的车铃和腕上铜光的线，鞭子、缰绳不换。
纷争纪|z2_tansy.battle: Holding the lead wagon: the short leather jacket hemmed with its ring of small brass bells buckled over a fitted padded leather jack, the bells glowing a faint wind-blue where the stored gale stirs in them, leather bracers stitched with a thin copper thread that shines like her wheel-tracks, a plain iron cap strapped under the chin, the tin scroll tube on her back. The driving whip is coiled in one fist and the other hand grips the reins, the body braced low; a determined, shrewd look.

纷争纪|z2_fenton.why: 满仓家家长，家里不穷，可他一辈子不跟人动手，第三格走 battle_pose（扛着封好的小酒桶上路），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z2_fenton.battle: On the road with the wagons: a waxed travelling cloak over the apron, a wide felt hat, cloth gaiters and sturdy boots, the ring of cellar keys at the belt and the brass spoon in the pocket; he fights no one and carries no weapon; instead he shoulders a small sealed cask, both hands holding it, the knees braced, a firm, steady look.

纷争纪|z2_uglas.rank: 极境（LVL 96），这一格是蹚开毒沼那一下到英雄
纷争纪|z2_uglas.why: 木匠家的儿子，极境定三档，穷只到极境差一截；胸口空着不带纹是生角者那时的样子，偏好朴素，只加过沼用的铁护胫和肩上的铁片，招牌是自己画歪的晨光木盾和刻着祖父名字的铁刀，角上无火。
纷争纪|z2_uglas.battle: Leading through a bog: the old plain leather armour buckled, its chest left bare of any crest, now reinforced with dark iron plates at the shoulders and a long pair of iron greaves for the mire, leather bracers, strips of marsh reed bound round the boots; the wooden shield with the crooked dawn ray in fresh paint raised on his left arm, the ray catching a real glint of light. The iron sword is drawn in his right hand and pointed forward, the small marks on its spine warming with a dull heat shimmer. Feet planted wide, the horns unlit, a steady, forward look, the yellow eyes level.

纷争纪|z2_igvar.why: 铜鳞氏的龙裔战士，极境定三档，天脊氏族的鳞纹皮甲加龙骨护片成套，招牌是龙骨大盾和鳞下之火烧红的刀。
纷争纪|z2_igvar.battle: Holding the pass: the Skyridge scale-pattern leather armour buckled, its chest chiselled with a standing scale-stone that glows dull bronze, plates of dragon bone added over the shoulders and thighs, leather bracers over the scaled forearms; the great round dragon-bone shield on the left arm raised in front of him, the iron sword drawn low behind it in the right hand with a dark red fire running along the blade from the heat kept under his scales, the bronze scales at his jaw glowing at their edges; feet planted wide, a low glow in the amber eyes; a calm, immovable look.

纷争纪|z2_hanno.why: 副官的外孙、黑石重骑，极境定三档，成套的掺银末重骑甲，照他那一门的写法人披铜皮，招牌是骑枪和父亲削柄的长剑。
纷争纪|z2_hanno.battle: In the charge: the black-stone heavy cavalry plate worn over a layer of copper-sheathed hide, its scales mixed with pale silver dust that flashes cold along every plate edge as he moves, matching gauntlets and articulated greaves, a closed helm with the visor up; the cavalry lance levelled in the right hand at a slant forward, a short pennon snapping at its head, the long sword with the hilt his father carved at the hip; leaning in as if mounted, the legs braced wide; a hard, ready look.

纷争纪|z2_reinhold.why: 白鸢骑士家长子，极境本是三档，世家到了极境还能往上一档，定四档：照他身量打的黑石重骑甲，胸口深錾白鸢、线里出白光，枪尖那一线白光是他的白鸢光枪。
纷争纪|z2_reinhold.battle: At the head of the charge, in the White Kite house's war harness made to his measure: the black-stone heavy plate with its pale silver dust flashing cold, the breastplate engraved deep with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, whose lines shine a clean white, fluted pauldrons and fully articulated arms and greaves, a white half-cloak at the shoulders, a closed helm with the visor up. The lance is levelled forward at a slant in the right hand, its tip lit with a hard white light, the long sword at the hip, the body leaning in as if on horseback, the legs braced wide; a hard, exact look.

纷争纪|z2_gaz.pref: 照常（身上不挂会响的东西）
纷争纪|z2_gaz.why: 南边驻地生的影魔斥候，灵格定二档，穷可跟着有名者；灰黑紧身短皮甲外头加一副漆哑了不响的骨片软甲和刻影文的骨护臂，会亮的是刀刃和角尖那一点紫火。
纷争纪|z2_gaz.battle: In the dark: the short soot-grey leather jacket buckled tight with its cuffs and hem bound close, over it a fitted harness of thin black bone plates lacquered dull so they never click, bone bracers carved with faint violet shadow script, a dark scarf over the lower face pulled down, nothing hanging that could rattle.
