Both short knives are drawn and held low, the plain one forward and the bone one back, a dark violet sheen along both edges, the tiny violet flames on his horn tips burning; the body crouched and ready, the shadow stretching long behind him; a sharp, silent look.

纷争纪|z2_helana.why: 徒手走出逆鳞谷的传奇，档在顶上，可她从不带兵器，不硬穿甲，只添一副她自己打的不刻字的护臂（铁匠家的女儿，★），光在颈后的鳞、拳头和那片无纹龙鳞上。
纷争纪|z2_helana.battle: Holding the gate: the sleeveless leather vest buckled tight over the linen shirt, plain trousers and boots; she carries no weapon and wants none, only a pair of plain dark iron bracers she forged herself, unmarked, over the bare forearms. Her bare fists are raised in a plain guard, the few scales at the back of her neck lit a faint amber and a pale heat haze rising off her knuckles; the feet planted wide and the body braced low, the thin unmarked scale swinging at her neck and catching the light; a fierce, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z2_kargo.rank: 传奇·天灾（181年认皇帝以后）
纷争纪|z2_kargo.why: 鳞誓之祖，天灾的传奇，可他只是看脚的守石人，不当族长不披甲，照朴素的路子留长袍和扫雪的帚，光在剩下的暗青鳞和龙骨短刀上。
纷争纪|z2_kargo.battle: At the pass: the clan's long grey-brown robe with the cuffs worn through and the sleeves tied back, a plain leather belt, leather bracers over the forearms where the sparse dark blue-green scales are left bare, each remaining scale edged with a cold blue-green light; he wears no armour. The short dragon-bone knife is drawn low in his right hand with a faint glow running along the bone, and the long broom handle is held crossways in the left like a staff; the feet planted wide; a calm, immovable look.

纷争纪|z2_halga.pref: 朴素（锻师，自己打的不加装饰）
纷争纪|z2_halga.why: 独桥上没让开的矮人锻师，传奇顶档；他身上全是自己打的东西，样子朴素不加花，烧穿小洞的围裙和铜丝缝的左靴照旧，光是盾上、锤上锻接火候那样的符文。
纷争纪|z2_halga.battle: On the bridge: the thick burnt leather apron over a mail shirt of his own forging, its rings dark and close, plain smith-made vambraces and an iron cap with no ornament, the left boot's crack stitched with copper wire; a tall round shield of his own making on the left arm planted in front of him, its rim and face cut with deep rune lines glowing forge-orange like iron at welding heat; the big two-handed war hammer gripped in the right hand raised, its head glowing with the same forge heat; feet planted wide; an immovable, grim look.

纷争纪|z2_brunta.pref: 不靠装备（人形里扛石头，不带兵器）
纷争纪|z2_brunta.why: 黄岩一支的小真龙化成扛石的人，英雄定四档，可她不带兵器、不用背架，本事在龙骨和浮上来的鳞，原句垫肩皮坎肩、浮鳞和赤雷已经是她这一档的样子，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z2_brunta.battle: Holding the line in human form: the padded leather jerkin buckled tight over the linen shirt, heavy leather bracers on both forearms, the hemp rope wound round both fists; she has no weapon. Pale stone-white scales surface along both forearms, at the back of her neck and on both cheekbones, a faint red crackle of lightning glowing in the seams of the scales, her amber eyes narrowed to vertical slits. She stands braced low with both open hands raised to shoulder height, palms up, as if bearing a great falling weight, feet planted wide; nothing in her hands. A grim, immovable look.

纷争纪|z2r_irase.pref: 法师式（本事是放夜，不靠甲）
纷争纪|z2r_irase.why: 苔阶城来的夜魔有名者，英雄定四档；她的本事是把正午拉成夜，不披重甲，照白石的年月魔族那一边加一件吸光的黑曜细鳞紧身胸衣和黑曜护臂，灰黑斗篷、雪白里子、黑丝绒领带照旧。
纷争纪|z2r_irase.battle: Bringing night down over a city at noon: the charcoal cloak flung wide behind her like a curtain, its snow-white lining showing, the black velvet collar-band fastened high; over the close black dress a fitted bodice of thin black obsidian scales that drinks the light, slim black obsidian vambraces, black boots. Both arms are spread out to either side, palms down, and ribbons of thick black darkness pour upward from the hem of her cloak and wind close around her body; the black flames on her horn tips burn tall, and her silver-white slit eyes shine. A calm, cold, overwhelming look.

纷争纪|z2r_radovan.why: 喂乌鸦人家的儿子，英雄不看家境定四档；原句的整副骨铠已近这一档，再在骨片上刻他的誓文发暗红的光、心口嵌一块黑曜，背闩、角上的鸦羽和矮火照旧。
纷争纪|z2r_radovan.battle: Storming the west gate: full bone armour of heavy pale plates fitted over dark leather, each plate carved with the words of his oath in script that glows a dull ember red, bone pauldrons and greaves, a plate of black obsidian set over the heart, raven feathers bound on the horn roots, the dark-red flames on his horns burning low and steady. He grips the iron-banded oak door bar in both hands like a battering ram, its head forward, the eight notches across it glowing ember red. Leaning in, feet driving, a fixed, unstoppable look.

纷争纪|z2r_vosha.pref: 朴素（冰原的驯鹿皮，敞着怀不怕冷）
纷争纪|z2r_vosha.why: 北边冰原的炎角有名者，英雄定四档；她照冰原的样子穿驯鹿皮、敞着怀，偏好朴素，只在皮护臂、护胫上缀黑曜鳞片，火从鳞缝里透出来，手里照旧没有兵器。
纷争纪|z2r_vosha.battle: Sinking fire into the ground: the short reindeer-hide robe belted tight with a broad braided-hide belt over the dark hide undershirt, open at the throat as always; hide bracers and shin guards plated with small black obsidian scales, the fur-trimmed trousers and tall hide boots. She stands braced with her right hand thrust down and open, a dull red heat glowing up her forearm and through the gaps between the obsidian scales, the soles and toes of her boots glowing red-hot; the flames on her horns pressed low and dark red. A hard, patient, burning look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z3_georg.why: 341年极境定3，采石村人家出身降一档；那时还没有成批的附魔铠甲，身上是一副补了四十年的硬皮甲加一块向矮人换来的符文板，箭头的符文照留。
纷争纪|z3_georg.battle: Holding the breach, in forty years of patched wall gear: the dust-whitened quarryman's apron belted tight over a heavy hide brigandine riveted with small iron plates, its chest plate a dwarf-cut rune plate traded from the wall's rune-smiths whose chiselled lines glow a dull steady white; a single old iron pauldron on the left shoulder; thick leather bracers pressed with a god's name; the quiver at his hip and a stone chisel stuck in the apron pocket. He draws the hardwood longbow with his thumb pressed on the arrow nock like gripping a chisel, the arrowhead etched with a tiny rune that glows. Feet planted wide, a hard narrowed look.

纷争纪|z3_lenate.why: 共鸣、未成年、墙后人家，只在父亲改小的皮甲上缝一块刻神名的薄铁片；341年还没有成批的附魔件，原句的附魔铁板改成祝福铁片，别的照原句。
纷争纪|z3_lenate.battle: Handing arrows on the stairs: the resized leather jerkin laced to the collar with a thin iron plate stamped with a god's name sewn across the chest, the letters glowing faintly white, ward thread stitched along its edge, leather bracers, a long bundle of arrows in the crook of one arm, a quiver at her side, the light shortbow on her back. She braces with the feet apart, holding one arrow out toward the viewer, its head etched with a tiny glowing rune. A fierce, steady look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z3_gaz.why: 英雄定4，不看家境；影魔斥候不挂会响的东西，所以好东西都做在贴身的影皮甲和刀上，不加甲片。
纷争纪|z3_gaz.battle: Slipping into the enemy line along a shadow, in a shadow-walker's fitted war leathers: a close grey-black jerkin of layered soft hide moulded to the body, with no buckle or ring that could rattle, its seams stitched in dusky-purple thread that glows faintly and seems to drink the light; matching soft vambraces and greaves bound with cord; a dark hood pulled up, the small purple horn flames showing through slits in it; a short knife in each hand held low and reversed, the blades smoked black with a thin purple edge-light; the plain bone knife at the belt, the long leather case on his back. Crouched on the balls of his feet, a thread of shadow trailing half a step behind him, a sharp, silent look.

纷争纪|z3_fridolin.rank: 共鸣→灵格（这一格是塌口那一夜，到灵格 LVL 42）
纷争纪|z3_fridolin.why: 画的是700年塌口那一夜刚到灵格，凿石人家又是未成年，降到1档；借来的段库旧皮甲加一块自己刻了神名、抹了祝灰的铁片，正是他的手艺。
纷争纪|z3_fridolin.battle: Crouched in the collapsed pit, in borrowed wall gear: the canvas smock belted tight over an old garrison leather jerkin lent from the section stores, one small iron plate laced over the heart with a god's name chiselled into it by his own hand, the letters filled with blessed lime that glows pale white; leather bracers; the chisel roll at his belt. He grips the borrowed bow in both hands with an arrow nocked and not drawn, its head marked with a smear of the same glowing lime. Eyes narrowed at the dark ahead, a nervous but steady look.

纷争纪|z3_ingeborg.why: 极境定3，斯滕家是墙后守口子的人家，降一档；700年还是传家皮甲，右肩那块垫一块矮人符文板，弓和凿子都是家传的。
纷争纪|z3_ingeborg.battle: At the breach, in the Sten family's old wall gear: the re-stitched leather jerkin she wore when young, reinforced with rows of small riveted iron plates, a dwarf-cut rune plate strapped over the lower right shoulder whose rune lines glow a steady white; thick leather bracers; a quiver and Georg's old stone chisel at her belt. She draws the hardwood Sten longbow, tiny bone tally beads swinging from its limb, her thumb pressed on the nock, the lower shoulder braced, a faint rune glowing on the bowstring and a god's name burned into the grip glowing warm. A fierce narrowed look.

纷争纪|z3_gerbert.why: 极境顶上，车夫家出身，可四十年墙上自己挣了一身整的，极境以上家境至多一档，这里不减，定3；招牌是那盏不灭的灯，977年还没有附魔铠甲，好东西是刻神名的板和剑。
纷争纪|z3_gerbert.battle: On the wall at the south tower, in a veteran's full wall kit: the white-worn garrison coat belted tight over a fitted brigandine of dark leather and riveted steel plates, a god's name engraved down the breast plate and glowing a soft white; a steel gorget and one heavy pauldron on the lower left shoulder; steel-lined vambraces; the palm-sized slate and engraving chisel in the coat pocket. He holds the short sword drawn and low, its blade inscribed with the same name and carrying a small pale light along the edge, and the brass lamp with its steady oil-less white flame held up in the other hand. A steady, measuring look.

纷争纪|z3_konstanze.why: 共鸣、未成年，守桥骑士家父亲已死，身上是学院发的大一号旧皮甲；977年没有附魔板，原句那一块改成学院祝过的铁胸片，父亲的桥纹盾是招牌。
纷争纪|z3_konstanze.battle: In the shield line: the oversized academy leather jerkin laced to the collar with a small iron chest plate strapped over it, stamped with the academy's blessing whose letters glow faint white, ward lines stitched along its edge, leather bracers. The chipped round shield with the lake-star bridge emblem is held high on the left arm, the emblem glowing a faint lake-blue where her palm presses behind it, and the short sword is drawn in the right, feet planted wide. A fierce, determined look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z3_konstanze_old.rank: 传奇（1020年接盾者那一回到传奇，此前英雄 LVL 186）
纷争纪|z3_konstanze_old.why: 画的是1020年凝名接盾者那一刻，这一纪那时顶上的一身：墙上矮人符文匠给她量身打的湖灰板甲和刻满护文的长盾，父亲的旧圆盾照背。
纷争纪|z3_konstanze_old.battle: Leading the reformed shield line, in the shield-captain's harness the wall's dwarven rune-smiths forged to her measure: fitted lake-grey plate over the battered leather jerkin, every plate etched with star-line runes that glow pale blue-white, the lake-star crest raised on the breastplate, articulated pauldrons and gauntlets, a cord tied round the left wrist over the gauntlet. A tall rune-cut long shield is braced in front, its face lined with glowing ward script, a short sword in the right hand with a god's name burning white along the blade, her father's chipped round bridge shield on her back. Motes of starlight drift off the plate. Feet planted wide, a hard, steady look.

纷争纪|z3_dobson.why: 共鸣的学生，粮车人家，不会打；学院外套加一件发下来的皮背心和小圆盾，计数的结绳带一点光就够。
纷争纪|z3_dobson.battle: In the shield line, uneasy, in academy issue that does not fit: the far-too-long academy coat belted tight with its hem rolled three times, a short issued leather vest laced over it, a small leather cap with an iron rim, the counting-knot cord at his belt whose knots glow a faint amber as he counts. The small round shield with the academy's blessing painted on its face is held up unsteadily on his left arm and a short club in his right, the slate on his back. Braced with big feet planted, a nervous but stubborn look.

纷争纪|z3_izra.why: 共鸣、未成年，小镇木匠家，母亲改小的外套外头一件学院皮背心；招牌是父亲做匣、剑脊刻环的窄剑，环印亮起劈散术式。
纷争纪|z3_izra.battle: Watching from behind the parapet, in her mother's resized jacket and a few academy pieces: the jacket laced to the collar under a plain issued leather vest, leather bracers, the hood back so the small bare wood-coloured horns show. The narrow sword is drawn and held low, the ring pattern engraved along its spine glowing a faint pale gold, ready to split a spell. Crouched low, eyes on a far fire, a still, sharp look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z3_clara.why: 极境定3，盾手家的女儿降一档；举盾者的祭司照殿里的规矩穿短袍跟阵，不披板甲，好东西在祝过的细锁子、绣祷词的罩衣和刻祷词的小圆盾上。
纷争纪|z3_clara.battle: Behind the shield line, in the shrine's battle vestments: the iron-grey robe cut short to the knee and belted over a shirt of fine blessed mail whose rings catch a pale gold light, a short iron-grey tabard over it with the prayer stitched down its front in silver thread; leather bracers; the leather waterskin and roll of prayers at her belt; the small round shield on the right arm with its carved prayer lit by a steady miracle light. The bare, ungloved left palm is raised and glowing, a thin pale-gold shield of light standing before it. Feet planted, a fierce, steady look.

纷争纪|z3_markus.why: 十四岁的学徒，不拿刀，第三格照姿势句举小木盾；不添甲，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z3_markus.battle: Standing at Clara's side: the short acolyte's robe belted tight, the small bare wooden shield gripped in both hands before him. Braced with the feet together, the chin up, he carries no sword, an earnest, unafraid look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z3_anton.why: 共鸣，撑船人家，首列盾手；1020年盾碑那一夏成批的附魔铠甲还没送上墙，身上是盾手皮甲加一块刻神名的胸铁和捡来的长圆盾。
纷争纪|z3_anton.battle: In the front rank, in a shield-bearer's plain wall kit: the leather jerkin laced up with the lake-star crest nailed on the chest, a single iron breast plate strapped over it with the Shield-bearer's name cut into it and glowing faintly, leather bracers and a plain iron cap with a short nasal, his belt empty of any sword. The long oval shield with its deep axe-cut is planted in front and both hands braced behind it, ward lines carved along its rim giving a steady cool light. Feet wide, shoulders squared, a hard, steady look.

纷争纪|z3_tirian.why: 传奇定5，可他是守望者、只用左手教人等，不披金属甲；顶上那一身是精灵长出来的叶鳞衫、活木护臂和落日弓。
纷争纪|z3_tirian.battle: Waiting on the third level behind the wall, in a watcher's war garb grown rather than forged: the long grey-green hooded cloak pinned back, its hem stitched with living leaves that give off a faint green light; a fitted moss-green tunic over a supple shirt of elven leaf-scale, the overlapping pale gold-green plates glowing softly at their edges; a single bracer of living wood set with bone on the left forearm, grown to the arm; a quiver of grey-fletched arrows at the hip whose heads hold a sliver of sunset light. He holds the old longbow with its deep right-hand grip-mark across his body in the left hand, an arrow resting and not drawn, the right arm hanging bare and still at his side. A still, patient, piercing look.

纷争纪|z3_liltie.why: 传奇，可她是药师，第三格照姿势句不拿兵器，不穿甲；只让雪狐皮、颈上的干花蕾和手里的新芽带出偷季节的那一层春光。
纷争纪|z3_liltie.battle: Walking into the poisoned mist, a herbalist who never wears armour: the snow-fox pelt wrapped tight and pinned with a bone pin, its fur tips glittering with fine rime that melts into a faint warm light, a hood of moss-green cloth over the hair, leather gloves, the herb bag on a strap across the chest, the dry flower bud at her neck glowing faintly. In one hand a small bunch of living green shoots is held out in front of her, a soft spring-green light breathing from them and from the hem of her dress and pushing the mist back. Eyes lowered, a still, resolved look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z3_ryan.why: 传奇定5，矿奴出身只会砸东西，样子照他朴素：没纹没饰，好料子藏在皮甲里，镣、灯、缺三道的矿锤是招牌。
纷争纪|z3_ryan.battle: Holding the narrow wall alone, in the plainest gear a legend wears: a sleeveless jerkin of black dwarven-tanned hide over the grey shirt, lined inside with thin plates of dark ore-steel that show only at the edges where faint white-hot rune lines glow, no crest and no ornament; heavy plain steel bracers; the coarse open iron shackle swinging from the left wrist, its broken links glowing dull orange; the small oil lamp hooked on his belt, its flame never low. He swings the worn miner's hammer back in both hands, a crack of white light running through the three notches in its head. Feet planted wide, a fierce, silent look.

纷争纪|z3_gulba.why: 传奇定5，采石人家的半兽人，样子照他朴素；顶上的东西是绑在肩上刻了深符文的河石板和那根顶过山的石杖。
纷争纪|z3_gulba.battle: Bracing under the collapse, in plain gear made to carry mountains: a sleeveless jerkin of thick layered hide reinforced over the shoulders with slabs of grey river-stone bound in bronze wire, each slab cut with a single deep rune that glows a slow amber under the strain; broad bracers of stone and leather; the straw pouch at his belt with the little straw goats. The bent stone staff is planted upright in front of him with both hands gripping it, faint amber runes waking along its curve, the shoulders hunched as if holding up the ceiling. Feet planted, a steady, heavy look.

纷争纪|z3_toka.why: 传奇定5，可他只带一根没接口的麻绳追兽，不拿刀弓不披甲；顶上那一层是雷兽皮的肩披和缰绳上走的电光。
纷争纪|z3_toka.battle: Riding into the storm, a hunter who carries no blade: the sleeveless leather vest laced tight over the rough grey tunic, a mantle of thunder-beast hide across the shoulders with its fur standing on end, the storm-grey hooded cloak whipping back with small blue-white sparks crackling along its hem; leather bracers ringed with bands of storm-dark horn. The long unspliced hemp rope is off the waist and gripped in both hands as reins, held taut before him, faint lightning running along its fibres. Crouched forward, a determined, fearful-but-forward look, no sword and no bow.

纷争纪|z3_faron.why: 传奇定5，有翼魔族的射手，照灯的年月有翼魔族的样子：黑翼、骨、长弓，胸肩添一层黑亮的骨片甲，招牌是那张衬鳞的长弓。
纷争纪|z3_faron.battle: On a ridge at night, in a winged marksman's war harness: the close dark-grey leather jerkin laced up and cut open down the back for the black wings, overlaid across the chest and shoulders with thin plates of black glossy bone carved with faint violet sighting script; a long bracer of overlapping black scales on the left forearm; a quiver of black-fletched, bone-tipped arrows at his hip. The wings half open and low. He draws the long scale-lined bow to full, its limbs glinting water-coloured, the arrow aimed at something unseen far away, a thin line of cold light running along the shaft. Feet planted, a cold, absolutely still look.

纷争纪|z3r_rudah.why: 英雄定4，几万顶帐子的炎角战头；照灯的年月炎角的样子，黑铁加黑曜的胸肩甲，招牌是燃白的双角和结渣的宽背砍刀。
纷争纪|z3r_rudah.battle: At the foot of a wall tower, in a fire-horn war-chief's harness: heavy plates of black obsidian-glazed iron over thick scorched leather strapped across his chest and shoulders, their edges glowing a sullen ember red, iron-studded bracers ringed with obsidian, a broad belt set with ember-bright iron studs, the fur cape torn away, the hair bound tight in its iron ring. Both backswept horns burn a blinding orange-white from root to tip; he grips the slag-crusted broad-backed blade in his right hand, molten light running along its black spine, and leans forward, head lowered to drive the horns in. A savage, set look.

纷争纪|z3r_anello.why: 灵格的牢看守长，家境中等，定2；341年没有附魔铠甲，皮甲外头一副刻神名的铁胸甲和护喉，招牌是祝过的灯和秤。
纷争纪|z3r_anello.battle: On the night of the water gate, in a prison warden's kit: the leather jerkin buckled tight under the grey garrison coat, a riveted iron breast plate over the jerkin with a god's name cut into it glowing faintly white, a steel gorget, leather bracers, the ring of keys and the brass steelyard with its warped shield buckle at the belt. In his left hand he holds up a blessed lamp, an iron-framed lantern with a clear pale white flame, and in his right a plain straight short sword drawn and held low, a thin line of the same pale light along its edge. Feet set wide, a hard, unbending look, the mouth shut.

纷争纪|z3r_gerlach.why: 英雄定4，烬角城头人；700年炎角那一身黑铁加黑曜、刻着族纹的胸肩甲，招牌是黑曜大刃和祖上那只断角。
纷争纪|z3r_gerlach.battle: Leading the molten charge, in a fire-horn head-man's war harness: heavy plates of blackened iron and black obsidian over thick boiled leather across his chest and shoulders, the obsidian cut with old clan marks that glow ember red from within, iron-bound bracers banded with obsidian, the old broken horn at his left hip under his left hand. Both his horns blaze a fierce orange-white, molten orange dripping from the soles of his boots and trailing from his greaves, and in his right hand he grips a great blade of black obsidian whose edge glows like cooling lava. Head lowered, striding forward, a set, heavy, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z3r_dederick.why: 审判官不出手，第三格照姿势句捧名册；剑挂着不用，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z3r_dederick.battle: He is no fighter: the grey tribunal robe buttoned to the throat, a long dark grey wool cloak over it, a plain sheathed short sword hanging unused at his left hip, the rusted key at his throat. He holds the trial roster open in front of him in both hands, reading from it; a cold, steady look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z4a_vera.why: 极境定3，铜舌家的混血炉匠；1192年已有成批附魔甲、还没有炉甲，她穿自己铆的一身附魔鳞甲配矮人肩甲，招牌是裂开的炉心和大锻锤。
纷争纪|z4a_vera.battle: Fighting beside her furnace, in a forge-mistress's war kit she riveted herself: the spark-pocked leather apron over a fitted brigandine of enchanted iron scales, each scale cut with dwarven runes that glow ember red at the seams, riveted vambraces, one heavy dwarf-forged pauldron engraved with a rune line glowing ember red, the smoked mica goggles pushed up on her forehead, the wire-bound split furnace core at her belt with a thin red light leaking through its cracks and a long wrench beside it. She grips a great two-handed forge hammer across her body, its head ringed with copper runes glowing orange, feet planted wide, a hard, grinning look.

纷争纪|z4a_kino.why: 十五岁的学徒，不出手，第三格照姿势句握拨火签守炉；不添甲，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4a_kino.battle: Keeping the furnace through a night of attack: the shortened apron tied tight over his shirt, leather gloves too big for him, the tail wound round his waist. Both hands grip the iron poker upright in front of him.

纷争纪|z4a_sjor.why: 极境定3，炉脉一支的老炉匠；一身自己整锻的山铜胸甲，朴实厚重，符文缝里透红，招牌是锻锤和臂上的火纹。
纷争纪|z4a_sjor.battle: Defending his forge, in a Furnace-Vein smith's war harness: the Furnace-Vein jacket with its furnace crest over a cuirass of seamless forged orichalcum plates, plain and thick, cut with rune lines glowing red at the seams, heavy iron bracers, salamander-hide gloves. He grips the polished forging hammer in one hand low at his side, its head glowing dull red, the other fist closed. He stands planted, the fire veins on his forearms glowing red and a heat shimmer rising off his shoulders, a hard, unmoving look.

纷争纪|z4a_boli.why: 灵格定2，长辙家的军需，家境中等；赶车外套里一件嵌了附魔甲片的棉甲，车鞭带一道他认路的发光车辙。
纷争纪|z4a_boli.battle: Guarding the supply train, in a quartermaster's road kit: the deep-brown driving coat buckled over a padded jerkin set with small enchanted iron plates whose white rune lines glow when struck, leather bracers stamped with the Longrut wheel-rut mark, the bell at his neck, bare feet planted wide. He holds a long carter's whip coiled in one hand, a faint glowing wheel-track of light trailing from its lash, the small scale and fat pouch at his belt, a wary, narrowed look.

纷争纪|z4a_wibuke.why: 共鸣，金穗佃农家的收麦人，干活的衣服外头只捆一块墙上下来的附魔胸片；招牌是祖父那辈打的大镰。
纷争纪|z4a_wibuke.battle: Holding the last row, in reaper's clothes and one piece off the wall: the linen jacket belted tight with the waist band, a salvaged enchanted iron plate strapped over the chest with a faint white rune line along its edge, leather bracers, a short leather apron over the skirt for the legs, boots laced to the knee, the old straw hat on her back. She grips the great scythe two-handed at an angle across her body, the polished heirloom blade catching a warm golden glow along its edge, a fierce, determined look.

纷争纪|z4a_meibao.why: 祭司不出手，第三格照姿势句护伤兵；不披甲，只让袍角绣的麦穗带一层金光。
纷争纪|z4a_meibao.battle: Tending the wounded through the night: the wheat robe tucked up with a cord, the embroidered ring of wheat ears at its hem glowing faintly gold, a plain apron over it, the sleeves rolled, the wooden scythe at her neck, the clay jar at her waist, her left palm open and glowing gold.

纷争纪|z4a_haruk.why: 极境定3，赭岭采石人家降一档；身上是从瓦阵带回来的那一身旧附魔鳞甲，补过、铆过，旧圆盾和开山斧照旧。
纷争纪|z4a_haruk.battle: Holding a road, in the old tile-wall kit he brought home: the quarryman's leather apron over a scale-plated leather coat whose enchanted scales are dented and re-riveted, white rune lines still flaring along them, heavy enchanted forearm guards, the leather knee brace. The old round shield from the tile wall is strapped on his left arm with its two worn bright grooves and a faded rune ring on its face, the long-handled mountain axe raised in the right hand at the shoulder, its pale-honed edge catching a white glint. He plants his feet wide, a hard, level look.

纷争纪|z4a_genevieve.why: 极境定3，白鸢骑士家；狮鹫骑照规矩只护胸肋，好处做在附魔白甲片、银白鸢肩饰上，配短弩和网。
纷争纪|z4a_genevieve.battle: Leading the wing in the air, in a griffon captain's flight harness: the light white-kite leather armour guarding only chest and flanks, faced with thin enchanted white plates whose rune lines glow pale along their edges, the folded white kite emblem in silvered steel on the left shoulder, the white streamer streaming behind, the old flying goggles pulled down with the cracked left lens, her father's mended left glove, the clip-hooks fastened, a short crossbow and a coiled net at the hip. She holds a light ash-wood riding lance upright, its point at the top, a small wind-rune glinting on the head, a fierce, focused look.

纷争纪|z4a_ima.why: 共鸣，城门楼下守门人家的女儿，旗语手的轻皮甲加一小块附魔护心；招牌是魔晶丝的旗。
纷争纪|z4a_ima.battle: Signalling in the air, in a signaller's light issue: the very light leather jerkin laced tight with one small enchanted plate over the heart, its rune line glowing faint white, leather bracers, the clip-hooks fastened, the long flag-tube on her back. She stands in the stirrups snapping one red flag out at arm's length, its crystal-thread weave flashing bright in the wind, the other hand gripping the saddle strap, a sharp, intent look.

纷争纪|z4a_regin.why: 极境定3，蓝鳞氏的龙雷炮手；照规矩两条小臂露鳞，围裙下一件刻符的钢背心、蓝鳞家纹的肩甲，招牌是那门龙雷炮。
纷争纪|z4a_regin.battle: Firing the dragon-thunder gun, in a dragon-thunder gunner's battle dress: the scorched leather apron over a sleeveless vest of riveted rune-cut steel plates whose lines glow red-gold, a heavy steel gorget and one thick pauldron etched with the Bluescale clan mark, both forearms bare so the blue scales show with red lines glowing between them, heavy gloves, the short wings half spread. He stands braced at the breech of a rune-cut iron barrel whose engraved lines crackle with red-gold thunder, one hand on the firing lanyard, eyes wide and fixed on the sky, a hard, level look.

纷争纪|z4a_kuya.why: 共鸣、未成年的信使，跑路不穿甲，短打里一件带风符的附魔薄皮背心，父亲做的软靴带一点青风。
纷争纪|z4a_kuya.battle: Running a dangerous road, in a courier's light kit: the close-cut jacket buttoned to the collar over a thin enchanted leather vest with a faint green wind-rune between the shoulders, leather wrist guards, the trouser legs tied tight, her father's soft boots with a pale green breeze curling off the heels, the satchel strapped across her chest, the copper bell on her tail tip. She runs low and fast with the short knife held back along her forearm, ears flat, a fierce, focused look.

纷争纪|z4a_sigmund.why: 英雄定4，不看家境；做了皇帝也只穿老兵灰外套、不戴冠，战装照档量身打，可不加纹不鎏金，招牌是烧黑纹的长剑和臂上的金缝。
纷争纪|z4a_sigmund.battle: At a breach in the wall, in plain war gear made to his measure and kept without ornament: the grey veteran coat with its patched elbows over a fitted harness of dark enchanted steel, breastplate and pauldrons cut with clean rune lines that glow white when struck, no crest and no gilding, fine rune mail beneath, steel-backed leather gauntlets, the iron lamp hook strapped across his back. He holds the longsword of the southern wall drawn low in his right hand, its blade scored with black burn lines and pale gold light pouring into it from the seams along his forearms and neck, a hard, level look.

纷争纪|z4a_agnes.why: 白烛的老祭司不出手，第三格照姿势句拿绷带和白烛；不披甲，只添颈上一枚亮着的银烛护符、袍角缝着的祷文微光。
纷争纪|z4a_agnes.battle: Tending the wounded in the field: the long white robe of the White Candle tucked up with a cord, its wax-stiffened hem faintly glowing where the prayer is stitched, a grey leather apron over it, the sleeves bound back, the white headcloth, a small silver candle ward on a cord at the throat glowing warm white, the candle bundle, needle packet and whetstone at her belt.

纷争纪|z4b_bess.why: 灵格的老家主，长辙家殷实，可她不是打仗的人，第三格照姿势句举铜锅当盾；只在外套里添一件家里买的嵌附魔片的棉背心，铜锅沿亮一圈铜光。
纷争纪|z4b_bess.battle: Holding her camp kitchen against a rush, a halfling matriarch not a swordswoman: the carter's coat belted tight over a quilted vest set with a few small family-bought enchanted plates whose rune lines glow faint white, the apron on, the sleeves rolled, the bells at her hem tied up so they do not ring, the tin scroll tube on her back. She grips the huge copper pot by its handle in both hands, lifted as a shield in front of her, a ring of warm copper light glowing round its rim, the ladle held up in the right hand like a short club; a fierce, planted stance, jaw set, the mouth firm.

纷争纪|z4b_seraia.why: 极境，可担架手跟着人走、不打仗，照白烛的短袍；只在袍下添一件轻附魔皮背心护肩背，臂上的烛布亮一点光。
纷争纪|z4b_seraia.battle: Carrying a wounded soldier out of a fight, a candle medic not a fighter: the grey-white knee-length robe belted close over a light enchanted leather vest whose white rune lines glow across the shoulders where the pole bears, leather bracers, the white armband with its painted candle shining faintly, the tin box of candle stubs at her hip; the stretcher pole over one shoulder, her other arm bracing the front end low, the body crouched and braced to run. A steady, intent, unafraid look.

纷争纪|z4b_azro.why: 灵格定2，木匠家的蹚路兵降一档；前锋的皮甲只在胸前钉一块附魔铁板，背后不钉，没点过火的角亮淡白光是他的誓。
纷争纪|z4b_azro.battle: Leading a line through a bog under attack, in a path-prober's worn kit: the vanguard leather armour with its single enchanted iron breast plate buckled tight, a faint white rune line along its edge and nothing on the back, leather bracers, mud-caked boots, the rolled leather strip with his family's three lines at the belt, his unlit wood-coloured horns glowing a faint pale white. The iron-capped spear shaft notched with depth marks is held in both hands low and forward testing the ground, one foot half raised, his head turned to the ground ahead, a cautious, intent look.

纷争纪|z4b_brunhild.rank: 灵格→极境（第一炮那一下到极境 LVL 84）
纷争纪|z4b_brunhild.why: 画的是3046年第一炮那一下到极境，炮兵整套随炮发，原句已经够档，只在围裙下补一件护肩的附魔皮甲。
纷争纪|z4b_brunhild.battle: At his great cannon, a magic-crystal cannon and not a gunpowder gun: a squat rune-cut iron and brass barrel on a wheeled carriage, a fist-sized blue-white magic crystal glowing in a caged housing at the breech, rune lines along the barrel lit from within. The leather apron buckled tight over an enchanted leather jerkin with rune-cut steel plates at the shoulders, the ear-flapped cap pulled down, smoked mica goggles, leather gauntlets, a bandolier of engraved copper fuse tags across the chest; one hand on the firing cord, the other braced on the crystal housing, the legs planted wide. A rigid, focused look.

纷争纪|z4b_ein.why: 极境的老符文匠，不是兵，照姿势句举刻刀和小锤；只添一块他自己刻了封字的胸板和帽檐上的符文镜，左手那一段照原句一字不动。
纷争纪|z4b_ein.battle: Not a soldier, working under fire as the rune-smith: the black apron belted close over a breast plate he engraved himself, its sealing script glowing a cold pale blue, a leather skullcap on his head with a small rune lens clipped to its brim, his daughter's shield-clasp on a cord at his neck, a chisel in the right hand whose tip glows white where it bites and a small mallet in the left, the spectacles on his nose. A focused, tense look. The small mallet is in the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the back of the hand toward the viewer: index, middle and ring fingers curl round the handle, and in the place of the little finger there is only a short leather-wrapped stump, half a finger long, sticking out stiffly beside the handle without reaching round it.

纷争纪|z4b_nasta.why: 灵格定2，对炉街铁壶家的炉工；围裙下一件火蜥蜴皮的耐火衣、一对刻冷符的附魔铜肩，刮刀杆上刻一道符，手上带她凝露的凉气。
纷争纪|z4b_nasta.battle: Holding the furnace line under attack, a furnace-hand not a swordswoman: the apron buckled tight over a fireproof work coat of quilted salamander hide, a pair of enchanted copper pauldrons with cooling runes that glow frost-blue, leather gauntlets on, the damp cloth pulled over her mouth, the tin cup at her waist; both hands gripping a long iron scraper-pole angled across her body like a spear, its iron head etched with a glowing rune and a thin mist of cold curling off her grip, the legs planted wide, braced against the heat. A fierce, determined look.

纷争纪|z4b_sanlo.why: 共鸣的深潮看潮人，不是打手；照深潮的样子，海草筋麻褂外一件贝片背心、鳐皮护臂，海牙短矛上走一道海水。
纷争纪|z4b_sanlo.battle: Standing guard on the shore of a besieged bastion, a watcher not a duellist: the sea-grass-sinew smock belted close, a vest of overlapping pale shell plates laced over it whose edges shimmer faint blue when wet, ray-skin bracers over the sleeves, the single conch at his neck, the roll of tide tables at his belt; a short spear of bone-white sea-ivory held in both hands low across the body, a thin film of sea-water running along its blade, the ear fins spread wide to listen. An alert, intent look.

纷争纪|z4b_rodi.why: 灵格定2，轨会的老车夫；深蓝外套里一件嵌附魔片的棉背心，晶铲上沾着发蓝的魔晶屑，左手手套那一段照原句。
纷争纪|z4b_rodi.battle: Driving the war train under attack, a driver not a swordsman: the deep blue rail-guild jacket buttoned to the neck over a padded vest set with a few enchanted iron plates whose white rune lines glow at the chest, the sweat cloth with its tiny embroidered bell round his neck, leather gauntlets, a pair of smoked mica goggles pulled down; one hand pulling the throttle lever, the other gripping the long crystal shovel held forward like a short spear, its blade dusted with glowing blue crystal grit, the legs braced wide. A hard, steady look. The left gauntlet (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a stubby little finger half the length of the others, because the finger inside it is only a stump; that gauntlet reads as four long fingers and one short one.

纷争纪|z4b_luise.why: 灵格的炮算师，没上过墙，不打仗；研究所的长外套里一件发下来的轻附魔背心，量尺上的刻度亮一点蓝光。
纷争纪|z4b_luise.battle: Calculating on a firing line, a calculator not a swordswoman: the charcoal coat with its small brass ring pin belted close over a light issued vest of thin enchanted plates with pale rune lines, fingerless knitted gloves, a leather satchel across the chest, a tablet of tables hung at her belt; a long brass range-ruler held in both hands across the body like a quarterstaff, its engraved scales glowing a faint blue, the legs braced against the rumble of the guns. A tense, focused look.

纷争纪|z4b_orgun.why: 灵格的轰狱砌墙匠，不是打手；光着的胸前只挂围裙，加一只锻营雷打的铁肩、宽铁护臂，石锤里闪一点蓝雷。
纷争纪|z4b_orgun.battle: Defending his wall, a mason not a duellist: the mason's leather apron buckled tight over his bare chest, a single thunder-forged iron pauldron on the right shoulder with blue sparks crackling in its hammer marks, broad iron bracers over the mortar-stained forearm cloths, the rope of iron pulling hooks round his waist, the iron ring on his left horn; a heavy mason's mallet with a stone head held in both hands raised over the shoulder, faint blue sparks of thunder in the grain of the stone, one bare foot forward, the horns lowered; a fierce, steady look.

纷争纪|z4b_orian.why: 极境定3，白鸢骑士家的炉甲骑手，成套的轻炉甲衬装正合这一档；招牌是攥在手里的旧缰绳。
纷争纪|z4b_orian.battle: In a light furnace-armour harness ready to mount a mech: the padded arming coat with leather-stitched elbows and the worn white kite emblem on the shoulder, steel pauldrons and gauntlets engraved with rune lines that glow faint silver, a steel breastplate with a small furnace-core port on the chest glowing blue, a half helm with the faceplate raised, a coiled link-cable at the hip for the cockpit; the old reins wound round her left fist, a long straight sword held low in her right hand with a pale glow along its rune-cut blade, the stance wide and braced like a rider about to charge. A steady, intent look.

纷争纪|z4b_hakon.why: 灵格的老炉匠，不是兵，照姿势句举扳手摸热；围裙下一件嵌附魔铜片的耐热棉衣，照他的规矩不戴手套。
纷争纪|z4b_hakon.battle: Not a soldier, working under fire at a mech's furnace: the burned apron patched with copper plates and buckled tight over a heat-proof quilted coat set with small enchanted copper scales, a thick leather skullcap and a smoked mica visor pulled down, the brass tuning fork at his belt humming with a faint visible ring of light, no gloves on his bare hands; the long spanner in his right hand, the left palm held up and flat as if feeling for heat, faint glowing heat lines rising across the palm. A tense, focused look.

纷争纪|z4b_clovis.why: 灵格定2，铃尾信使家；跑死域长程不穿甲，绿外套里一件带风符的附魔薄皮背心，鞋跟带一点青风。
纷争纪|z4b_clovis.battle: On a dangerous courier run, a runner not a swordswoman: the forest-green jacket belted close over a thin enchanted leather vest with a pale green wind-rune glowing between the shoulders, leather bracers, the flat satchel strapped tight across the chest, the belt bell tied with cloth to keep it silent, the ring of fine bells at her ankle, thin soft running shoes with a faint breeze curling at the heels; a short straight dagger held low in her right hand, the body low and light on the balls of the feet, the ears pricked forward. A sharp, alert look.

纷争纪|z4c_veranda.why: 传奇定五档，可她是空手去劝龙、劝魔神的人，赤脚、不拿兵器，不硬穿甲，只让背上那片青金鳞当她的盾，鳞边的细字亮起来。
纷争纪|z4c_veranda.battle: Walking out alone beyond the wall to speak to a war god: the long grey linen robe belted tight with a plain cord, no armour and no bracers, bare feet; across her back on its wide strap the single blue-and-gold dragon scale as tall as half a person, standing in for any shield, the ring of small unreadable script around its rim glowing a faint blue-gold and a thin ward-shimmer spreading off its edge; no weapon, both hands open and empty at her sides, her pale gold eyes level and unafraid.

纷争纪|z4c_kailan.why: 跑在灾前头喊人的信使，身上越轻越好，从来不拿兵器；第三格有 battle_pose 管，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4c_kailan.battle: Running ahead of the danger: the green tunic cinched tight with a belt, leather bracers and knee wraps, the old burnt shoes tied at his belt, no weapon. Bright eyes, the mouth open to shout a warning.

纷争纪|z4c_dion.why: 斩过千像的传奇，炮的年月里跟着灯芯与灰烬的女主人南去，原句的熬皮甲配不上；升成一身雷纹的附魔胸甲，照旧裹得严实。
纷争纪|z4c_dion.battle: Walking backwards toward danger, in the light war harness of a legend of the islands: over the knee-length sail-cloth tunic a fitted breastplate and backplate of storm-grey enchanted steel, thin lightning-vein runes running across them and glowing pale blue, matching vambraces and greaves and a high plain gorget, everything covered and close; the short grey cloak over both shoulders. The polished round bronze shield is held in front of him at his chest, its mirror face toward him so that he looks only into it; his body turned away, his mouth set tight, the brow drawn together.

纷争纪|z4c_edmund.why: 一辈子没打过架的乐师，空手走进包围圈，不给他添甲；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4c_edmund.battle: Walking into a surrounded camp without a weapon: the grey travelling coat over the deep blue robe, leather gloves, the bone vial at his belt, both hands empty at his sides; calm, upright, and smiling slightly.

纷争纪|z4c_hipono.why: 王子出身不看，传奇定五档；他躲着人走了一万年，头发都没人束，样子朴素，骑装照传奇的料子做成一身素面附魔皮甲，不加装饰，只在缝线和护臂上透一层淡白的光，白羽照旧是他的兵器。
纷争纪|z4c_hipono.battle: Riding out in front of the guns: over the long brown tunic a plain fitted riding harness of the finest enchanted leather, dark brown and wholly unadorned, breast, back and shoulders shaped close, a faint white glow running only along its seams, matching plain enchanted leather bracers and riding greaves, the threadbare green-grey cloak thrown back, the grey blindfold, the bowstring on the left wrist; the thornwood crutch gone, the white feather raised in his right fist and pulling upward, a soft white light streaming off its vanes.

纷争纪|z4c_inny.why: 她是彻底的凡人、只背人不打仗，白烛给她留的担架位子都不用，战装就是旧斗篷和自己编的背架；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4c_inny.battle: Going into a collapsing flank to bring people out: the old cloak thrown back, a worn leather jerkin and bracers over the tunic, the woven carrying frame strapped tight on her back, a rope coiled over one shoulder; no weapon, her arms free and reaching, her teeth set.

纷争纪|z4c_corenna.why: 围死七座营垒的深潮传奇，原句的轻皮挽具太寒酸；照深潮那一系换成盐晶和海骨叠的挽具，四条胳膊的袖口照开，骨剑照旧没磨直。
纷争纪|z4c_corenna.battle: Holding a salt circle round a bastion, in the war harness of a deep-tide legend: over the sleeveless sea-fibre tunic a harness of overlapping plates of white salt crystal and pale sea-bone, cut with four armholes and laced with kelp-sinew cord, the crystal edges glowing a cold sea-green; a broad salt-crusted belt hung with the rolled tide chart; the forearms crusted with wet salt that glitters; dark trousers rolled to the shin, bare feet. The bone sword, still not ground straight, drawn in the upper right hand with a line of sea-green light along its crooked edge, the upper left hand raised palm-out as if drawing the sea up; the lower pair stays folded still against her chest.

纷争纪|z4c_hendrik.why: 营垒的守将照一方镇将估极境，3400年附魔甲早已成批，穿营垒发的整副附魔甲衣；招牌是链船上那只铜哨，剑照旧朴素。
纷争纪|z4c_hendrik.battle: On the wall at dusk, in the issue kit of a bastion commander: over the salt-stained grey coat a fitted enchanted brigandine of dark leather and riveted plates, thin white rune lines along the plate edges that flare when struck, a plain steel gorget, a leather cap with ear flaps, the old brass chain-boat whistle at the belt beside a pouch of crystal cells, a short plain sword at his hip with one faint rune near the hilt; a shuttered lantern with a pale blue crystal flame in his left hand. He is counting lights on the chain, his back slightly stooped, a steady, watchful look.

纷争纪|z4r_nidar.why: 极境三档，首匠家底厚加一档；原句的炉冠、符文锻甲和锤已经是量身的一身，1193年也对得上，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4r_nidar.battle: On the night he gathered in every fire of the mountain: the furnace crown on his brow, a ring of black mountain copper forged from the master furnace's first hoop, with a row of small furnace-door openings across its front through which the furnace fire glows orange and blue-white; a riveted leather forge cuirass with rune-cut plates glowing at the seams over the wool shirt, thick iron bracers and heavy gloves. He grips a long-handled forge hammer in both hands, its head scored with rune lines and glowing like a furnace mouth, a heavy, level, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z4r_anmara.why: 英雄定四档不看家境；魔族养藤的祭司不穿铁，把树皮甲做成照她身形打的一身、刻年轮会发绿光，活藤和白花照旧。
纷争纪|z4r_anmara.battle: Leading her clan against the reapers: the long vine-fibre dress belted tight under a war harness shaped to her, layered plates of dark heartwood bark carved with growth rings that glow a soft spring green, laced together with living vine that puts out thorns along the shoulders, matching bark bracers budding small white flowers, the half clay pot at her waist, bare feet with green shoots at the heels. She grips the short bone knife in her right hand, her left hand open and low with living vine tendrils curling up from the palm, the white flowers on her horns open; a fierce, quiet look.

纷争纪|z4r_sithea.why: 撼世的引翼者，原句的雕骨羽甲、骨珠高领已到顶档，她只叫不扑、不拿兵器也写了；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z4r_sithea.battle: Calling the whole flock against the cannon line: an over-designed war harness of pale carved bone plates laced over dark leather, sculpted bone pauldrons shaped like layered feathers, long dusk-lilac ribbons streaming from the shoulders, a tall collar of interlocking bone beads glowing ice blue around her throat, the white-edged wings folded close behind her with every white feather shining. She carries no weapon and leads by voice alone: one hand lifted with the fingers spread to direct the flock, the other at the bone beads at her throat, a fierce, commanding look.

纷争纪|z4r_everard.why: 英雄四档，他念旧穿回南段守闸的那一身，原句只是寻常旧锁甲；改成照他身架打的附魔锁甲和铁片、盾沿整圈亮铁灰的光（扣沿），剑照旧朴素。
纷争纪|z4r_everard.battle: Back on the gate as in the old days, in his own gate-commander's harness from the southern wall: a heavy fitted coat of enchanted riveted mail, its rings faintly rune-lit, with dented iron plates over the chest and shoulders made to his frame and white rune lines along their edges, the right pauldron worn bright where a gate cable ran over it, a short deep blue surcoat of his office, rune-etched gauntlets, the polished gate ring at the belt. A tall rectangular wall shield on his left arm, its rim worn to bare iron and glowing iron-grey along the whole edge, a plain broad arming sword held low in his right hand, a hard, steady look.

纷争纪|z4r_wolfgang.why: 极境三档，世家加一档，甲是家里照他量的整副；他不戴首饰、说话像念法条，样子去装饰，只留鸦羽披肩和骨哨。
纷争纪|z4r_wolfgang.battle: Commanding the battery line: the fitted navy coat over a slim enchanted breastplate, gorget and tassets made to his measure in the house armoury, plain and unornamented, engraved rune lines glowing a faint crystal violet, the raven-feathered shoulder cape, black gauntlets with a small violet crystal set at each wrist. He holds the bone whistle raised near his lips in the left hand and the slim straight rapier drawn low in the right, a thin violet rune line along its blade, a cold, ready look.

纷争纪|z4r_yorick.why: 英雄往上不看家境，原句的皮挽具偏低；改成照他两米多的身架打的符文铁片挽具，肩上铆着吃链的铁环，赭色符文亮着。
纷争纪|z4r_yorick.battle: Hauling a chain of boats against the tide, in a hauler's war harness forged for his size: over the canvas vest a heavy fitted harness of rune-cut iron plates across the chest and shoulders, thick iron rings riveted at both shoulders to take the chain, the ochre rune lines along the plates glowing warm, enchanted iron vambraces over the chain marks, ridged grip gauntlets, the boots braced. He grips the heavy grappling chain unwound in both hands, the four-pronged iron claw swinging at its end, the links glowing with ochre runes, a fierce, grinning look.

纷争纪|z4r_zambo.why: 白骸骨匠首，英雄四档；原句的刻字骨甲已对得上这一系在炮的年月的样子，只添一道骨环高领，显出是量身拼的。
纷争纪|z4r_zambo.battle: Driving the colossi against the tower: a fitted harness of carved bone plates laced over dark leather, each plate cut with joining runes that glow pale cyan, a high collar of interlocked bone rings, bone bracers, the grey felt cloak with its bone toggles thrown back, a short shoulder mantle of white bone tags. He raises the leg-bone bell mallet in his right hand to strike, pale cyan light running along it and along the bone rings on his knuckles, a hard, intent look.

纷争纪|z5a_katie.rank: 共鸣→灵格（这一格是甩晶匣那三夜）
纷争纪|z5a_katie.why: 新上墙的穷人家哨兵，灵格本是二档减一档；灰外套底下只多一件营垒发的附魔半身胸甲，晶匣和投索照旧。
纷争纪|z5a_katie.battle: Standing her watch on the beacon tower, in a new guard's issue kit: the grey guard's coat belted with a broad strap over a plain issue enchanted half-cuirass, its single white rune line dim along the edge; leather bracers marked with faint rune lines; the pouch of crystal cartridges glowing softly at her belt. She whirls the woven sling-cord in her right hand ready to throw a cartridge, a spark of white light gathering in its cradle, the short spear held low in her left, feet apart, her eyes fixed on a far spark in the dark.

纷争纪|z5a_gunter.why: 灵格减一档，老侍从跟皇帝一样穿发下来的灰外套，底下添一件刚上墙时领的旧附魔半身胸甲，旧圆盾的符文线照旧亮。
纷争纪|z5a_gunter.battle: Guarding the emperor on a windy night: under the grey coat, belted with a strap, an old issue enchanted half-cuirass from his first years on the wall, its rune line dim; the oak lamp box on his back with the small lid-lamp flame burning steady in the wind; the old round shield raised in front of him in his left hand, faint worn rune lines under the half-gone paint glowing pale, a small lit hand-lamp in his right, feet planted, a stubborn, calm look.

纷争纪|z5a_peg.why: 赶粮车的半身人，喊人不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_peg.battle: Driving through the night on the grain road: a worn canvas short jacket over the leather apron with its bells buckled on, a thick scarf, fingerless gloves, a coil of mule reins gripped in both hands, a lantern with a crystal core hung from the wagon beam. She does not fight, she shouts and does not slow down.

纷争纪|z5a_maren.why: 未成年的看潮人，在船上干活不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_maren.battle: On the deck of the boat in rough water: the canvas short jacket buttoned up, long trousers under a canvas skirt tied at the knee, boots hung round her neck. She holds a heavy coil of mooring line in both hands, the iron chain end at her waist, her eyes on the swell.

纷争纪|z5a_stig.why: 灵格二档，深井一支家底寻常；油布围裙底下换成一件改合身的矮人旧鳞甲坎肩，手套关节刻符文，晶匣冲角照旧。
纷争纪|z5a_stig.battle: At the ram on the warship's prow: the oilcloth apron over an old refitted dwarven scale jerkin from the deep-well armouries, its small plates laced tight and edged with dim rune lines, rune-knuckled iron-capped gloves, a pouch of crystal cartridges at the belt beside the lead weight, the nailed boots planted wide. He braces his shoulder against the heavy brace-pole of the crystal-cartridge ram, both thick arms locked round it, the lead weight swinging at his belt, a grim, immovable look.

纷争纪|z5a_froni.rank: 共鸣→灵格（风台找风那一回）
纷争纪|z5a_froni.why: 未成年的看风手，挂网量石不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_froni.battle: Hanging on the cargo net across the canyon: the leather waistcoat buckled tight over the linen shirt, leather gloves, fine rope looped over her shoulder, the lead plumb weight swinging from its cord. Upside down in the net, one hand holding a white chalk mark on a stone, the other on the rope, her eyes on the drifting rocks.

纷争纪|z5a_kettle.why: 极境三档，塔炉匠的整套战装就是炉边那一身做成甲：围裙底下一件炉钢附魔胸甲、符文隔热手套，招牌是刃口烧红的长铁铲；原句身后的炉子是背景，拿掉。
纷争纪|z5a_kettle.battle: Defending the furnace in the tower, in a tower furnace-smith's war gear: the burnt leather apron buckled over a fitted dwarven cuirass of dark furnace steel whose rune seams glow orange, rune-etched heat gauntlets to the elbow, a leather cap with smoked mica goggles pushed up on it, the iron-toed boots planted wide. He holds the long iron shovel and the fire tongs crossed in front of his chest, the shovel blade glowing red-hot along its rune-cut edge, a hard, silent look.

纷争纪|z5a_peony.why: 研究所的算师，升塔那天算铅不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_peony.battle: Working the figures for a tower on the day of its lift: the grey institute robe belted tight, sleeves tied back, the little brass bell silent in her fist, the charcoal pencil raised, the notebook under her arm, her eyes racing.

纷争纪|z5a_horst.why: 极境三档，骑士世家本该加，可国已亡、他守着旧甲不换纹，定在家传的那一整套；补上黑石重骑那一路掺月银末的甲片，冲起来一片冷光。
纷争纪|z5a_horst.battle: Ready at the gate before the charge: the old White Kite knight's plate armour buckled complete, an heirloom set of the heavy-cavalry line whose steel is mixed with pale silver dust that still flashes cold, its surface dull and dark with scuffs, the white kite on the breastplate rubbed down to a faint shadow and never replaced, faded rune lines along the pauldrons waking to a thin silver-white glow, no helm. A long lance held upright in his right hand, its rune-cut head lit pale, a round shield on his left arm. He stands square on both feet, a hard, level look.

纷争纪|z5a_ishile.why: 守湖人撑船引路不打仗，那盏铜灯和骨哨就是她的家伙；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_ishile.battle: Guiding a boat across the lake by night: the oilcloth cloak buttoned to the throat, leather gloves, the bone whistle on its cord, the brass lamp raised high on a pole. She stands braced at the stern with a long punting pole, the lamp lighting the black water, a calm, unblinking look.

纷争纪|z5a_novia.why: 未成年的观星学徒，不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_novia.battle: Out on the night bridge: the patched fisher's coat buttoned to the throat, a long scarf, mittens, boots, the carved star board held up in one hand with its rope hanging loose from it and the small knife in the other hand; nothing is tied on her back, there is only this one board, her face tipped up to the sky.

纷争纪|z5a_rotrude.why: 十七岁、刚学剑的采花家女儿，共鸣又家贫，只添一件厚皮练剑短甲和谷里铁匠打的一只护臂；花瓣原句铺在脚下，改成贴着剑身化刃。
纷争纪|z5a_rotrude.battle: Training in the flower field: the long-sleeved rough dress belted tight with the rose-red band, a plain laced fencing jerkin of thick leather over it, a single steel bracer on the sword arm from the valley smith with one thin rose-red rune line, tall boots, the braid tied back. She holds the thin sword in both hands at the ready, point forward, the rattan scabbard at her belt, a swirl of rose petals turning into tiny glinting blades along the blade, a clear, serious look.

纷争纪|z5a_cenwa.why: 十岁的孩子，这一页是被护着的，长大以后的旧皮甲和长戟归铁狼那一格；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5a_cenwa.battle: Waiting out the night in the camp, alert: the grey hemp robe belted tight, a short dark cloak, soft boots, the left cuff patch visible. He holds a shuttered lantern low in both hands, his dark red eyes faintly glowing, a calm, unblinking look.

纷争纪|z5b_wethlo.why: 英雄四档，前锋营的黑皮甲做成照他身形打的漆黑皮甲加暗钢边；剑上那一路写成排成法阵的细槽亮暗红，避开血字过审核。
纷争纪|z5b_wethlo.battle: Charging with the vanguard, in vanguard armour fitted to him over ninety years in the dead lands: black lacquered boiled-leather plates over the chest, shoulders and thighs, edged in dark steel, a dark red lineage stripe down the chest glowing faintly with dark red script, black leather bracers set with small dark steel plates. He holds the narrow straight sword drawn low at his side, the fine grooves along the blade, laid out like a spell circle, glowing deep red, the other hand open. A level, hungry, unwavering look.

纷争纪|z5b_tiona.why: 绣工、养孩子的人，不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5b_tiona.battle: Not a fighter; tending the wounded at the edge of the camp: the pale grey robe with the sleeves tied back with cloth, the needlework pouch at her belt, a clean linen apron over the robe. She holds a threaded needle up in one hand and a roll of bandage in the other, the feet apart and steady, a firm, calm look.

纷争纪|z5b_zaina.why: 英雄四档，炎角赤铜胸甲光着两臂是这一系的样子，做成照她身架锻的胸甲加短裙甲、铜纹亮橙红，大盾镶赤铜边。
纷争纪|z5b_zaina.battle: Charging at the front, in a flame-horn war harness forged to her build: a red-bronze breastplate and short tassets etched with branching copper sorcery lines that glow ember orange, bare arms, heavy red-bronze bracers on the wrists. The big round shield rimmed in red bronze held braced before her on her left arm, its face darkened by heat, the long-handled war hammer raised in her right hand, its head glowing red with her own heat, the horn flames roaring high. A fierce, shouting look.

纷争纪|z5b_kos.rank: 共鸣→灵格（等风岭那一天）
纷争纪|z5b_kos.why: 刚上岭的孩子射手，未成年往低里判，只添一只刻族纹的骨护臂，角弓、羽边箭囊照旧；双角那一句是纠错，留着。
纷争纪|z5b_kos.battle: On the ridge in the wind: the deerskin jerkin laced firmly, a carved bone bracer on the bow arm with a faint ember-coloured clan mark, the leather finger guards on her right hand, the feathered quiver her mother sewed at the belt. She draws the horn bow to full and aims straight ahead along the arrow, whose tip carries a faint ember glow, the feet planted. A steady, intent look, the mouth closed. Both horns show, one over each temple, the same size.

纷争纪|z5b_kilian.why: 看风手，被关了一年刚放出来，身上不带兵器；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5b_kilian.battle: Hanging on a tower edge in high wind: the canvas coat buckled, a climbing rope belayed round his waist and across the chest, leather gloves, the bandaged leg braced on a ledge. He swings a lead plumb weight on a long cord in one hand, reading the wind, the other hand gripping the rope; he carries no weapon. A sharp, focused look.

纷争纪|z5b_muk.why: 灵格减一档的老补墙匠，围裙底下多一件发下来的旧附魔半身胸甲、一顶刻符文带的铁盔；原句靠着的半截墙和脚边的灰桶是场景，桶挪回背上。
纷争纪|z5b_muk.battle: Holding a breach in the wall: the leather apron buckled over a battered issue enchanted half-cuirass, its cracked rune line still flickering white, knee pads on, a dented issue iron helmet with a faint rune band, thick leather gloves, the mortar bucket on his back. He braces with the left shoulder forward as if holding up stone, the stone hammer raised in his right hand and the trowel in his left, both crusted with mortar that glints faint grey. A stubborn, grim look.

纷争纪|z5b_kisha.why: 最低档的新人，修墙不算持兵，只添一块墙队的旧皮护肩，飞石那一手带一圈淡光。
纷争纪|z5b_kisha.battle: Throwing from the wall: the oversized coat buckled to the collar, sleeves rolled, a scuffed leather shoulder guard from the wall crew strapped on the throwing side, leather gloves, the bag of round stones at her belt. She winds up with one stone in her right hand, a thin pale spin of light around it, the left arm pointed forward at the target, the feet planted. A fierce, concentrated look, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z5b_aurelio.why: 背冠领驼队的人，谈不拢就绕路，不拿兵器打仗，长杖是引路用的，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5b_aurelio.battle: Leading the caravan through a dust storm: the sunset robe belted, a cloth wrapped over the nose and mouth with the amber eyes clear above it, the box strapped on his back. He holds a long staff planted in front of him in one hand and raises the other arm to signal the line to halt. A firm, alert look.

纷争纪|z5b_rinaldo.why: 灵格减一档的守火人，只添塔上库里拿的一副附魔隔热手套，围裙上的日轮徽亮金光；照脸的火光改到火钳上。
纷争纪|z5b_rinaldo.battle: Defending the furnace: the leather apron buckled over the robe, the sun-disc badge on its chest glowing warm gold, heat-proof enchanted gauntlets to the elbow taken from the tower stores, their runes glowing dull red, a smoke-blackened helmet. He holds the long tongs in both hands, a glowing coal gripped in their jaws, braced and planted, firelight running along the tongs. A grim, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z5b_ingrid.why: 极境三档，塔炉匠这一行的整套是加了炉钢甲片的围裙和符文隔热手套，招牌是自己排火色的铜表；原句的铁砧是家具，拿掉。
纷争纪|z5b_ingrid.battle: At the tower's furnace heart, in a master furnace-smith's gear: the burned Furnace-Vein apron buckled over a plated work cuirass of dark furnace steel with orange rune seams, rune-etched heat gauntlets to the elbow, the smoked-mica goggle pulled down over her eyes, the copper fire-colour dial glowing at her belt on its chain. She swings the furnace hammer in both hands, its rune-cut head glowing white-hot and sparks flying from it, her feet planted wide. A fierce, absorbed look.

纷争纪|z5b_yel.why: 未成年的看风手，不打仗；有 battle_pose，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5b_yel.battle: Not a fighter; on the wind platform in a gale: the tower jacket buttoned to the collar, a safety line clipped round his waist to the rail, leather gloves. He holds the lead plumb weight out on its cord over the edge in one hand and a small notebook in the other, the feet braced apart. A serious, concentrated look.

纷争纪|z5b_ninmeis.why: 极境三档，在缝里补了四百年岩，样子朴素实用：皮衣肩臂缀山铜片、嵌骨的守望者护臂，长弓是活精灵木；原句脚卡在石缝里是场景，改成抬脚撑着。
纷争纪|z5b_ninmeis.battle: Hanging in the crevices under a floating rock: the grey-brown leather suit buckled, its shoulders and forearms reinforced with thin plates of mountain bronze cut like her clamp bands, a watcher's bracer set with pale bone, a rope round her waist, fingerless gloves. She draws the long bow of living elven wood to full, a faint green glow along its limbs, one foot braced high, the arrow aimed along her gaze with a pale point of light at its tip. A cool, intent look. The ear on the viewer's left is the short blunt one, the ear on the viewer's right long and pointed.

纷争纪|z5b_dankvart.why: 灵格减一档的捡骨人，只添一块死域里捡来的附魔肩甲，符文线一闪一闪，拣骨钩照旧。
纷争纪|z5b_dankvart.battle: Crossing the dust flats: the coarse jacket buttoned, the cloth wound at the neck, a scavenged enchanted shoulder plate from the dead lands strapped over the left shoulder, its rune line flickering on and off, a cloth over the nose and mouth with both mismatched eyes clear above it, the basket strapped on his back. He holds the bone-picking hook in both hands ahead of him like a short pole, ready to ward off, the feet planted. A wary, alert look.

纷争纪|z5c_io.why: 传奇定五档，可他一直穿发下来的灰外套、腰缠麻绳，样子照旧朴素；只在里头添一件附魔皮背心、两只附魔护臂，豹皮的电光和不灭的火把才是招牌。
纷争纪|z5c_io.battle: Climbing to a rescue on the hanging ropes: the plain grey wool issue coat belted tight with the three loops of hemp rope, under it a light fitted vest of enchanted leather with a thin storm-blue rune line along its seams, enchanted leather bracers over the sleeves, leather gloves, boots with rope-wrapped soles, the folded leopard pelt strapped tight over his back with blue sparks running in its folds. In his right hand he grips the staff with its flame burning bright and held forward, a coil of rope over his left shoulder; braced and fierce, the brows drawn together, the mouth set.

纷争纪|z5c_wulde.why: 观星的女王不拿兵器，靠的是掌上那一圈星点；不给她穿甲，只在深蓝长袍的下摆和袖口添一道会亮的星文。
纷争纪|z5c_wulde.battle: Standing at the head of a camp during a relief march: the deep-blue robe shortened and belted over dark wool trousers and leather riding boots, its hem and cuffs stitched with a thin line of star-script that glows a faint silver-white, a hooded dark cloak, leather gloves with the fingertips cut open, the brass astrolabe at her belt and a long rolled star chart in a leather tube on her back. She holds out one hand flat, palm up, with a thin ring of faint light-points above it like a small map of stars, the other hand open and steady; a calm, cold, exact look. No weapon.

纷争纪|z5c_sekody.why: 蔷薇的开国女王、剑圣，原句一件皮短甲配不上；换成薄附魔钢的蔷薇色胸甲，刻攀枝刺藤亮玫瑰金，轻巧合她看着软折不弯的样子；花瓣原句从四周花上掀起是场景，改成贴着剑身。
纷争纪|z5c_sekody.battle: Dancing the blade at the mouth of the valley, in the war dress of the Rose's swordmaster: a close-fitted deep-rose cuirass of thin enchanted steel engraved with climbing thorny cane lines that glow a soft rose gold, a matching pauldron on the sword shoulder and slim vambraces, over a cream blouse with the sleeves bound at the wrists, a split green battle skirt over riding trousers and tall leather boots, the thorn-braid pinned up. She draws the slim long sword in her right hand and swings it in a wide arc, a storm of red rose petals spiralling along the blade and turning to glinting edges; a fierce, bright, confident look.

纷争纪|z5c_tanis.why: 祂身边那支箭，传奇五档；在原来的深灰皮衣上添雕骨肩甲和胸侧骨片、刻着亮青白光的细字，长骨护臂，跟她那张青白骨弓配成一身。
纷争纪|z5c_tanis.battle: Drawing the great bow on a ridge at night, in the war harness of the arrow-god's best archer: the dark grey leather jerkin laced tight with a high collar, pale carved bone plates fitted over the shoulders and the bow-side chest, engraved with fine script that glows a cold blue-white, a long carved bone bracer on the left forearm and the shooting glove, a short dark cloak pinned at the left shoulder blowing in the wind, quiver on the hip. She holds the blue-white bone bow at full draw with the arrow nocked, a thread of blue-white light along the arrow, the string at her cheek, one eye open and unwavering, the shoulders square and the feet planted wide; completely still and calm.

纷争纪|z5c_heidi.why: 传奇照档用好东西，可她是修墙队的领头，一件不加装饰：灰外套底下一件打得极好的素面附魔胸甲、山铜包边，符文缝亮暗金，盾沿一道护符光。
纷争纪|z5c_heidi.battle: Holding the breach at the mouth of the wall: the patched grey wool coat belted tight over a plain, finely forged enchanted breastplate edged in dull mountain bronze, no ornament, its rune seams glowing dull gold, plain shoulder plates of the same, leather gauntlets, heavy boots, grey mortar dust on everything, a dented round shield on the left arm with a faint gold ward line round its rim. The long mountain-bronze sword is drawn in her right hand, its blade glowing dull gold along the edge, the row of small dents along its spine; planted wide, shouting a verse of her song with the mouth open, a fierce stubborn look.

纷争纪|z5c_baudouin.why: 英雄四档不看家境，可他严整不炫，舰队外套扣子一颗不少；外套底下添一件合身的附魔胸甲，护喉刻一道亮海青光的风文，剑照旧素；左手三指那一段原样留着。
纷争纪|z5c_baudouin.battle: On the stern of his flagship in a gale: the deep-blue fleet coat buttoned to the collar and belted over a slim fitted enchanted cuirass, every brass button in place, a plain steel gorget engraved with a thin line of wind-script glowing pale sea-green, a leather sea-cloak lined with stitched ward thread blowing in the wind, polished boots; in his right hand a plain straight sword held low at his side, a faint sea-green rune along its fuller, the left hand gripping a signal flag's staff with its only three digits, thumb, index and middle finger, the outer edge of the hand a smooth scarred stump with no ring finger and no little finger, that bare edge turned toward the viewer; the signal flag is a plain pennant of one deep sea-blue with a narrow white border, NOT striped; a calm, resolute look, the eyes on the sea.

纷争纪|z5c_turak.why: 座前祭司，一辈子在岭下喊名字，拉不开好弓、不拿兵器；原句的皮背心护臂已够，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5c_turak.battle: Standing at the foot of the ridge before the altars: the dun-brown priest's robe with a heavy dark leather vest and bracers over it, a hooded grey cloak, strong boots. He carries no weapon: he holds out one hand to the sky and the other to the crowd and shouts a name at full voice, the mouth open, the chest high, the face lit by firelight.

纷争纪|z5c_severin.why: 第一塔的守火人，塔落时守着炉门不肯走，不是打仗的人；原句的围裙手套就是他那一身，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z5c_severin.battle: Feeding the last fire as the tower falls: the scorched leather apron over a thick grey wool coat, thick leather gloves to the elbow, a cloth wrapped over the nose and mouth, heavy boots. He is braced in front of the open furnace door with the iron tongs gripped in both hands, orange firelight on his face, the knees bent and the jaw set; stubborn, refusing.

纷争纪|z5r_vikar.why: 撼世传奇、线南翼群的头领，定在这一纪顶上那一档；魔族不烧魔晶，照有翼一系用黑曜、骨和夜里发亮的刻文，翼骨磨的钩子照旧。
纷争纪|z5r_vikar.battle: Climbing the beacon tower as a legend, in the war harness of the wing-hosts' lord: a long close-fitting coat of blackened scale armour reaching the shins, every scale a thin plate of polished black obsidian edged with carved pale bone, high-collared, the back left open in a wide V so that the two gold-scarred wing stumps blaze bright; layered obsidian shoulder plates rimmed with bone and etched with night-script that glows faint violet; black bone-plated bracers and greaves carved with the same violet lines. He holds one pale bone climbing hook in each hand, the points turned down, their edges glowing faint gold, and a pool of starless night clings around his feet like black water, trailing upward behind his heels in thin dark sheets. A heavy, upward-reaching stance, a cold, unblinking look.

纷争纪|z5r_oira.rank: 英雄→传奇（倒潮夜第二声螺到撼世）
纷争纪|z5r_oira.why: 倒潮夜这一格正是她到传奇的那一刻，潮主家世代领船，贝甲是家传的，升到顶档，加潮文、盐晶和浪光。
纷争纪|z5r_oira.battle: On the prow on the night of the great double tide, in the tide-master family's heirloom war shell: a fitted armour of overlapping pearl-white shell plates over dark sea-green scale-mail, each plate inlaid with spiralling tide-script that glows sea-green, high-collared, the shoulder plates shaped like great spiral shells rimmed with white salt crystal, long sleeves with shell-plated vambraces, a long split skirt of scale panels edged with mother-of-pearl, a long deep-teal mantle that streams out behind her like a rising wave, its edge foaming white with drifting spray-light. She holds the white conch raised to her scarred lips in both webbed hands, the cord of sixty-eight shell plates swinging from it, each plate glinting. A tall, still, commanding stance, the coral-red eyes cold and steady.

纷争纪|z5r_leona.why: 英雄位阶的领翼，英雄往上不看家境；照浮塔年月夜翼扑塔、骨矛钉塔那一路，骨甲刻风文，翼骨磨的哨挂上。
纷争纪|z5r_leona.battle: Diving on the sky-tower, in the lead wing's war harness: a fitted flight armour of dark iron-blue scale-leather, overlapping plates of pale carved bone over the chest and shoulders cut with wind-script that glows faint violet-white, a high bone gorget, bracers and greaves of black leather set with thin obsidian splints, the back open between the wing roots; the bone whistle hangs at her throat; the great iron-blue wings spread wide behind her, the left one missing its row of feathers. She grips a long bone spear in both hands, its head ground needle-sharp and its shaft bound with violet-lit script, the point thrust down and forward as if she is about to drop like a black star. A fierce, cold, intent look.

纷争纪|z5r_pelosen.why: 英雄定在四档，可他是点灯引路的梦魇，不靠甲，赤脚，照他的路子把档用在雾衣上：黑曜镜片、灯文衬里、骨制灯符。
纷争纪|z5r_pelosen.battle: Raising the false lamps in the fog, in a fog-walker's ward coat rather than armour: the long fog-grey coat closed with carved horn buttons, its collar and cuffs sewn with small shards of black obsidian mirror that catch the orange-gold light, under a dark lilac mantle whose edges fray into drifting mist and whose lining is stitched with faint lamp-script glowing orange; a fitted dark leather vest and bracers beneath, a cord of small bone lamp-charms at the belt, barefoot. In his left hand he holds the old unlit lantern raised high; his right hand is open at his side, and around him float a dozen small glowing orange-gold lights with no lamps, like lit windows hanging in the air. A calm, still, persuasive look, the orange-gold eyes glowing.

纷争纪|z5r_nazro.why: 座前祭司，不是兵，不带兵器，第三格照 battle_pose 出宴夜那一身；battle 照原句交回，只把衬里的 blood red 换成 deep crimson 免得过审核。
纷争纪|z5r_nazro.battle: Walking at the head of the feast on the night of the eighth feast: the ash-grey robe under a long black hooded mantle lined with deep crimson, a wide black leather belt, black leather bracers. He holds the long black iron ladle out level in front of him in his right hand like a sceptre, the left hand raised open, and thin threads of dark red horn-fire curl around the ladle. A calm, sorrowful, unbending look.

纷争纪|z5r_grize.why: 极限型机甲城脊的主控，英雄位阶，炉城炉匠家出身；她的战装是驾驶的那一身，升成量身做的主控挽具，铜接口、晶匣、符文线，起动钥照旧。
纷争纪|z5r_grize.battle: Strapped in as pilot of the City Ridge, in the Furnace City pilot's war kit: a thick padded charcoal wool under-armour quilted with copper rune-thread that glows faint blue, leather at the elbows and knees; over it a fitted brass-riveted enchanted harness of thin plates across the chest and shoulders, crystal-lit brass couplings at both shoulders where the machine's link-clamps lock on, a row of crystal cells at the belt; short leather gauntlets that leave the forearms bare so the rune marks glow bright blue; a close leather cap with smoked mica goggles pushed up on the forehead, heavy boots. In her right hand she holds a heavy brass rune-key as long as her forearm, the start-key of the machine's furnace core, glowing blue along its teeth. A firm, focused look.

纷争纪|z5r_taher.why: 名字凝住的英雄、前锋领头，照浮塔年月炎角赤铜胸甲光膀子那一身往上做，黑曜镶钉、刻纹透白火，黑曜斧照旧，照旧赤脚。
纷争纪|z5r_taher.battle: Leading the push on the breach, in the flame-horn vanguard's war gear: a massive red-bronze breastplate etched with branching copper sorcery lines that glow white-hot, both arms bare to the shoulder, heavy pauldrons of black leather studded with black obsidian, red-bronze bracers, a short war kilt of riveted leather strips plated with red bronze, barefoot on the cracked baked legs. In his right hand a long-hafted war axe with a black obsidian head, white fire running along its edge; his left hand is held open toward the ground and glows white-hot, the horn flames roaring up white. A grim, immovable look.

纷争纪|z5r_senati.why: 跟塔赫尔同档的英雄，影魔走影子、不挂会响的东西，档用在吞光的哑黑曜片和贴身皮挽具上，不加重甲。
纷争纪|z5r_senati.battle: Sending her shadow across the breach, in a shadow-walker's silent war kit: the close dark slate coat belted tight under a fitted harness of black leather with thin matte obsidian plates at the shoulders and ribs that swallow the light, nothing that can jingle, black leather bracers set with dull obsidian splints, soft silent boots. Her shadow has left her and rises beside her as a long flat black silhouette of a woman taller than she is, its long thin fingers reaching forward; her own right hand is raised with the fingers spread, steering it, the left hand low at her side. A cold, intent, unhurried look, the indigo eyes glowing.

纷争纪|z5r_emeric.why: 极境的段城守将，龙雷炮手出身，照浮塔年月灰外套罩附魔半身甲、晶匣皮袋那一身成套，招牌是刻符的炮杵和口袋里的旧道钉。
纷争纪|z5r_emeric.battle: Holding the rail crossing, in a wall commander's enchanted kit: the standard grey wool coat belted tight over a fitted steel half-cuirass cut with rune seams that glow pale blue, enchanted iron pauldrons with a lit crystal set in each, heavy leather cannoneer's gauntlets with brass crystal-feed rings at the wrists, a leather pouch of crystal cells at the belt, a leather cannoneer's cap with the ear flaps turned up, heavy boots; the old iron rail spike sticks out of the coat pocket. A plain broad straight sword hangs at his left hip in its scabbard; in his right hand he holds a long brass-capped cannon rammer upright like a staff, its brass cap etched with a glowing rune ring. A planted, unyielding stance, a hard, calculating look.

纷争纪|z5r_harzan.why: 英雄低处，英雄往上不看家境；夜翼猎手扑塔，骨甲镶黑曜、鹫羽披肩、刻猎文的骨护臂，骨矛照旧，哨含在嘴里。
纷争纪|z5r_harzan.battle: Diving on the falling tower, in a night-wing hunter's war harness: dark scaled-leather flight armour over the dun jerkin, chest and shoulder plates of pale carved bone edged with polished black obsidian, a short mantle of dark vulture feathers at the shoulders, bone bracers carved with hunting script that glows dull gold, the back open between the wing roots, the great indigo membrane wings spread wide. He grips a long bone spear in both hands, its point ground to a needle and glinting gold along the carved script. A fierce, sharp, grinning look with the whistle clenched in his teeth.

纷争纪|z5r_torsten.why: 灵格高处的运晶驻地领头，营垒那一路的寻常人家，二档：灰外套底下一副重新上了带的旧附魔甲、一只镶晶的肩甲、晶匣皮袋，提灯换成晶灯。
纷争纪|z5r_torsten.battle: Leading the crystal caravan north, in a camp chief's refitted issue gear: the grey wool coat belted over an old enchanted brigandine re-laced with new straps, one thin rune line glowing pale blue along its seams, a single crystal-set iron pauldron on the right shoulder, a leather pouch of crystal cells at the belt, a sand-dun hooded cloak, the scarf pulled up to the chin, heavy boots, a short straight sword at his left hip. He holds a lit brass crystal lantern up in his right hand, its pale blue light steady, his weight on the right leg, a steady, watchful look.

纷争纪|z6a_lumeya.why: 王庭侍从、未成年的样子，第三格照 battle_pose 按地引泉、不拔兵器，穿的是干活那一身；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_lumeya.battle: Ready to cross open ground: the grey-green dress hitched up and belted over fitted dark leggings, a short leather jerkin and forearm guards, the two jars tied snug at her back so they cannot swing, the herb pouch at her belt. In her right hand a small bent root-wood knife held low, her left hand open and ready; a steady, serious look.

纷争纪|z6a_franz.why: 守兵家的传令兵，短剑一回没拔过，第三格照 battle_pose 在墙上狂奔报信，穿的是红布肩的信使那一身；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_franz.battle: At the wall in an alarm: the red-shouldered leather jacket buckled tight, the satchel slung to his back, leather bracers, cleated boots planted on the stones. In his right hand the short sword drawn at last and held low and unsteadily, his left hand raised flat as a signal; a tense, wide-eyed look.

纷争纪|z6a_ursu.why: 英雄位阶的老斥候，英雄往上不看家境；铁狼年月人穿轻的、最精的那一身，照斥候的样子升成薄附魔甲片、镶晶护臂、晶匣，铃绳和短刀照旧。
纷争纪|z6a_ursu.battle: Ready to scout the dead land, in a Bell-tail veteran's light war kit: a fitted grey scout brigandine of thin enchanted plates riveted under the grey leather, its seams tracing faint pale-blue ward lines, a ring of rope loops at the belt, a dark cloak-blanket wrapped over one shoulder, the rope coil across his chest in a figure-eight, crystal-set bracers bound on both forearms, a row of crystal cells at the belt, copper-soled boots. In his right hand a short knife held low, its edge faintly rune-lit, in his left the end of the long belled rope paid out behind him, every small bell etched with a glowing rune ring; crouched, ears forward, amber eyes narrowed.

纷争纪|z6a_iro.why: 灵格的守望者弓手，家里世代守林，可看着十六、算未成年，档往低里判，穿得严实：一件刻青纹的树皮叶甲、一只镶晶骨护臂。
纷争纪|z6a_iro.battle: On the stone ridge of the deer-spring pass, in a young Watcher's issued wall kit: the grey-green cloak pinned back with a leaf pin, a fitted high-collared jerkin of lacquered bark-leaf scales over leather with faint green ward lines along the seams, long sleeves, a bone-set bracer on the bow arm with one small lit crystal, a sewn leaf-and-bow badge on the shoulder, quiver full at her side with a few arrows whose heads glimmer faintly. She draws the tall longbow to full length, the string at her cheek, the arrow aimed straight ahead, left hand steady on the bow, eyes wide open and fixed; a fierce, concentrated look with the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z6a_linnet.why: 林隙药农家摇铃的姑娘，不是兵，第三格照 battle_pose 护着铃筐摇手铃，穿林隙那一身；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_linnet.battle: Out on the road in danger: the linen jacket buckled up, a short leather vest and forearm guards, the willow basket carried in front in both arms to guard the bells, the herb bag at the belt. In her right hand a short walking staff with a bell tied to its head, held crosswise; a determined look, the brows drawn together.

纷争纪|z6a_hug.why: 白烛担架手，不拿兵器，第三格照 battle_pose 扛伤兵、横担架杆挡在前头，穿担架队的罩衫；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_hug.battle: Carrying the wounded under threat: the grey-white smock belted tight, a heavy leather apron over it and leather forearm guards, three folded stretchers on his back. One huge arm holds a limp wounded soldier across his shoulders, the other hand grips the iron-shod end of a stretcher pole like a staff; braced forward, a grim steady look.

纷争纪|z6a_wupke.why: 极境的甲长，在擎天级头舱里拽铃指挥，第三格照 battle_pose 穿旧船长外套掌舵，不披甲；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_wupke.battle: Commanding in the head chamber: the patched navy coat buttoned up, a leather harness belt and brass whistle round his neck, a bell cord in his right hand to ring instead of shouting, the left hand on the rail. Legs wide and braced, eyes narrowed and fixed ahead; a steady, commanding look.

纷争纪|z6a_mette.rank: 共鸣→灵格（LVL 33→45，这一格是敲拍钟那二十多天）
纷争纪|z6a_mette.why: 钟匠家的女儿、术式兵团外圈，开局共鸣、敲拍钟那些天到灵格，二档：兵团发的灰蓝短袍带发光回路线、一只镶晶护臂、一排晶匣，拍钟和刻字刀照旧。
纷争纪|z6a_mette.battle: In the casting ring, in the spell-corps' outer-ring kit: the grey-blue short robe belted, its tight cuffs engraved with glowing pale-blue circuit lines, the three embroidered rings on the left breast lit faintly along their stitches, a crystal-set bracer on the left forearm, a row of small crystal cells at the belt beside the hemp-wrapped carving knife, the bronze pendant outside the robe. In her right hand a short slim casting rod held up in front of her, its tip glowing; in the left the palm-sized beat-bell, a ring of faint light pulsing from it; a concentrated look, the lips moving in a chant.

纷争纪|z6a_lanvig.why: 极境的炉班头，守炉的人不披甲，第三格照 battle_pose 站在炉门前握火钳，穿炉脉的厚皮围裙；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_lanvig.battle: Defending the furnace chamber: the heavy leather apron with the hearth-vein mark belted over a chain-mail vest, thick leather gauntlets and forearm guards bound with copper wire, the goggles down, a small flame lamp at her belt. In her right hand the long fire tong held like a short spear across her body, her left hand raised flat to hold off the heat; planted low and wide, a stern look.

纷争纪|z6a_finke.why: 极境的陆舰舰长，链船人家出身，第三格照 battle_pose 压推杆掌舵，穿油布短褂那一身；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_finke.battle: Commanding on the chain-ship bridge: the oilcloth jacket buttoned to the throat over the fleet-blue shirt, a leather harness belt, the slate hung at her side, the register tucked away. Her right hand grips the long push-bar like a staff and her left points ahead; planted wide and low, a hard, commanding look.

纷争纪|z6a_solan.why: 极境的龙裔舵手，散裔村子出身，在擎天级坐了一百六十年，极境以上家境至多差一档，定三档：舵班旧皮甲加薄附魔甲片、新换的发光膝甲、炉纹、镶晶护臂，照旧光脚。
纷争纪|z6a_solan.battle: At the helm under attack, in the colossus helm crew's refitted harness: the old helm-crew leather armour reinforced with thin enchanted plates at the chest and shins, the knees patched three times, the new left knee guard bright with a fresh rune line glowing blue, the furnace badge stitched on the shoulder, crystal-set leather forearm guards, the brass seat-number tag at his neck, the boots hanging from his belt, bare feet planted on the copper plate. He grips two push-bars at once in his large hands, the muscles of his neck standing out, the slit eyes wide and unblinking; a hard, focused look.

纷争纪|z6a_dario.why: 极境的上弦手，管机兵不自己上阵，第三格照 battle_pose 握上弦钥匙待命，穿上弦场的旧皮围裙；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_dario.battle: Standing over a winder at an alarm: the leather apron belted tight with all its pockets buckled, leather gloves, forearm guards, the thick book strapped against his chest. In his right hand a long brass winding key held out in front of him, the left hand raised flat as if to hold a machine still; standing braced and leaning forward, a sharply focused look, no machine drawn.

纷争纪|z6a_herta.why: 共鸣的白骸驮水人，营里平常人家，一档：毡斗篷外头只添一件骨匠会刻号的骨片背心、一只骨护臂，缰绳、骨哨、短刀照旧。
纷争纪|z6a_herta.battle: On the road under threat, in a bone-white water carrier's gear: the grey felt cloak buttoned up with its bone buttons, a short vest of pale bone plates sewn onto felt and carved by the bone-wrights with number marks, NOT readable text, glowing faint white, one carved bone bracer on the right forearm, the rein-cloth wrapped on the left hand, the bone whistle at her lips, the great water skin strapped on her back.
