In her right hand a pack beast's lead rein and in her left a short bone-hilted cleaver held low, a pale line glowing along its edge; planted wide, a stern, watchful look.

纷争纪|z6a_loel.why: 夜翼信使，只练了投信没打过仗，第三格照 battle_pose 低飞护着信袋，穿送信人的皮短褂；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_loel.battle: Flying a message through danger: the leather jacket buckled, leather bracers, the letter pouch strapped tight across the chest. In his right hand a short dagger held low, the grey-brown wings half open and tilted behind him; crouched at the lip of a pit ready to launch, a keen, alert look.

纷争纪|z6a_pia.why: 共鸣的小斥候，信使家一家送一个，看着十六七、算未成年，一档：斥候那一身外头只添一块薄附魔肩甲、一只镶晶护臂，穿得严实，图袋、短刀、信号火把照旧。
纷争纪|z6a_pia.battle: Out on a scouting run into the dead land, in a junior scout's kit with a few issued pieces: the grey short tunic bound snug with copper-wire cuffs, a short leather jerkin with one thin enchanted shoulder plate whose ward line glows faint pale blue, a leather forearm guard set with one small lit crystal, copper-soled boots, a small ring badge on the shoulder, the flat map pouch at the belt, the blanket tied on her back like a pack. In her right hand a short knife held low and in her left a small signal torch; crouched low, ears forward, wide-eyed and serious.

纷争纪|z6a_afu.why: 灵格的前铃，信使家的女儿，跑得越快越好，二档只加轻的：薄附魔甲片的短甲、镶晶护臂、几枚晶匣，铜底靴和尾铃照旧。
纷争纪|z6a_afu.battle: Running the lead line into the dead land, in the lead bell's light scout kit: the grey tunic bound snug with copper-wire cuffs, a fitted short jerkin of leather over thin enchanted plates whose ward lines glow faint pale blue, crystal-set bracers, a short row of crystal cells at the belt, the copper-soled boots, a thin dark cloak streaming behind with a ring badge sewn at the shoulder. In her right hand the short knife drawn and held back, its edge faintly rune-lit, the brass bell on her tail ringing; mid-leap, ears flat, a fierce, daring look.

纷争纪|z6a_timu.why: 斥候队的厨子，第三格照 battle_pose 举铜锅护炉房，穿围裙那一身；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_timu.battle: Stepping up to defend the hearth-room: the grey tunic bound tight, a thick leather apron over it and leather forearm guards, the copper pot raised in one hand like a shield. In the other hand a heavy iron ladle held back like a club; planted wide with the ears flat, a protective, grim look.

纷争纪|z6a_grim.why: 极境的机兵匠头，在上弦场里抡锤，第三格照 battle_pose 站在机兵胸膛前，穿断崖一支的厚皮围裙；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6a_grim.battle: Defending the foundry: the heavy leather apron with the chisel row belted tight, thick leather gauntlets with copper wire at the cuffs, a smoked-glass goggle pulled down over his eyes, a brass whistle badge on the chest. In both hands a long-handled iron hammer held across his body, rune lines on its head glowing dull red, the beard swinging; planted wide and low, a stern, focused look.

纷争纪|z6b_ode.why: 一辈子没拿过刀的守火老人，档在顶上可他不靠装备，第三格照 battle_pose 捧着火往南走，穿那件补丁皮斗篷；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6b_ode.battle: Carrying the fire south: the patched hide cloak belted tight with a leather cord, the tinder pouch at his hip, hide boots wrapped with thongs for the long road. He never fights and holds no weapon; in both hands he carries a cupped handful of living fire. A calm, unbowed look.

纷争纪|z6b_xien.why: 九千年的传奇定在顶档，可九矛只猎兽、不替哪国打仗，脸是十七岁的少年，穿得严实、样子朴素：好料子不加装饰，霜银细甲、兽皮胸甲、白兽骨护臂上只有淡淡的霜文。
纷争纪|z6b_xien.battle: Keeping the night watch, in the Nine Spears' hunt harness, plain but of the finest make: the dark-grey hunting jacket buttoned to the throat over a fine shirt of frost-silver mail, a fitted cuirass of pale beast-hide plates with no ornament, faint frost runes glowing white along its edges, the deep slate wool cloak, bracers of carved white beast bone over the long sleeves, leather gloves, tall hide boots wrapped with thongs. He holds the white ash-wood ice spear in both hands, its tip sparkling with frost that never melts, aimed forward and slightly up; the silver staff is left planted in the ground behind him. A wide-awake, unflinching look, the eyes open, the mouth closed.

纷争纪|z6b_bor.why: 撼世传奇、焦砧家的钉匠，顶档：山铜鳞片的锻工挽具、符文缝透熔橙的光、护臂上嵌小铜钉，家传锤和长铜钉照旧。
纷争纪|z6b_bor.battle: Driving nails into a cliff face, in the Charred Anvil's own forge harness: a heavy jerkin of thick leather plated with dark orichalcum scales whose rune seams glow molten orange, broad rune-cut orichalcum pauldrons, forearm guards studded with small bronze nails whose heads glow, a coil of rope belted at the waist over the wool shirt. In his right hand he raises the heavy family hammer overhead, its face burning white-orange with rune fire; in his left he holds one long bronze nail point-forward as if setting it into the rock, a ring of light at its tip; the nail bundle stays on his back. Planted wide, a hard, focused look.

纷争纪|z6b_fenruis.why: 撼世传奇的守望者弓手，顶档照守望者的路子：白杉活木长成的胸甲带叶脉青光、镶晶骨护臂，箭头拖一缕发光的雾，白杉长弓照旧，背上不挂东西。
纷争纪|z6b_fenruis.battle: Shooting by ear on the wall, in a Watcher legend's war harness: the grey-green tunic under a fitted chest guard of pale white-fir wood grown into living lamellar, leaf-vein lines glowing soft green across it, bracers of carved bone set with clear crystals on both forearms, the hood thrown back, the braid pinned up. She holds the white-fir long bow fully drawn, the arrow pointing out at the unseen enemy, a thin trail of glowing mist curling from its head, the head turned slightly to the sound, the milky eyes open; nothing is slung on her back. A still, unflinching look.

纷争纪|z6b_luka.why: 撼世传奇的铃尾领车，跑得快是她的本事，顶档做成轻的：灰皮底下的精制附魔甲片、刻绳结印的胸甲、铜包指节的手套，铃绳上每只铃闪金色符文。
纷争纪|z6b_luka.battle: Pulling the line at a collapsing city wall, in a Bell-tail cart leader's legendary road harness: a fitted grey brigandine of fine enchanted plates under grey leather, its seams tracing pale-gold ward lines, a leather chest guard etched with a glowing rope-knot sigil, reinforced leather bracers and gloves with brass-capped knuckles, the cuffs bound. She holds a loop of the belled rope taut between both fists, pulling hard with the feet braced and the weight back; the bells ring along the line, each one flashing a small rune of pale gold. A fierce, determined look.

纷争纪|z6b_valkes.why: 撼世传奇的守门人，英雄往上不看家境，顶档：旧城门铁打的重甲片、门枢形的大肩甲、琥珀色护文，断门闩上缠发光符箍。
纷争纪|z6b_valkes.battle: Holding a gate against a wall of enemies, in the gate-keeper's legendary harness: the thick leather jerkin bolted with heavy plates of old gate iron at the shoulders, chest and forearms, the plates engraved with ward lines that glow deep amber, massive pauldrons shaped like great door hinges, a heavy belt with an iron gate-ring buckle, iron-shod boots. He holds the broken iron door bar across his body in both hands like a bar across a gate, amber rune bands glowing along its length, planted wide with the knees bent, taking the weight. A fierce, steady look.

纷争纪|z6b_salus.why: 轰狱的撼世传奇、拜恩身边砌墙拆墙的那一个，照铁狼年月轰狱雷锻铁、开城大锤那一路做顶档，角尖铁箍照旧。
纷争纪|z6b_salus.battle: Breaking and raising walls, in the Thunder-Gaol builder's war gear: the leather jerkin bolted with heavy plates of thunder-forged black iron at the shoulders and forearms, blue lightning-script flickering in their seams, an iron band at the left horn tip, a thick mason's apron of iron-studded hide, heavy iron-shod boots. He holds the long-handled hammer in both hands in front of his body with the pointed head up, faint blue lightning crawling over its iron head; planted wide; nothing is slung on his back. A hard, unhurried look.

纷争纪|z6b_karzein.why: 白骸敲钟点名的传奇，走路没有声音，样子一直朴素，顶档用在炭灰外套底下贴身的白骨胸甲和冷白的点名纹上，不挂会响的东西。
纷争纪|z6b_karzein.battle: Walking up to the wall in the dark, in a bell-keeper's plain war dress: the charcoal coat belted tight over a close-fitted cuirass of polished white bone plates carved with roll-call lines, NOT readable text, glowing cold white, a ragged short cloak of undyed grey wool over the shoulders, bracers of carved bone, soft-soled boots, nothing that rattles. He raises the iron pestle in his right hand, striking the small bronze bell held in his left, one clear note spreading in a thin ring of cold white light. A cold, unhurried look.

纷争纪|z6b_jani.why: 二十一岁的前铃斥候，原页没写位阶，照年纪和差事估共鸣；她不拿兵器，第三格照 battle_pose 蹲在绞盘上喊、摇尾铃；battle 照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6b_jani.battle: Leaping onto the capstan of the land ship: the grey scout tunic and trousers bound tight, leather bracers and gloves, the blanket tied round her waist. She holds no weapon; she shouts with one hand cupped at her mouth and rings the tail bell. A fierce, urgent look.

纷争纪|z6r_taule.why: 白骸骨匠会的英雄狼匠，第三格照 battle_pose 边走边吹唤狼骨；原句已经是铁狼牙甲片、刻令发白光的骨护臂，合铁狼年月狼匠的样子，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6r_taule.battle: Commanding the pack from the ridge: the pieced hide cloak thrown back, a short coat of iron-wolf plates riveted onto leather and cut with number marks, NOT readable text, enchanted bone bracers on both forearms etched with command lines glowing pale white, the bone tags rattling at his belt. He holds the shin-bone whistle to his lips with the right hand and the carving knife low in the left, mid-stride, a hard, intent look; no wolves are drawn.

纷争纪|z6r_tessma.why: 血誓祭司长，是祭司不是兵，第三格照 battle_pose 立着持祭刀、掌心一道红光；battle 照原句交回，只把开头的 blood oath 改成 oath-seal 免得过不了审核。
纷争纪|z6r_tessma.battle: On the rim of the pit, opening the oath-seal: the bone-white robe girded with a dark red sash, a short mantle of pale felt sewn with rows of small bone tags, enchanted bone bracers etched with faint red runes. She holds the short ritual knife in the crooked right hand, a thin line of red light glowing across that palm, the left hand lifted open; around her faint lines of pale light twist askew like warped glass. A slow, immovable look.

纷争纪|z6r_bertha.why: 号祭，不带刃，第三格照 battle_pose 举号吹；原句的刻唤号纹骨肩甲已对上这一档，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6r_bertha.battle: On the horn-altar in the dead land: the patchwork cloak thrown back over the shoulders and belted, a fitted dark leather bodice over the dress with enchanted bone plates at the shoulders etched with pale glowing call-lines, leather bracers. She raises the great bone-white horn to her lips with both hands, the bell flung high, the bell-shaped tips of her own horns glowing pale. A fierce, unbroken look.

纷争纪|z6r_lowry.why: 灵格顶上的图手，不是剑士，第三格照 battle_pose 迈步量路；原句是斥候短甲加刻护文的铜肩片，二档对得上，照原句交回。
纷争纪|z6r_lowry.battle: Over the line into the dead land: the grey scout tunic bound snug, the grey leather jerkin with enchanted brass plates at the shoulders etched with faint warding lines that glow pale blue, copper-wired cuffs, the blanket tied on his back like a pack, the map case strapped across his chest. He holds a short knife in the right hand, its tip dark with ink, and a brass winding key on a cord in the left; one long measured step forward, ears up, a steady, intent look.

纷争纪|z7_himmel.rank: 传奇·圣座（10899年以后，左臂的伤夜里发白）
纷争纪|z7_himmel.pref: 照原型（亚麻色长斗篷、蓝上衣，冒险者不套兵团那一身）
纷争纪|z7_himmel.why: 勇者，圣座的传奇，定这一纪顶上那一档；号角的年月冒险者照各人的原型穿，长斗篷和收腰蓝上衣不动，只把银胸甲、肩甲升成照他身量打的附魔银甲，刃上淡蓝的光照旧。
纷争纪|z7_himmel.battle: A hard night on the wall: the long cream cloak thrown back over the shoulders, its frayed hem stirring; over the fitted royal-blue tunic a silver breast-piece and light silver pauldrons forged to his measure, the finest work of the wall's last years, fine rune lines along their edges glowing pale blue and a small clear crystal set at the breastbone; silver-backed vambraces, the left sleeve buttoned tight over the faintly glowing white arm. He holds the broad sword upright in his right hand before him, the blue gem in its gold crossguard lit and the blade bright with a pale blue glow, and glances back over his shoulder counting heads; a calm, bright, determined stance.

纷争纪|z7_konrad.why: 补网人家出身的赤牌层书记，这一段守着抄桌不往上走，也不出手；原句灰袍袖套、墨壶口那一圈发光的墨线已是他上墙抄名字的样子，不打仗照原句交回。
纷争纪|z7_konrad.battle: A scribe on the wall in wartime: the grey library robe belted with the black sleeve-covers on, bare headed, a satchel of ledgers slung across the chest, the copper ink-pot at his belt with a thin glowing line of ink on its rim. He stands with a ledger open on his left forearm and a quill in his right hand, writing a list of names; he does not fight. A calm, intent look.

纷争纪|z7_shanse.why: 放牦牛人家的十五岁牧女，共鸣又穷，未成年档往低里判；牦牛毛短袍照旧，只添父亲留下的一只墙上旧弓手护臂（符文线暗了还在闪），箭头绕一缕风是她那一门刚起头的青风。
纷争纪|z7_shanse.battle: Out on the high pasture with a bad wind coming: the yak-wool tunic belted tight over leggings, a short hooded cloak of felted yak wool, leather bracers over the long sleeves, the left one an old wall-issue archer's bracer handed down from her father with a single dim rune line still flickering along it, the cattle-horn whistle at her belt. She holds the small birch bow with its twisted yak-hair string low in her left hand and an arrow in her right, a thin curl of wind turning around the arrowhead, the hair streaming sideways; a steady, intent look.

纷争纪|z7_melosa.why: 潮歌管航路的赛壬歌者，极境定三档；歌者照法袍的路子不穿甲，海青长袍照旧，加一件绣潮文、随歌声发亮的鲨皮短披肩和银贝喉饰，去掉原句里的船头免得画场景。
纷争纪|z7_melosa.battle: Singing the last song above the sunken sea: the long sea-green singer's robe belted tight, over it a close short mantle of silver-grey sharkskin stitched with pale tide script that lights up with her voice, a short oilcloth cape thrown back, the shell cuffs clicking and glowing a faint pearl-white, a slim gorget of silver and shell below the seaweed cord, bare feet braced. She stands upright with the white conch raised at her lips in her right hand, the silver markings on her neck blazing, the wind pulling her blue hair back; a resolute stare.

纷争纪|z7_ria.why: 老滩种盐田人家的女儿，共鸣又穷，定一档；深潮人家不烧魔晶，海草短褂照旧，只添贝片护腕和一件盐腌鲨皮短背心，量潮尺上的刻度带一点海绿的光。
纷争纪|z7_ria.battle: On the shoal as the tide turns against an attack: the seaweed-fibre tunic and trousers belted tight, a short vest of salt-cured sharkskin over the tunic, wrist guards of overlapping pale shell plates over her scaled forearms, a short salt-stone knife at the hip, the rolled leather tide-chart across her back. She grips the tide-marked measuring rod in her right hand like a short staff, its notches glowing a faint sea-green, knees bent, a thin curl of sea water winding around her ankles; a focused stare.

纷争纪|z7_osca.why: 段城三代弓手人家，灵格本二档，兵户穷该降，可南段弓手的附魔皮甲是墙上发下来、家里传了三代的，照号角的年月传下来补着穿的样子定二档，符文线暗了还在闪，晶槽换了一枚新魔晶；去掉垛口和身后的墙。
纷争纪|z7_osca.battle: Drawing in the dark: the south-wall archer's leather brigandine handed down three generations, laced tight over a dark-green quilted undercoat, its small inner plates patched and its old rune lines dim but still flickering blue-white, the polished leather pad on the right shoulder, old wall-issue bracers with a few dimmed rune lines and one fresh crystal lit in the left wrist socket, the open-faced iron helmet on. She draws the heirloom long bow to full, its back wrapped in three generations of leather bands, an arrow nocked and the string at her cheek, left foot forward; a hard narrowed stare along the arrow.

纷争纪|z7_bernt.why: 打箭头人家的老盾手，灵格近顶，当了三十多年兵，身上是墙上发的旧附魔皮甲补着穿，定二档；左肩那块软皮照旧，会亮的是号口那一圈符文，去掉垛口和石墙。
纷争纪|z7_bernt.battle: Blowing the call on the wall: the old enchanted leather brigandine of a former shield-man laced tight, its dim rune lines still flickering faintly, the soft replaced patch on the left shoulder, an oilcloth cape, an iron cap, bracers with a small brass wall-horn badge. He holds the long brass horn raised at his lips in both hands, the bell pointing up and out, the ring of runes around its bell glowing as the call sounds, the sagging shoulder braced; a sharp, wide-awake stare. The soft leather patch is on the left shoulder, on the viewer's right when he faces us, the same side as in the first panel.

纷争纪|z7_eisen.rank: 传奇·撼世（LVL 218），10899年到天灾、走上圣座
纷争纪|z7_eisen.pref: 照原型（角盔、深井旧锁甲、褪色红斗篷）
纷争纪|z7_eisen.why: 深井一支的斧战士，传奇顶档，照原型那一身不换样子，只让深井旧锁甲的领口下摆和铁肩甲带上深井的符文、发暗红的锻火光，斧背那一块敲平的地方也亮。
纷争纪|z7_eisen.battle: Holding the ground: the horned iron helmet with its nose guard pulled down, the old Deepwell chain shirt of dark close rings buckled tight, deep runes worked into its collar and hem glowing a dull forge-red, the heavy iron pauldrons etched with the same runes, iron-capped boots; the faded red cloak thrown over one shoulder; the small brass lamp lit at his belt. He grips the single-edged Deepwell axe in both hands across his body, its flattened back facing out and faintly lit, the feet planted wide, the brown beard braids hanging over the mail; an immovable, level stare.

纷争纪|z7_verdandi.rank: 传奇·天灾（约10940年吊桥上挡了三天三夜）
纷争纪|z7_verdandi.pref: 朴素（游侠旧装，披风破了又补）
纷争纪|z7_verdandi.why: 斩风之刃，风铃的开国女王，传奇顶档；她不爱叫东西留住，照朴素的路子，游侠旧装和破了又补的披风照旧，半身甲换成高原锻的附魔甲，不加一点装饰，只一道风纹发天青的光。
纷争纪|z7_verdandi.battle: Holding a bridge against a tide: over the worn ranger's jerkin a plain highland-forged enchanted half-plate cuirass of dull steel with a single pauldron and no ornament at all, only a thin wind-rune line along its edge glowing a pale sky-teal; the patched grey-and-green cloak whipped sideways by the wind, plain steel bracers, tall boots planted. She holds the long, very thin blade low in her right hand, the edge turned out, a gust spiralling visibly around it, the sky-teal braid streaming; a fierce, steady stare.

纷争纪|z7_yak.pref: 不靠装备（烧炭的粗布衣裳，不属于哪一边）
纷争纪|z7_yak.why: 十一里，没有阵营的传奇，档在顶上，可他一辈子穿补了又补的粗布衣裳，不靠甲，不硬穿；只让山铜长刀豁口里压成石的土和刃口带上光，去掉原句里烧黑的地面。
纷争纪|z7_yak.battle: Holding a line between two armies: the patched coarse tunic belted, bracers of rough leather, the sheepskin thrown back; he wears no armour and never has. He grips the notched thick-backed blade of mountain bronze in both hands across his body at waist height, the earth packed hard in its notch glowing a dull ember brown and a dark line of heat running the length of the edge, the feet planted wide; an unmoving, level stare.

纷争纪|z7_grim_legend.rank: 传奇·撼世（LVL 202，10993年止戈那一夜凝名）
纷争纪|z7_grim_legend.pref: 不打仗（匠头，吹哨叫机兵回来）
纷争纪|z7_grim_legend.why: 断崖一支的机兵匠头，那一夜到传奇，档在顶上，可他不打仗；照匠头的路子只加一件拿自家机兵外壳的铜钢片铆的护身甲，胸口嵌一枚弦钥和一颗亮着的魔晶，围裙、名册照旧，锤子的握法交给姿势句。
纷争纪|z7_grim_legend.battle: At the foundry floor: the heavy leather apron with the chisel row belted tight over a riveted brigandine of brass and steel plates cut from his own machines' casings, a winding key and a small lit magic crystal set at its breast, thick leather gauntlets with copper wire at the cuffs, a smoked-glass goggle pushed up, a brass whistle badge on the chest, the brass-cornered roster book at his belt. In his hand the long-handled iron hammer, rune lines on its head glowing dull red, the grey beard swinging; planted wide and low, a stern, focused look.

纷争纪|z7_osca_legend.rank: 极境（LVL 96，11003年盐滩泉眼那一夜凝名）
纷争纪|z7_osca_legend.why: 画的是凝名那一夜，极境定三档，兵户的穷到极境至多差一档，她当了十几年墙上叫得出名字的弓手，照三档写：成套的南段弓手附魔甲，符文重刻发稳光，护肩加刻符钢片，招牌是缠了三代皮条的长弓；去掉垛口和墙。
纷争纪|z7_osca_legend.battle: Drawing in the dark: a fitted south-wall archer's harness of dark enchanted leather over a dark-green quilted undercoat, its rune lines freshly recut and glowing a steady blue-white, the polished leather pad on the right shoulder reinforced with a rune-etched steel plate, bracers with bright crystals lit in their sockets, the open-faced iron helmet on. She draws the heirloom long bow to full, its back wrapped in three generations of leather bands, an arrow nocked and the string at her cheek, left foot forward; a hard narrowed stare along the arrow.

纷争纪|z7r_kovol.why: 亚蒙座下缝伤的祭司，英雄定四档；照祭司的路子不披甲赤脚，脚印斗篷是他的招牌，只把骨片护臂添成一副刻沙纹的骨喉甲和护臂，光照旧是白的。
纷争纪|z7r_kovol.battle: Opening the rite before the wounded god: the footprint cloak thrown back from the shoulders, its sand patches glowing faintly white along every seam, the plain sand-coloured linen robe belted tight with the rope belt, a gorget and bracers of white bone plates carved with fine ripple script that glows a pale sand-white, bare feet. A long white thread trails from the bone needle in his left hand. He sets the white bone staff to strike downward in his right hand, a still, merciful, unyielding look.

纷争纪|z7r_quitam.why: 血誓派首座，英雄顶上，第三格走 battle_pose（举头碗、指节敲碗沿，不带刃），原句黑漆鳞甲配暗红战祭袍已是这一档，照原句交回，只把碗沿那一处 blood red 换成 deep red，免得过审核时出事。
纷争纪|z7r_quitam.battle: Leading a hundred thousand beneath the siege temples: a long dark red war vestment over a coat of black lacquered scale, sculpted black pauldrons engraved with rows of bowls, the oath ribbons at his brow streaming behind, the eleven bowl rims at his throat glowing a dull deep red. He holds the black clay head bowl high in his left hand and strikes its rim with the knuckles of his right, a ring of red light spreading from it, a cold, commanding look.

纷争纪|z7r_rambold.why: 南段上弦场的弦长，极境定三档，原句铜片皮甲、机兵肩甲改的护肩和发光的绞柄已是这一档上弦手的样子，第三格走 battle_pose（横握长绞柄），照原句交回。
纷争纪|z7r_rambold.battle: Riding at the head of the risen machines: an oilcloth cloak over a leather brigandine riveted with brass plates and old clockwork parts, a pauldron made from a clockwork soldier's shoulder plate, the cuffs bound in copper wire, the string of rusted keys at his belt. He grips a long iron winding crank in both hands, its handle as long as his arm and its key-head glowing with a dull ash-grey light, a hard, set look.

萨尔维斯|sa1_hadwin.why: 灵格本是二档，逃难十年家底没了，可身上是黑石守门人家传的那一副旧铜皮甲，补了又补，手里是父亲的守门枪，不再往下降；二幕起左手戴学院给的铭环。
萨尔维斯|sa1_hadwin.battle: Ready to hold a line, in his family's old Blackstone gate-guard harness, patched through ten years on the road: a breastplate of copper-coloured pressed wolf hide polished smooth, pale silver dust in its plates giving a faint cold flash, the seven-ringed wall brand worn down to three rings; mismatched copper-hide pauldrons re-laced with rawhide; old beast-bone vambraces; leather gauntlets; a heavy grey wool cloak fastened at the throat; the plain pale silver name ring on his left hand faintly lit. He grips his father's very long gate spear in both hands, levelled forward, a small amber beast-core set in its dark iron socket glowing dully. Feet planted wide, a hard, calm look, the mouth shut.

萨尔维斯|sa1_meirece.rank: 灵格（LVL 68，北口那一夜凝名；约6150年到传奇）
萨尔维斯|sa1_meirece.why: 画的是北口站环心那一夜，还是灵格；矿工家的女儿，学院的人不披甲、不带法杖，只照这一段学院的样子加一件：左臂皮护腕上嵌一只施术的骸银圈，细光线从圈里展开。
萨尔维斯|sa1_meirece.battle: Standing as the centre of a ring: the grey robe with the sleeves tied back, the black cord drawn tight, a plain leather bracer on the left forearm set with a small bone-silver casting ring from which fine threads of cold white light unfold, the scroll of ring diagrams unrolled in her left hand. Her right hand is held out flat in front of her, palm down, the pale silver ring glinting. No weapon, no armour. A cold, focused look.

萨尔维斯|sa1_hedwig.why: 灵格本二档，三代重骑、母亲做过骑首，身上是王的重骑整套，加一档；招牌是冲起来甲片里一齐亮的冷光，最里那一圈烙印她自己刮掉了。
萨尔维斯|sa1_hedwig.battle: Ready to charge, in the full royal Blackstone heavy-cavalry harness her family wore for three generations: breastplate, pauldrons, tassets and greaves of copper-coloured pressed wolf-hide scales with pale silver dust worked into every plate, the whole suit flashing cold white from shoulder to shin as she moves; the seven-ringed wall brand on the chest with the innermost ring scraped away by a knife; a copper wolf-pelt cloak flung back from her shoulders; copper-scaled gauntlets; the heavy-cavalry helm on her head with the visor up. She grips the long lance in both hands, levelled forward, its old iron head bound to the shaft with bands of Blackstone silver. The feet planted wide, a fierce, determined look.

萨尔维斯|sa1_lise.why: 九岁的孤女，没成年，不打仗，抱着钥匙数门，穿得严实，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa1_lise.battle: Braced for the night of the ring: the short coat buttoned to the chin, a wool scarf wound up over her chin, fingerless wool mittens, boots laced tight; she carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa1_elio.why: 启源的粮官，三代种麦的人家，守仓不拿剑，仓钥和账本就是他的家什，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa1_elio.battle: Standing guard: the white-grey coat buttoned, a leather apron, sleeves tied back. He grips the iron key in his right fist like a weapon, feet planted, shoulders squared; he carries no sword. A hard, immovable look.

萨尔维斯|sa1_doni.why: 共鸣一档，车队头家里过得去，在车夫褂外头罩一件换来的铜皮狼皮背心，挂一串会亮的车铃当报信的护符，鞭梢编进一截旧雷皮；崛起（上）还没有辉塔，用的是诸国剩下的兽材。
萨尔维斯|sa1_doni.battle: Ready to hold the road, in the few pieces a carter can buy: the oilcloth smock buttoned to the throat under a short vest of copper-coloured pressed wolf hide traded off a highland guard; leather gloves, sleeves tied back, boots laced tight; a string of small brass cart bells across the vest, each faintly lit copper as a warning charm. She grips a long cart whip in her right hand, the lash coiled over her shoulder, its braided tip of old thunder-beast hide giving off tiny sparks, and braces the other fist on her hip; a stubborn, fierce look.

萨尔维斯|sa1_lucilla.why: 十七岁的编年院学徒，没成年，下城抄书人家的女儿，手上连铭环也没有，不打仗，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa1_lucilla.battle: Ready for the field: the grey robe belted tight over a dark long-sleeved tunic and trousers, leather bracers, boots laced. She holds the blank roll tight against her chest with the left arm and the copper pen up in her right hand like a dart; a sharp, determined look, the mouth shut.

萨尔维斯|sa1_dagobert.why: 原页没写位阶，北口那一夜被灵格六十二的哈德温一枪挑下，估灵格；灰须公爵的孙子，守着高地最深的一座矿，家里打了四十六年仗，世家加两档，量身打的铜皮甲配黑石银狼牙盔、嵌活曜核的剑。
萨尔维斯|sa1_dagobert.battle: Charging dress, in the made-to-measure war harness of the Greybeard heir: full plate of copper-coloured pressed wolf hide, thick with pale silver dust that flashes cold, every edge trimmed in polished Blackstone silver, a copper wolf head embossed on the breastplate; the whole copper-wolf pelt worn over it, the wolf-head helm pulled on with its Blackstone silver fangs bared, the pelt streaming back from the shoulders and faintly steaming as if fresh-skinned; copper-scaled gauntlets. He grips a long broad sword of old iron in his right hand, held high, a living red-brown beast-core set in its crossguard glowing hot, and a round shield painted with the copper wolf head on his left arm. A savage, shouting look.

萨尔维斯|sa2_eberhard.why: 共鸣一档，下城三代铸灯匠家，干活的皮围裙外头只添自己浇的铜护臂和一盏不用点的灯，接着辉塔刚升起来的光。
萨尔维斯|sa2_eberhard.battle: Ready to hold the street, in his forge gear and the brass he cast himself: the burn-holed leather apron strapped on, its brass buttons rubbed bright; thick leather gloves to the elbow under a pair of cast-brass vambraces of his own make, fine white lines running along them that glow with the new tower light; a leather cap; one of his flameless brass lamps hung at the belt, shining cold white with no wick. He grips a heavy forging hammer in both hands, held across his body, its head banded with brass. Feet planted wide, a hard, stubborn look.

萨尔维斯|sa2_ilse.why: 灵格本二档，荫外坡上的猎户村过得紧，降一档；毛朝里的狼皮短褂外头只添一只换来的封核护臂，荫外用得上。
萨尔维斯|sa2_ilse.battle: Hunting the pack outside the glow: the copper wolf-hide coat buttoned with the fur inward, a hood of the same pelt pulled up, leather gloves; on her left forearm the old string-scored bracer, and over the right a single second-hand outland bracer of hardened hide with a small sealed beast-core under a brass cap at the wrist, glowing faint white; a skinning knife at the belt, the quiver on her back. She draws the hard bow with an arrow nocked, the string at her cheek, feet wide; a fierce, calm look.

萨尔维斯|sa2_rupert.why: 共鸣的学徒，猎户家的孩子，学院的人不披甲，只加一件：灰袍下摆和袖口拿白线绣一圈环印，在塔光里亮。
萨尔维斯|sa2_rupert.battle: Ready for the ring: the grey robe belted tight with the sleeves pushed back, its hem and cuffs stitched with a ring-sigil of fine white lines that glow with the tower light, the jacket under it, leather gloves on the right hand only. He holds both hands out in front of him, fingers spread, the ring on his left hand glinting; he carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa2_adrian.why: 英雄不看家境，日轮骑士量身的白甲加金面日轮盾正是这一档；甲上的金一片一片拆去换药，只剩一线，是他的故事，照留。
萨尔维斯|sa2_adrian.battle: Ready to hold the west gate, in the Sun knight's white plate fitted to him: breastplate, pauldrons and greaves of white steel, a sun-wheel engraved on the breast that glows soft gold, the gold once inlaid along every plate edge scraped off bit by bit to buy medicine until only a faint gold line remains; a white tabard with a plain sun disc; a white cloak torn at the hem; white steel gauntlets. He holds the gold-faced sun shield on his left arm braced forward, its scratched face blooming a wide ring of golden light, and the long royal sword in his right hand pointed down. Feet planted wide, a hard, immovable look.

萨尔维斯|sa2_theo.why: 灵格的信使，两边都放行，什么兵器都不拿；只加一件：铜信筒的箍上嵌一颗封核，荫外跑信用得着。
萨尔维斯|sa2_theo.battle: On the run: the wolfskin vest buttoned, a short hood of wolf fur over his ears, leather gloves, the leg wraps pulled tight, the brass tube strapped to his chest, a band near its whittled wooden stopper set with a small sealed beast-core glowing faint white. He leans forward in a sprinting stance with one arm swung back; a fierce, determined look. He carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa2_cassian.why: 极境三档，东方军团长一身成套的灰甲，在荫外打城，甲上嵌封核；原页写他不带剑、带信囊，原句里那把短剑拿掉，招牌是信囊和手上转开的环印。
萨尔维斯|sa2_cassian.battle: Ready to command, in the eastern legion commander's full grey plate: a fitted grey breastplate, pauldrons and vambraces with fine bone-silver rune-lines along every plate edge, a sealed beast-core under a brass cap on the back of each vambrace glowing white; the grey-blue cloak with the ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem embroidered on the chest; no sword, only the leather letter pouch slung across the chest, a letter sealed with a ring-sigil in wax glinting at its mouth. He stands upright with his bare right hand extended in a command, the pale silver name ring on it lit and a small ring-sigil of cold white light turning open above the palm. A calm, stern look.

萨尔维斯|sa2_berengar.why: 原页没写位阶，日轮认冠不认人，他是试冠试上的，估灵格；王家加一档，日轮白甲一身，甲上的金跟儿子一样拆去换药；这一格是交冠交剑的那一夜，不出手。
萨尔维斯|sa2_berengar.battle: Resolved for the last night, in the Sun king's white war harness: a white steel breastplate and pauldrons over fine mail, the gold once inlaid along their edges scraped away for the city's medicine like his son's, only a faint gold line left; a white surcoat with a gold sun disc on the chest that glows soft gold; a heavy white cloak; white leather gloves. The crown is removed and held out in his right hand, a faint ring of gold light around it. His left hand rests on the hilt of the sheathed king's sword at his belt. A calm, resolved smile.

萨尔维斯|sa2_rupert_legend.rank: 灵格（LVL 66，北口外那座塔升起那一夜凝名；约6690年到传奇）
萨尔维斯|sa2_rupert_legend.why: 画的是凝名那一夜，那时还是灵格；画塔心的人不披甲、不带兵器，赤脚站环听地脉，只加一件：资深学者的灰袍下摆和袖口绣几圈环印白线，在塔光里亮。
萨尔维斯|sa2_rupert_legend.battle: Standing in the tower core, barefoot: the senior scholar's grey robe belted tight with the sleeves pushed back, its hem and cuffs embroidered with rings of fine white sigil lines that glow with the tower light, the fur-collared jacket under it, leather gloves on the right hand only. He holds both hands out in front of him, fingers spread, the ring on his left hand glinting; he carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa3_marius.why: 灵格本二档，摆渡人家出身，可客星城卫士的刻纹白甲和骸银长戟是宫里发的整套，照宫里的档，家境不加不减。
萨尔维斯|sa3_marius.battle: Ready on guard, in the sky city's palace-guard harness: full white plate with a ring of fire crossed by two keys engraved on the breastplate, the engraving glowing cold white, matching white pauldrons and greaves, a white tabard, the helm on with the visor up, white gauntlets; nine hall keys on a ring at his belt. He holds the halberd in both hands, levelled forward, its head sheathed in pale bone-silver with a faint white sheen along the edge. Feet planted wide, a hard, immovable look.

萨尔维斯|sa3_tisha.why: 十一岁跑腿的孩子，没成年，不打仗，光脚、白麻短衣、铜铃，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa3_tisha.battle: Ready to run a message: the white linen tunic and leggings, the blue sash tied tight, the little bell silenced with a knot of cloth, her hair tied back; she carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa3_frida.why: 极境三档，神殿给辨渊师的一身成套行头，不披甲，招牌是那盏镜湖玻璃罩的灯；兼修学城的镜光，左臂添一只封核护臂。
萨尔维斯|sa3_frida.battle: Ready to face a beast, in the temple examiner's full field kit: the deep grey robe with the sleeves bound at the cuff by leather cords, over it a long apron of thick dark beast hide stitched with fine bone-silver ward lines that glow faint white; elbow-length gloves of the same hide; on the left forearm a bone-silver vambrace with a small sealed beast-core at the wrist, ready to throw a flash of mirror light; the leather case of knives and vials at her hip. She holds the pale silver lamp high in her right hand, its clear lake-glass shade throwing a cold white light, and a short knife in her left. Feet planted, a calm, fixed look.

萨尔维斯|sa3_calista.why: 极境，北辰塔顶守光的学者，不披甲，狐皮斗篷和铜星筒就是她的家什，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa3_calista.battle: Ready for the night watch: the deep blue robe belted tight, the fox cloak fastened, leather gloves, a woollen hood up. She holds the brass star-tube out in front of her in both hands like a staff, feet planted; she carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa3_gaius.why: 极境三档，深矿人家出身到了极境只差一截，守北军团阵长整套的灰甲、熊皮斗篷，8311年曜核还有新货，护臂嵌核；招牌是掺着银光的铭环。
萨尔维斯|sa3_gaius.battle: Ready to hold the frost line, in the Northern Guard's full grey plate: a fitted grey breastplate, pauldrons and greaves with bone-silver rune-lines along every plate edge holding a thin white glow in the cold, a sealed beast-core under a brass cap on the left vambrace; the frosted bearskin cloak worn fur-out over it; a legion helmet; a round shield on his left arm painted with the ring of fire and two crossed keys; the pale silver name ring on the left hand with the missing fingertips (on the viewer's right when they face us), shining with a silvery light. He grips the legion short sword in his right hand held low, its blade forged in blue fire with a faint blue sheen. Feet planted wide, a hard, stubborn look.

萨尔维斯|sa3_gunnar.why: 灵格本二档，霜线外最后一个猎户，村子空了、家里穷，降一档；白狐皮猎装照旧，只添拿自己在原边挖的银打的箭头和缠弓的银丝。
萨尔维斯|sa3_gunnar.battle: Ready to hunt, in his white fox hunting suit worn fur-outward, the hood up and the face half covered by a scarf of white fur, mittens pushed off to bare fingers on the string; the old antler-backed bow strung with deer sinew, its grip bound with silver wire he dug himself; arrows tipped with raw pale silver from the edge of the plain, faintly cold-shining. He draws the antler bow with an arrow nocked, the string at his cheek, feet planted; a calm, flat look.

萨尔维斯|sa3_steward.why: 原页没写位阶，宫里几户人家世代出的总管，管宴不打仗，侍从腰上只挂册子和笔，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa3_steward.battle: Ready for a crowded night: the white satin robe with the sleeves pinned back, the sash tight; he carries no weapon.

萨尔维斯|sa4_vesla.why: 极境本三档，可她是判词下来西迁的魔族染匠，生在人家里的魔族没有战装，鞭只打车辕；衣甲不硬加，招牌是亮着靛蓝的长鞭和一万多个名字的名册，木牌不藏。
萨尔维斯|sa4_vesla.battle: Dressed to lead a column west: the long indigo-dyed smock belted tight, the sleeves rolled to show her blue hands; over it a dark travelling cloak she dyed deep blue herself, the hood down; leather bracers; sturdy boots; the carved wooden tag in plain view at her throat, a ring-sigil burnt into it; the thick ledger of more than ten thousand names at her belt, its page edges glowing faint indigo. She holds the long driver's whip beside her, the lash curling at her side, a thin line of deep blue light running along it.

萨尔维斯|sa4_julian.why: 启源的魔族木匠，没有战装，不打仗，拿手里的木槌护人，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa4_julian.battle: Dressed for the road with the column: the smock belted, a leather apron, thick leather gloves over the scaled hands, the tool belt still on. He grips a heavy wooden mallet in both hands, held across the body.

萨尔维斯|sa4_nyra.why: 灵格本二档，西迁的魔族没有战装，白烛祭司只救治送终，白麻袍和白蜡烛就是她的一身，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa4_nyra.battle: Dressed to tend the wounded on a march: the white robe belted tight with the skirt tied up, a dark travelling cloak with the hood down, the bandage bag at her belt, sturdy shoes. A lit white candle in her left hand, a roll of bandage in her right.

萨尔维斯|sa4_sextus.why: 灵格顶上的百人长，二档；军团闲了两百多年，一身旧甲、环火双钥磨白的斗篷，新换的配件骸银薄了，招牌是军团里一代代传下来的嵌核旧短剑。
萨尔维斯|sa4_sextus.battle: On duty, in the idle legion's old kit: a worn grey legion cuirass with matching pauldrons over the grey tunic, bone-silver rune-lines worn almost dull along its plates, the newer fittings thinner than the old; the grey-blue cloak with the ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem on the chest worn white; a plain open helm; the pale silver name ring on his hand. A short legion sword drawn in his right hand and held low, an old beast-core handed down the ranks set in its pommel and glowing faint amber; the large water flask at his belt.

萨尔维斯|sa4_tino.why: 七岁的魔族孩子，没成年，不打仗，跟着母亲走在队伍中间，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa4_tino.battle: Dressed for the long road: the wool tunic belted with a cord, a hooded brown cloak, wool leggings, sturdy small boots, a small bundle on his back, a short walking stick in one hand.

萨尔维斯|sa5_priska.why: 灵格本二档，裂影之地谷里教字的人，家里穷，降一档；谷里没有甲，深灰麻衣加补了十一回的旧斗篷，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa5_priska.battle: Dressed for a long road: the patched cloak fastened at the throat with the hood down, a leather belt, sturdy walking boots, the leather tube slung on her back. In her right hand a stout walking staff planted before her; her left hand is open at her side.

萨尔维斯|sa5_berthold.why: 灵格二档，北口守门人家境中等，一套守门人代代传、改合身的旧半甲，环印暗了一半，领甲上一颗旧封核还亮着；招牌是那根带霜的铁箍门闩。
萨尔维斯|sa5_berthold.battle: Dressed to hold a gate, in the north-pass warden's old kit refitted to him: the thick grey wool robe belted tight with its leather shoulder patches, over it a grey steel half-cuirass and gorget handed down among the gatekeepers, the ring-sigils along its edges dimmed by half and one old sealed core at the gorget still glowing faint white; rune-etched steel vambraces; the ring of iron keys at his belt. He holds a heavy iron-bound wooden gate bar across the body in both hands, its iron bands rimed with frost and lit by a thin cold white line. A stern look, the mouth closed.

萨尔维斯|sa5_quintilian.why: 共鸣的宫廷侍从，宫里传话的人家，侍从腰上不许带东西，不打仗，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa5_quintilian.battle: Dressed for a crisis: the white satin robe tied up at the waist with a plain cord, dark riding trousers beneath, the cuffs bound back, sturdy shoes. He holds a short brass-capped palace staff across his body in both hands.

萨尔维斯|sa5_tarson.why: 极境三档，退役的老旗官，偏好朴素，只留着当兵时的旧甲旧盾，环印暗了一半、空核槽拿家里的旧核补；招牌是那杆刻满痕的长矛，矛头下系一截褪色的旗布。
萨尔维斯|sa5_tarson.battle: Dressed to hold a line, in an old soldier's kept-over kit: the washed-out grey-blue legion cloak tied with the standard-bearer's quick-release knot, its faded emblem on the back; under it his own worn legion cuirass and pauldrons, the ring-sigils along the plates dimmed by half, one empty core socket refilled with an old family core glowing faint amber; a plain open helm; an old round legion shield on the left arm, its painted emblem faded. He grips the long notched spear in his right hand, held forward at chest height, a strip of faded grey-blue standard cloth knotted below the head and every notch on the shaft holding a faint cold white glow. No ornament.

萨尔维斯|sa5_maggie.why: 共鸣一档，商队的半身人女厨，围裙外头只添一件商队护车的旧皮背心，招牌是那口热锅底挡得住术光的黑铁锅。
萨尔维斯|sa5_maggie.battle: Dressed to defend the wagons: the grease-stained apron tied tight over an old padded caravan-guard leather vest with a faded brass company badge, leather gloves, the sleeves rolled, the skirt tied up short, sturdy boots. She holds the black iron pot up in front of her as a shield, its thrice-patched bottom glowing a warm orange-red as if fresh off the fire, a faint ring of heat-light spreading across it to turn spell-light aside; a heavy iron ladle in her other hand raised like a club.

萨尔维斯|sa5_inriel.why: 灵格二档，除名时带走的只有守望者停在夏色的林色衣、养熟的长弓和刮了刻纹的刀，添一件同色的叶鳞皮甲，氏族记号也刮了；招牌是箭过处的那一道黑线。
萨尔维斯|sa5_inriel.battle: Dressed to shoot, in what she kept of the warden's gear: the warden's living-cloth tunic and short cloak, frozen in summer green since the day she was struck off, tied close; over the tunic a fitted vest of overlapping leaf-shaped leather scales in the same green, its clan marks scraped off; leather bracers and a leather glove on the drawing hand; the quiver of unmarked arrows at her back. She holds the long well-seasoned bow at full draw, the arrow aimed to the viewer's right, a thin line of black trailing from its head. The elf ear on the viewer's left is the blunt one, its point lost to the old wound, shorter than the long pointed ear on the viewer's right.

萨尔维斯|sa6_felix.why: 共鸣的塔林学徒，修灯匠家的小儿子，不打仗，灰袍、阵图笔和墨壶就是他的一身，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa6_felix.battle: Not a fighter, dressed for a crisis: the grey robe belted tight, a satchel of rolled drawings across his chest, the ink pot at his belt, sturdy shoes. He holds a long drawing pen like a pointer in one hand and a sheet in the other.

萨尔维斯|sa6_beronica.why: 灵格，九十五岁教算账的老学者，不打仗，旧黑袍、石板和账本就是她的一身，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa6_beronica.battle: Dressed for a crisis: the old black robe belted, a heavy dark travelling cloak over it with the hood down, sturdy walking shoes, a stout walking staff in one hand. The slate is held against her chest like a shield, the account book at her waist.

萨尔维斯|sa6_kelsas.pref: 平日朴素，猎期那一天唯一一回披甲
萨尔维斯|sa6_kelsas.why: 圣座的传奇，帝国最强的大魔导，平日一件没有徽记的长袍；这一格是猎期那一天的暗金法阵重甲、星空披风、悬冠和贯穹，带兵器参考图，已是这一纪顶上那一档，照第三格姿势句，battle 照原句交回。
萨尔维斯|sa6_kelsas.battle: The day of the dragon hunt, the one day he armed himself, in the same figure as the great frieze: heavy dark-gold plate engraved all over with fine magic circles and diagram lines, a long cloak that is a field of night sky full of small stars, the white-gold hair loose over the shoulders, a plain thin gold crown floating a hand's breadth above his head and touching nothing. With both hands he levels the dragon-hunting swordspear Vault-Piercer diagonally upward, exactly the weapon in the weapon reference pictures: a weapon half again as tall as he is, its head a long, broad, tapering sword-blade of aged dark gold and bronze as long as his whole body, with a small cross-guard where the blade meets a long cord-wrapped shaft, a faint crackle of pale lightning along the blade; the face is fully visible, calm, far-looking.

诸国期|zg1_erna.why: 共鸣本是一档，灰篱镇埋人的穷人家，只在粗布裙外头加一件旧兽皮护胸，装备的光落在祝过的白绳、白石圈和她刻的名字上。
诸国期|zg1_erna.battle: Ready to dig in, in the few blessed things a grave-digger can get: the grey-brown dress belted tight with the hemp rope, the old cloak knotted back over the shoulders; over the dress a stiff chest guard of thick old beast hide laced at the sides; leather wraps on the forearms, an altar-blessed white cord wound round the left wrist and shining softly; a string of small white grave pebbles knotted at the belt, each glowing faintly pale. She grips the iron spade in both hands, the blade up and forward at chest height, a name carved on its face glowing soft silver-white. A steady, set look.

诸国期|zg1_cyril.why: 见习祭司，不带兵器，第三格照姿势句画提灯的样子，祭袍就是他的战装，不加甲。
诸国期|zg1_cyril.battle: Carrying the lamps up at night: the grey-white robe hitched to the knee with the rope belt, a woolen scarf over the shoulders. In his right hand a long lamp hook with a lit lantern swung from its tip, held out in front; the wick bag hangs at his hip. A frightened, determined look; he carries no weapon.

诸国期|zg1_greta.why: 共鸣，高地石匠人家，工衣外头只添一块黄岩兽壳护胸，招牌是她自己的兽骨大锤，凿过的纹发暗赭光。
诸国期|zg1_greta.battle: Ready to smash a gate, in a mason's gear with one piece of beast plate: the canvas smock belted tight over its leather knee and elbow patches; across the chest a salvaged guard of yellow-rock beast shell plates riveted to a leather backing, one plate chiselled with a ward pattern whose grooves glow dull ochre; leather bracers on both forearms, the chisel belt cinched. She grips the big yellow-rock beast-bone hammer in both hands, the head up behind her shoulder, the haft wound with the old towel, thin amber lines lighting along the seams of the bone head. A fierce, set look.

诸国期|zg1_corbin_legend.why: 传奇顶档，可他一辈子空手、只穿城里给的那件旧皮外套，本事全在岩息和十三枚铜牌上，照姿势句不加甲。
诸国期|zg1_corbin_legend.battle: Ready to grapple: the short old hide coat belted tight, the sleeves pushed up, thick leather wraps round both fists and forearms. He carries no weapon: the twelve engraved copper tags glow a dull ember red at his chest, and he stands wide-legged with both bare hands open and low, ready to seize. A heavy, set look.

诸国期|zg1_corbin.why: 极境本是三档，可他是判了关的矿工，空手斗士，不带兵器不披甲，照姿势句，皮外套和铜牌照旧。
诸国期|zg1_corbin.battle: Ready to grapple a wolf: the short old hide coat belted tight, the sleeves pushed up, thick leather wraps round both fists and forearms, the blank copper tags at his chest. He carries no weapon and stands wide-legged with both bare hands open and low. A heavy, set look.

诸国期|zg1_runa.why: 启源的铜匠女儿，不是打仗的人，照姿势句拿錾子守铺子，不加甲。
诸国期|zg1_runa.battle: Ready to defend her shop: the burned apron tied tight, leather gloves on, the cap pulled low. She holds the longest chisel in her right hand like a short blade, held forward at waist height, the other six still in the belt holster; the tag hangs at her neck. A fierce, wary look.

诸国期|zg1_bode.why: 共鸣的村里屠户，围裙底下添一件自己剔下的野猪皮坎肩，亮的是守夜祷法要的那一截白烛和祝过的白绳。
诸国期|zg1_bode.battle: Ready to hold his ground, in what a village butcher can get: the oily leather apron tied tight over a thick boar-hide jerkin cut from a beast he jointed himself, the bristles left on at the shoulders; thick leather wraps on both forearms; a stub of white candle burning in a small tin cup hooked at his belt, a soft warm glow around it; an altar-blessed white cord tied round the right wrist, shining softly. He grips the short boning knife in his right hand, held low and forward, the notched blade carrying a thin clean pale light, the other hand open to guard. A heavy, steady look.

诸国期|zg1_rowena.why: 见习祭司，靠沙漏和祷式，不带兵器，照姿势句，祭袍不改。
诸国期|zg1_rowena.battle: Ready to hold her ground: the white robe hitched at the waist with a belt, a short travelling cloak on, the sleeves tied back. Both hands raise the cracked wax-sealed hourglass high in front of her like a shield; the tally board stays at her belt. A frightened, firm look; she carries no weapon.

诸国期|zg1_brigid.why: 未成年、启源、樵夫家的女儿，干活衣服外头只添一件不着火的旧火鬃狼皮短披，亮的是她的暗红火把。
诸国期|zg1_brigid.battle: Carrying fire, in her work clothes and one bartered piece: the homespun tunic belted with a hemp rope, the sleeves rolled, leg wraps tight, thick leather gloves; over the shoulders a short worn cape of patchy fire-mane wolf hide that will not catch flame, small sparks flicking off its fur when she moves. On her back the wooden frame loaded with a bundle of resin torches; in her right hand a lit pine torch held forward, burning a deep dark red; the axe hung in a loop at the belt. A fierce, set look, the eyes open and the mouth shut.

诸国期|zg1_lothern.why: 启源的守望者，王庭发的斗篷长弓就是底子，一档只添一件守望者的东西：古树皮压的护臂，刻纹发青光；照姿势句半张弓不放箭。
诸国期|zg1_lothern.battle: Ready on the line, in a young Warden's kit: the grey-green cloak pinned back at the shoulders over the plain tunic; on both forearms Warden's bracers of pressed ancient-tree bark, their carved leaf lines holding a faint pale green glow; a soft leather guard on the draw hand; the quiver full at his belt. He holds the long bow drawn half-way, the string back halfway to his cheek with no arrow loosed, a thin stir of green wind along the string, the bow limb scorched black from fire. A still, watchful look.

诸国期|zg1_orik.why: 启源的点灯人，黑布衣裳外头只加一块硬皮护肩和一袋月银末，招牌是杆头那一团冷白的白火。
诸国期|zg1_orik.battle: Ready to carry fire through the dark, in a lamplighter's kit with one guard's piece: the black clothes belted tight, the oilcloth cape tied back; a single hardened leather shoulder guard strapped on the left, branded with Pinegate's lamp mark; a leather glove on the left hand; at the belt an oil flask and a small sealed pouch of pale-silver dust glinting through its weave. He holds the lamp pole forward in both hands, the small fire pot at its brass head flaring with a cold pale-silver white flame, the short chopping knife still in his belt. A tense, bright-eyed look.

诸国期|zg1_oldcount.why: 年轻时亲手斩过铁皮狼的高地伯爵，估极境，一身成套的铜皮甲，招牌是冠上那颗自家斩的核和认主的家徽；人严，不加金饰。
诸国期|zg1_oldcount.battle: Armoured in the house harness of Cleftstone: a bronze-hide lamellar cuirass pressed from bronze-wolf hide over the dark wool tunic, matching bronze-plated pauldrons and vambraces; the cast bronze house badge with its beast head fixed at the breast, the core dust in it glowing a faint warm gold; the long dark cloak thrown back; the iron crown on his head, its iron-grey beast core lit with a slow cold glow; a round shield slung at his back, its boss set with a smaller iron-grey core. His right hand rests on the hilt of a plain heavy broadsword at his hip; his left hangs open. A cold, set look.

诸国期|zg1_countson.why: 十二岁的孩子，照姿势句拿木杖站岗，穿得严实，不加甲。
诸国期|zg1_countson.battle: Standing watch: the charcoal tunic belted, the short cloak pinned back, leather gloves on. He holds a small wooden practice staff upright beside him with both hands, the feet planted, a brave, set look.

诸国期|zg2_isca.why: 十一岁的散裔孩子，不带兵器，照姿势句裹着父亲的大斗篷站着，不加甲。
诸国期|zg2_isca.battle: Her standing-ground clothes: the big hooded cloak pulled tight and held closed with her fist at the chest, the hood up, a single reverse-growing dark scale hanging on a hemp cord at her neck; shoes tied tight. She stands straight with her feet planted, chin up, eyes wide open and facing forward, the mouth closed.

诸国期|zg2_viro.why: 灵格，猎鳞学派出来的学徒，学派给的硬皮甲加几块龙鳞皮改合身，领口底下压不住的那一点赤光是她藏的血脉。
诸国期|zg2_viro.battle: Her hunting gear, the full kit of a scale-hunters' school: a hard boiled-leather armour coat laced up to the chin, reinforced at the chest and sides with overlapping plates of dark drake hide, the school's mark burnt into the collar; leather bracers; a studded shoulder guard capped with one dull green drake scale; the hood of a dark cloak up; beneath the high collar a faint red glow, barely hidden. The short curved single-edged knife held low in the right hand with the edge turned down, a thin cold gleam along it, the left hand open, the brass cup still hanging at the belt; knees bent, the weight forward, the cold ice-blue eyes fixed ahead.

诸国期|zg2_roadman.why: 英雄不看家境，一身量身打的钢甲，可他只让人记住剑，不要纹样、不嵌宝石，光只在重剑的剑压上。
诸国期|zg2_roadman.battle: His fighting gear, made to measure and left plain: a fitted harness of dark grey steel plates over fine mail, breastplate, pauldrons and vambraces with no crest, no engraving and no gems; heavy leather gloves; the faded traveller's cloak thrown back over the shoulders. The plain greatsword drawn and held in both hands low across the body with the point down toward the right, a heavy grey shimmer of pressure rippling along its bare edge, the empty leather-wrapped scabbard left on his back; legs wide and planted, the face expressionless and fixed ahead.

诸国期|zg2_sibel.why: 祭火院的祭司，院里不拔刀，照姿势句拿火钳夹着火柴，粗麻袍和围裙不改。
诸国期|zg2_sibel.battle: Her fighting gear: the scorched apron tied tight over the robe, thick leather gloves, a leather cap, the iron fire tongs held out forward in both hands like a short spear with a glowing log gripped in them; feet planted, the brows drawn together and the mouth closed.

诸国期|zg2_jaro.why: 灵格，谷底城最好的年轻猎雷人，身上不带铁，一身改合身的雷皮，雷纹和骨刀上的紫电就是会亮的那两样。
诸国期|zg2_jaro.battle: His hunting gear, all hide and bone and no iron: the storm-patterned hide cloak thrown back, its lightning pattern glowing purple; a close vest of layered thunder-wolf hide over the dark shirt, its stripes crawling with faint violet light; thunder-hide bracers laced with sinew over the sleeves; nail-less soft boots. The bone knife held low in the right hand with thin violet lightning running along its edge, the left hand spread open as if reading the air, small sparks jumping between the fingers; knees bent; the face tense and bright, the mouth closed.

诸国期|zg2_finny.why: 鞣皮匠，照姿势句拿刮皮刀和兽皮挡着，干活的衣服加一件皮坎肩，不改。
诸国期|zg2_finny.battle: Her fighting gear: the oilcloth apron tied tight over a leather jerkin and thick leather gloves, the hide-scraping knife held low in the right hand and a tough stretched hide gripped in the left like a shield, the headscarf knotted tight; feet apart, the lips pressed and the olive eyes unblinking.

诸国期|zg2_bori.why: 刚出师的矮人锻工，共鸣一档，围裙外头是自己打的小铁帽和小圆盾，盾上他只会的那一道符文烧红。
诸国期|zg2_bori.battle: His fighting gear, made at his own anvil: the scorched apron over a leather jerkin, a small iron cap struck with a single rune on the brow; the small round shield he forged himself held up on the left arm, its one hammered rune burning a ring of red light; the small hammer gripped in the right hand, a spark of forge heat on its face; feet wide in the stout boots, a faint swirl of wind curling round them. Eyes wide, brows drawn together, the mouth closed and set.

诸国期|zg2_selwin.why: 刻判例的老抄写人，不打仗，照姿势句拿凿子和槌站着，工衣不改。
诸国期|zg2_selwin.battle: His standing-ground gear: a dust-grey leather apron over the tunic, the chisel gripped like a short blade in the right hand and a stone mallet in the left, shoulders braced against the stoop; the face stubborn and set, the mouth closed.

诸国期|zg2_bandit.why: 老猎鳞人落魄劫道，估灵格，穷，减到一档，身上是猎鳞那些年剩下的硬皮甲和一块旧龙鳞护肩。
诸国期|zg2_bandit.battle: His ambush gear, the last of his scale-hunting days: the worn hard-leather jerkin buttoned tight to the chin; one battered shoulder guard of dull dark drake scale strapped on the right; a rag wrapped round the lower face and hanging at the neck; the cloak bundled on one shoulder; an old curved hunting knife sheathed across the belt. The hand axe raised in the right hand, the three-fingered left hand held out to signal (on the viewer's right when they face us); crouched and ready.

诸国期|zg2_copperking.why: 铜谷的王，本事不高，钱多，买来的整套铜甲和镶紫雷核的盔，照姿势句，原句已经是这一档。
诸国期|zg2_copperking.battle: His war clothes: bought bronze armour, a copper breastplate engraved with the valley arms worn over the robe, a plumed helmet with a small purple thunder core on its brow, a short ceremonial sword held point down in both hands; stout and heavy, the face calm and unworried.

诸国期|zg2_clanhead.why: 守了几千年的玄鳞氏族长，估极境，氏族传下来的一副旧甲，片片嵌着祖辈褪下的鳞，招牌是胸口刻纹的大鳞。
诸国期|zg2_clanhead.battle: His war gear, the old clan harness of Skyridge: the grey-brown robe with the sleeves tied back, a heavy leather harness strapped over it hung with dark metal plates, each plate set with a shed deep blue-green scale of the clan's forebears; dark plated vambraces over the scaled hands; the big carved chest scale left bare and glowing amber along the clan sign. The heavy iron-shod staff held upright in the right hand, its head ringed with old engraved runes that hold a warm ember light; feet planted wide; the face grim and the mouth closed.

诸国期|zg3_bran.why: 不站边的半身人车夫，照姿势句拿奶酪刀抱账本，旧呢外套不改。
诸国期|zg3_bran.battle: Ready to hold the line: the patched coat buttoned, a leather cap tied on, thick leather gloves; he holds the cheese knife out nervously in front in his right hand and hugs the ledger to his chest with the left. A worried but stubborn look.

诸国期|zg3_katrin.why: 共鸣的城门守兵，穿城里发的烫徽皮甲，只多一面嵌着碎核的城徽圆盾，枪尖那点麦秆色的光是她的天赋。
诸国期|zg3_katrin.battle: On guard, in the Wheat-Bridge guard's kit: the leather armour branded with the town crest of a bridge wound in wheat, leather bracers and greaves, an iron cap; on the left arm a round shield painted with the same crest, a small cracked beast-core chip set in its boss and glowing dull gold, a gift of the old gate sergeant; the bronze seal at her belt. The long straw-tasselled spear held level at the ready in both hands, a point of straw-gold light at its tip. An unblinking glare.

诸国期|zg3_naka.why: 跑信的狐耳姑娘，本事只为送到，不用来打人，身上轻，只在皮外套上烫一支的记号，腿边一缕青风。
诸国期|zg3_naka.battle: Racing through danger, light as a runner must be: the short leather jacket buckled, the cloth strips at the cuffs streaming, her clan's fox mark burnt into the leather at the shoulder; leather bracers; the deerskin letter pouch strapped tight across the chest; calf wraps tight with a thin green wind curling round them. A short knife held low in her right hand. Leaning low, ears flat, a fierce look.

诸国期|zg3_tahe.why: 共鸣的狼耳猎手，草原上兽耳打仗靠身子不靠魔导，毛皮背心上烫一支的狼纹，骨片护臂，不加光。
诸国期|zg3_tahe.battle: On the hunt, in a hunter's own gear: the fur vest belted tight, his clan's wolf mark burnt into the leather at the breast; leather bracers studded with polished bone; a quiver of grey-fletched arrows at the hip; a coil of dog leashes at the belt. The short bow drawn halfway in both hands, the bone whistle held in his teeth, ears flat back. A sharp focused look.

诸国期|zg3_inri.why: 共鸣的高原猎户姑娘，皮外套外头只加一件射下过岚鹰的人才披的鹰羽短披，箭羽上那一缕青风是她的天赋。
诸国期|zg3_inri.battle: On a cliff-side hunt, in a highland hunter's gear: the leather jacket with the storm-hawk-down collar high, belted tight; leather bracers and a glove on the draw hand; over the jacket a short shoulder cape of storm-hawk feathers, the hunters' badge for one who has brought down a hawk. The short bow drawn to the cheek with a hawk-fletched arrow, a thin curl of green wind stirring around the fletching; the braid swinging. A narrowed, focused look.

诸国期|zg3_todd.why: 车队的厨子，一辈子靠锅不靠甲，传奇也是喂饱人喂出来的，照姿势句举锅当盾，不改。
诸国期|zg3_todd.battle: Ready to feed the line: the apron cinched, leather gloves, a thick wool cap; he holds the iron pot up in front of the chest like a shield in one hand and the knife in the other. A fierce, worried look.

诸国期|zg3_rose.why: 领车队的半身人，不打仗，照姿势句抱账本举车铃，厚呢外套不改。
诸国期|zg3_rose.battle: Ready to lead the wagons out: the coat buttoned to the chin, a leather cap over the scarf, thick gloves; she clutches the ledger to her chest with one hand and holds the string of bells up in the other. A stern, determined look.

诸国期|zg3_chestnutcount.why: 日轮的伯爵，估灵格，世家加一档，一身成套的家传钢甲，可宝石都当了换粮，冠和护手只剩空托，只有剑格上一颗星石还在。原句给冠写了红玉，跟长相不合，改成无宝石。
诸国期|zg3_chestnutcount.battle: Holding the gate, in a sun-kingdom noble's harness with its jewels sold: a dull steel breastplate stamped with the sun-kingdom crown and matching pauldrons over the worn ruby-red wool, the black mourning band on the left sleeve (on the viewer's right); steel gauntlets whose cuffs hold only empty gold claws where star-stones were pawned; the gilded circlet on his head with its three bare empty settings and no stones; a plain helm under his arm. A long sword on the belt (on the viewer's left) with his hand on the hilt, its crossguard settings bare but for one pale star-stone glowing faintly in his grip. A cold, grieving glare.

诸国期|zg3_wheatcount.why: 爱舒服、饿死人也不卖星石的麦桥伯爵，估灵格，世家加一档，整套擦亮的钢甲，剑格嵌满红玉星石，招牌是额前那一颗星石。
诸国期|zg3_wheatcount.battle: At the gate, in the full harness of a comfortable count: a polished steel breastplate stamped with the wheat-and-bridge crest, matching pauldrons and gauntlets over the rich navy robe worked with blue-white silver thread; a heavy cloak; the gold circlet with its one pale blue-white star-stone at the brow, glowing steady; a sword on the belt (on the viewer's left) with his hand on the hilt, its gilded guard crowded with rubies and small star-stones that flare blue-white as he grips. A stubborn look.

诸国期|zg3_wolfchief.why: 北头猎场的狼耳首领，估极境，草原兽耳不用魔导，招牌是一张狼王皮斗篷和烫着一支狼纹的厚皮胸甲。
诸国期|zg3_wolfchief.battle: Facing the other camp, in a chieftain's hide and bone: the heavy cloak of a great grey wolf-lord's pelt thrown back, its head worn at the shoulder; a thick leather breastpiece with the north clan's wolf mark burnt deep into it; bone-plated bracers; a bone clasp at the throat; a quiver at the hip. The long bow held low in the left hand with an arrow, the bow not raised. A patient, hard look.

诸国期|zg3_deerchief.why: 南头鹿耳首领，估灵格，性子温和，层叠的小鹿皮斗篷加一件烫一支鹿纹的软皮胸甲，不加光。
诸国期|zg3_deerchief.battle: Holding the migration route, in the south clan's hide: the layered fawn-hide cloak belted over a supple leather breastpiece burnt with the south clan's deer mark; leather bracers; the bead string at the throat; a short bow held low in the left hand (on the viewer's right), a quiver at the hip. A resolute, gentle look.

诸国期|zg4_evelyn.why: 共鸣的日轮侍从，马夫家的女儿，烫冠皮甲外头只多一块第三回讨伐军留下的凹钢肩甲，亮的是胸口的冠和那只会鸣的空鞘。
诸国期|zg4_evelyn.battle: Ready to charge a ridge, in a squire's kit and one piece from the lost host: the leather armor strapped tight, the sun-kingdom crown branded on the chest catching a faint warm holy glow; a dented steel pauldron on the right shoulder salvaged from the third host; steel-capped leather bracers; a plain round wooden shield on her left arm; the old knight's empty scabbard still on her back, its mouth humming with a faint gold light. The cloth taken off the spear head so the bare blade shows, she grips the long spear levelled forward in both hands, feet planted wide. A fierce, unblinking look.

诸国期|zg4_pippa.why: 车营里长大的姑娘，不带兵器，照姿势句攥车铃拿柳条，改小的皮外套不改。
诸国期|zg4_pippa.battle: Ready to bolt: the cut-down leather coat buckled shut, a leather cap tied down over the curls, the bell string wrapped tight in her left fist so it cannot ring, bare feet apart; she carries no weapon and holds the willow switch out in front like a pointer. Wide alert eyes, mouth closed.

诸国期|zg4_emil.why: 共鸣的毛皮商，好皮子缝的外套就是他的护身，照姿势句举皮卷挡着，不改。
诸国期|zg4_emil.battle: Standing his ground on the road: the fur coat buttoned tight, a leather belt cinched, heavy fur mittens, the fox hat pulled down; he grips the short skinning knife low in his right hand and holds the roll of pelts up before him like a shield. A fierce, stubborn glare.

诸国期|zg4_gunt.why: 当兵三十年、讨龙去过两回的老兵，估灵格，穷兵减一档，身上是三回讨伐剩下的旧皮甲、一块旧日轮肩甲和熏黑的小盾；冬天也不戴帽，照旧光头。
诸国期|zg4_gunt.battle: As he went up the road, bare-headed in what survived three hosts: the battered sun-kingdom leather jerkin with its faded crown, buckled; one old dented steel pauldron on the right shoulder, its engraved sun-rays worn almost smooth yet still holding a faint gold glimmer; leather vambraces; a short sword on the belt (on the viewer's left); a small round shield on the left arm, scorched black at the rim by dragon heat. He holds the spear low and steady in the right hand, a calm, unreadable look.

诸国期|zg4_whitestone.why: 打过七八回兽潮没输过的日轮伯爵，估极境，世家加一档，量身打的白甲，日芒祷告时亮圣光。
诸国期|zg4_whitestone.battle: Ready to give the order, in the made-to-measure harness of a sun-kingdom count: full white plate of overlapping polished steel, fitted close and burnished bright, the gold crown emblem on the breastplate ringed with engraved sun-rays that shine with a holy glow; gilded edging on the pauldrons and gauntlets; the helm on with the visor up and a short white plume at its crest; a white cloak; the long sword on the belt, its guard set with a sun-gold beast core. His right hand is raised high, about to fall, his left hand resting on the sword hilt. A cold, exact look.

诸国期|zg5_enid.why: 十四岁的锁匠学徒，不带兵器，本事在耳管和拨片上，照姿势句，大外袍不改。
诸国期|zg5_enid.battle: The oversized robe belted tight with a cord, the sleeves pushed up, the hem knotted up, a leather tool roll at her side; a copper listening tube in one hand and a thin steel pick in the other, eyes narrowed, mouth closed.

诸国期|zg5_enid_legend.why: 不打一仗的智巧传奇，一辈子穿温策尔那件外袍、不带兵器，照姿势句，不加甲。
诸国期|zg5_enid_legend.battle: The big robe belted with a cord, the sleeves pushed up, a leather tool roll at her side, the copper tube in one hand and a thin pick in the other, the brows drawn together.

诸国期|zg5_anselm.why: 灵格的星湖扈从，未成年往低判，扈从一套锁子甲加煮皮胸甲，空塔盾等起誓，背上王的盾画着湖和星，湖纹微亮。
诸国期|zg5_anselm.battle: A squire's kit of the lake knights: a fitted mail shirt under a boiled leather cuirass, the deep blue tunic over it with the ring of embroidered water at the cuffs, leather vambraces, a plain steel cap. The white ash spear held level in both hands, the blank unpainted tower shield on his left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us), a faint ring of still blue light spreading from its rim as he plants it; the king's painted star-lake shield slung on his back, its ring of water glowing pale teal; feet planted, a stern look.

诸国期|zg5_remy.why: 从来不带刀的犬耳向导，照姿势句提不点的灯牵绳，不加甲。
诸国期|zg5_remy.battle: The grey hooded jacket buttoned up, the hood down so both ears show, leather gloves, the rope coil in one hand and the unlit lantern in the other; he has no weapon. Feet light, a tense, listening look, one ear pricked.

诸国期|zg5_cordai.why: 羽信会跑信人，只为送到不为打，不带兵器，照姿势句，灰斗篷别羽毛就是这一身。
诸国期|zg5_cordai.battle: The grey cloak thrown back, the satchel strapped tight to her back, a leather cap tied under the chin, leather gloves, thin deerskin shoes laced tight; empty hands, no weapon. A lean, intent look, the ears flattened back.

诸国期|zg5_sabina.why: 共鸣的守桥人，雾桥家这辈的老大，桥上发的煮皮甲和短锁子，招牌是补过两回的家传塔盾和照透雾的桥灯。
诸国期|zg5_sabina.battle: A bridge-guard's kit: the thick wool bridge cloak with the bridge embroidered at the collar, a boiled leather cuirass over a short mail shirt and the blue tunic, leather vambraces, a plain steel cap. The old tower shield on her left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us), patched twice at the edge, its painted ring of lake and single star glowing faint teal; the long spear levelled in her right hand, the bridge lamp on the shaft burning a clear, piercing white; feet planted wide, a steady, stern look.

诸国期|zg5_edgar.why: 极境的星湖王，加一档，量身的湖蓝珐琅半甲刻一圈湖纹，不戴冠；他年轻以后就没上过阵，甲不求华丽，招牌是湖底石环的王剑。
诸国期|zg5_edgar.battle: In the war harness of the lake king, worn for the first time in years: a lake-blue enamelled steel half-armour over the deep blue coat, a ring of water engraved across the breastplate and pauldrons whose lines glow pale cyan, fine mail at the arms, leather gauntlets, a plain open steel helm with no crown. The royal sword drawn and held low in his right hand, its stone-ring hilt glowing pale cyan and a thin cool light running down the blade; a calm, unhurried, heavy look.

诸国期|zg5_bertram.why: 从不自己动手的黑石副使，照姿势句手搭袖口拿信，不加甲。
诸国期|zg5_bertram.battle: He never does his own work: a heavy charcoal-grey travelling cloak with a fur collar over the robe, leather gloves, a rolled letter in one hand, the other hand on his cuff; a cool, measuring look.

诸国期|zg5_lorel.why: 做笛子的精灵，照姿势句捧白木笛不出手，苔色斗篷不改。
诸国期|zg5_lorel.battle: The moss-green cloak pulled around her, the hood half up, a leather travelling jerkin and leggings, soft boots, a slim elven bow slung on her back; she holds only the white-wood flute in front of her, a still, watchful look.

诸国期|zg5_anselm_legend.rank: 传奇·撼世（名字凝在极境，后到传奇）
诸国期|zg5_anselm_legend.why: 执冠者的骑士、星湖行波盾律的传奇，这一纪顶档的湖蓝甲，偏好不变，还是那面补了又补的旧塔盾，誓纹和湖星发光。
诸国期|zg5_anselm_legend.battle: In the harness of the Crown-Bearer's knight, made to his measure: lake-blue enamelled plate over fine mail, the breastplate and pauldrons engraved with the ring of water and the lines of his three-line oath, all glowing a steady pale teal; a deep blue surcoat with embroidered water at the hem; plated vambraces; a plain steel cap. The white ash spear held level in both hands, and on his left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us) the same old tower shield, patched in many places, its painted lake and single star shining like still water, a ring of calm blue light spreading from its rim; feet planted, the stiff left leg braced behind; a stern look.

诸国期|zg6_gulba.why: 灵格的采石人家儿子，穷，减一档，錾痕皮围裙底下加一件厚皮坎肩、一块换来的铜皮肩甲，亮的是石杖里的岩息黄脉。
诸国期|zg6_gulba.battle: Bracing for a rockfall, in a quarryman's gear: the scored leather apron laced tight over a thick leather jerkin; a single old bronze-hide shoulder plate on the left shoulder, traded from a highland carter; leather bracers dusted white with stone; the straw pouch at the belt. The straight white stone staff held upright in front of him with both hands, thin amber veins of rock-breath glowing through its pale stone; the shoulders squared, feet planted wide, a steady, heavy look.

诸国期|zg6_magda.why: 灵格的外炉炸山匠，行里配的整套工装改合身，铁盔一道火符、胸前一块挡碎石的符文铁片，赤粉是开山的不是打仗的。
诸国期|zg6_magda.battle: The scorched leather work suit under a thick leather apron and a wide belt hung with fuse coils; heavy gloves with rune-stitched cuffs; a stout hammered-iron helmet with a single fire rune on the brow glowing red; a small rune-struck iron plate over the chest that turns flying stone; the flat iron case on her back, red-core light glowing through its slots. A copper tube of red powder held in one hand, its seal glowing ember red, a coil of fuse in the other; feet planted wide, eyes narrowed to slits.

诸国期|zg6_liese.why: 未成年的磨坊女儿，看水的不是打仗的，只加一件上蜡的短皮坎肩和一枚河石护符，柳棍分叉处一点水光是她的天赋。
诸国期|zg6_liese.battle: The linen blouse under a short waxed leather vest, the brown skirt over close-fitting wool leggings, laced leather boots, a small river-stone charm on a cord at her neck holding a bead of faint blue water light; the knotted measuring rope across her chest. The forked willow stick held out in front with both hands, a thin shimmer of water light gathering at its fork; wide eyes, closed mouth, serious.

诸国期|zg6_ryan.why: 王矿末层的矿奴，灵格但一无所有，减到一档，破麻衣加厚皮围裙，自己的镣铐留着，锤上越硬越脆的裂光是他的天赋。
诸国期|zg6_ryan.battle: The torn hemp shirt under a thick miner's leather apron laced tight, the forearms bound in old leather wraps, the heavy locked iron shackle on the left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us); the small oil lamp hooked on his belt, still burning; pale-silver ore dust glinting on his sleeves. The miner's hammer with three finger-notches swung back in both hands, thin white cracks of light running across its head. Feet planted wide, a fierce, silent look.

诸国期|zg6_egon.why: 重骑扈从下来守外门，共鸣本是一档，可黑石发的铜皮重骑甲是整套的，算改合身的旧甲，甲片掺月银末发冷光。
诸国期|zg6_egon.battle: Heavy-cavalry order, in the issued kit of Blackstone: bronze-hide lamellar pressed from bronze-wolf hide with the seven-ringed wall branded on the chest, its scales dusted with pale-silver powder that glints cold white; matching bronze-hide pauldrons and tassets; a bronze-hide helmet with a nose guard; leather gauntlets. The long spear held low and level in both hands, the huge iron gate key tucked at his belt; feet planted, a hard, steady look.

诸国期|zg6_merlin.why: 井口拣矿的千湖姑娘，最穷的一档，破麻衣外加短皮外套和拣矿皮手套，腰上挂瑞恩砸开的镣铐。
诸国期|zg6_merlin.battle: The hemp shirt and patched skirt under a short leather jacket, close-fitting hemp leggings, laced boots, thick leather sorting gloves; the heavy sorting bag across her chest glittering with pale-silver grit; the broken iron shackle hanging at her waist by its chain. A short miner's pick held low in her right hand, a faint silver glint along its point; steady eyes.

诸国期|zg6_duke.why: 八十多岁的灰须公爵，不动手只下令，照姿势句举拐杖指着，呢袍银链不改。
诸国期|zg6_duke.battle: A dark-grey travelling cloak with a fur-lined collar over the court robe, the silver coin chain, one hand gripping the cane like a staff of command, the other raised to point; he carries no weapon. A stern, commanding look.
